n-m-h3-prob-02.topic: Yiwuwar: sharaɗantaccen yiwuwa, zaman kansa da dogaro, tunanin Bayes, tsara sample space
n-m-h3-prob-02.title: Abubuwa Biyu da Ba Su Tare Faruwa: Shin Masu Zaman Kansu ne?
n-m-h3-prob-02.goal: Bambanta “ba sa faruwa tare” da “masu zaman kansu,” sannan bayyana hujja bisa ma'anar independence (sanin ɗaya ba ya canza yiwuwar ɗayan).
n-m-h3-prob-02.material: An jefa ƙuri'a madaidaiciya sau ɗaya. A ita ce “sakamako 1 ko 2,” B kuma “sakamako 3 ko 4.” Ba za su faru lokaci guda ba. Jimin ya duba ya yi da'awar nan.
n-m-h3-prob-02.thinking.1: Duba independence ta amfani da ninkawa
n-m-h3-prob-02.prereq.0: Ma'anar abubuwan da ke zaman kansu
n-m-h3-prob-02.prereq.1: Ma'anar abubuwan da ba sa faruwa tare
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.prompt: Jimin ya ce, “A da B ba za su faru lokaci guda ba, saboda haka ba sa shafar juna. Don haka masu zaman kansu ne.” Wace tantancewa ce ta fi dacewa?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin abin da ke faruwa da yiwuwar B idan ka san A ta faru.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.hint.1: Idan suna zaman kansu, sanin A ya faru dole ya bar yiwuwar B kamar da. Kwatanta ko haka ne a wannan yanayin.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.a: Ba daidai ba. Idan ka san A ya faru, B ba zai iya faruwa ba, saboda haka yiwuwar B ta bambanta da da.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.b: Daidai ne. Tunda abubuwan biyu ba sa faruwa tare, ɗaya ba ya canza yiwuwar ɗayan.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.b: Ka fassara “ba sa faruwa tare” da “ba sa shafar juna.” Kasancewar ɗaya ya hana ɗayan faruwa shi kansa babban tasiri ne.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.c: Daidai ne. Tunda yiwuwar A da B iri ɗaya ce, ɗaya ba ya shafar ɗayan.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.c: Daidaiton girmar yiwuwar da independence abubuwa daban ne. Independence na nufin ko sanin ɗaya ya faru yana canza yiwuwar ɗayan.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.o.d: Ba daidai ba. Tunda yiwuwar A da B ta bambanta, ɗaya yana shafar ɗayan.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.r.d: Bambancin yiwuwar ba ya nufin abubuwan ba masu zaman kansu ba ne. Abin kwatantawa shi ne ko sanin ɗaya yana canza yiwuwar ɗayan.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s1.explain: Idan A da B ba sa faruwa tare, kuma kowannensu yana da yiwuwa fiye da 0, sanin A ya faru yana sauya yiwuwar B zuwa 0. Idan suna zaman kansu, dole P(B|A)=P(B), saboda haka ba su zaman kansu. A jefa ƙuri'a, A na 1 ko 2 ne B kuma 3 ko 4; P(B)=1/3, amma idan A ya faru P(B|A)=0.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.prompt: Da jefa ƙuri'a guda ɗin, la'akari da C (sakamako ko da) da D (sakamako 3 ko ƙasa). Zaɓi duk nau'i-nau'in abubuwan da ke zaman kansu.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowane nau'i, nemo P(duka sun faru) da P(na farko)×P(na biyu), ka kwatanta daidaitonsu.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.hint.1: Da farko rubuta sakamakon da ya shiga kowane abu, sannan nemo waɗanda ke shiga duka biyun.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.r.a: Ka ɗauki abubuwan da ba sa faruwa tare a matsayin masu zaman kansu. Idan ɗaya ya faru, yiwuwar ɗayan ta zama 0.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.r.d: Ka ɗauki kasancewar A cikin D a matsayin “ba su da alaƙa.” Idan A ta faru, D tabbas za ta faru, don haka yiwuwar D tana canzawa.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s2.explain: P(A)=1/3, P(C)=1/2, kuma P(A∩C)=P({2})=1/6=P(A)P(C), saboda haka A da C suna zaman kansu. Haka kuma B da C, domin B∩C={4} kuma 1/6=1/3×1/2. Ga A da D, P(A∩D)=1/3 amma P(A)P(D)=1/6; ba su zaman kansu. Abubuwa na iya zaman kansu ko da suna haɗuwa, amma waɗanda ba sa haɗuwa (idan yiwuwarsu ta fi 0) ba za su iya zaman kansu ba.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta bayani da za ka aika wa Jimin. Bisa ma'anar A da B su zama masu zaman kansu, bayyana dalilin da ya sa ba haka ba ne a misalin ƙuri'ar nan, kana amfani da “yiwuwar B idan mun san A ta faru.”
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta sakamakon ƙuri'ar da ya rage idan ka san A ta faru, sannan duba ko akwai wanda ke cikin B.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.hint.1: A jimla guda, rubuta yiwuwar B ta farko da wadda ta biyo bayan sanin A, ka kwatanta su.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.placeholder: misali, idan ka san A ta faru, to B ...
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana independence da “sanin abu guda ba ya canza yiwuwar ɗayan”?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: A wannan misalin, ka bayyana yiwuwar B ta asali da yiwuwarta bayan sanin cewa A ta faru?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka ce “ba sa faruwa lokaci guda” da “masu zaman kansu” ba abu ɗaya ba ne?
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.model.0: Idan abubuwan suna zaman kansu, yiwuwar B za ta kasance 1/3 ko da mun san A ta faru. Amma idan A (1 ko 2) ta faru, B (3 ko 4) ba zai faru ba, saboda haka yiwuwarta ta zama 0. Yiwuwar ta canza, don haka ba masu zaman kansu ba ne.
n-m-h3-prob-02.s.s3.model.1: Da farko yiwuwar B ita ce kashi ɗaya bisa uku. Amma idan mun san ƙuri'ar ta nuna 1 ko 2, 3 ko 4 ba zai yiwu ba, saboda haka yiwuwar B ta koma 0. Da suna zaman kansu ba za ta canza ba, amma ta canza; don haka ba su zaman kansu.

n-m-h3-prob-08.thinking.0: Bambance bayanin da ake buƙata da wanda ba a buƙata ba
n-m-h3-prob-08.topic: Yiwuwar: sharaɗantaccen yiwuwa, independence da dogaro, tunanin Bayes, tsara sample space
n-m-h3-prob-08.title: Kuɗin Kyauta na Wasan da Aka Katse: Yaya Za a Raba?
n-m-h3-prob-08.goal: Tantance bayanin da ake buƙata don nemo yiwuwar cin nasara, sannan gina sample space mai yiwuwar daidai ta ɗauka wasan da zai iya ƙare da wuri an buga shi har ƙarshe.
n-m-h3-prob-08.material: Ƙungiyoyin A da B suna wasa; ta farko da ta ci wasanni 3 za ta sami kyautar won 80,000, amma an katse wasan. A yanzu A ta ci 2, B kuma 1. Sun amince a raba kyautar bisa “yiwuwar kowace ƙungiya ta yi nasara a wasannin da suka rage.”
n-m-h3-prob-08.thinking.1: Gina sample space mai yiwuwar daidai
n-m-h3-prob-08.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da ɗauka ba ya sauya sakamako
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.prompt: A da B suna wasan da ta fara cin wasanni 3 ke samun won 80,000, amma an katse. A ta ci 2, B ta ci 1. Za a raba kyautar bisa yiwuwar nasara. Zaɓi duk bayanin da ake buƙata don nemo yiwuwar (ba a san ƙwarewar ƙungiyoyin ba).
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.hint.0: Cire bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya ka duba ko za a iya lissafa yiwuwar nan gaba ba tare da su ba.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta abin da ake buƙata don sanin wasanni nawa kowace ƙungiya za ta ƙara ci domin zama zakara.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.a: Jerin yadda aka ci wasannin baya (A,B,A)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.r.a: Ka ɗauka jerin lokaci yana da muhimmanci. Yiwuwa nan gaba ta dogara ne kan nasarorin yanzu da wasannin da suka rage; jerin da aka tara nasarorin ba ya shafar ta.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.b: Yawan nasarar kowace ƙungiya zuwa yanzu (2 da 1)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.c: Yawan nasarar da ake buƙata don zakara (ta fara samun 3)
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.d: Tsawon lokacin da wasan ya ɗauka zuwa yanzu
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.r.d: Lokaci ba shi da alaƙa da nasara da rashin nasara nan gaba. Duba ko yana shafar yiwuwar cin nasara.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.o.e: Yiwuwar kowace ƙungiya ta ci wasa guda
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s1.explain: Adadin nasarorin yanzu da wanda ake buƙata don zakara suna ƙayyade ƙarin wasanni (A na buƙatar wasa 1, B wasa 2); yiwuwar kowace wasa tana ƙayyade yiwuwar hakan. Jerin nasara da lokacin wasan ba sa shafar wasannin saura.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.prompt: A ɗauka yiwuwar kowace ƙungiya ta ci wasa guda iri ɗaya ce, kuma wasanni ba sa shafar juna. Nemo yiwuwar A ta zama zakara da kuɗin kyautar da ya kamata A ta samu. Nuna yanayin da ka ƙirga.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta abin da dole ya faru a wasannin saura don A ta ci da kuma B ta ci.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ko da wasan zai iya ƙare da wuri, duba ko ɗauka cewa an buga duk wasannin saura yana ba da yanayi masu yiwuwa daidai.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka duba dabam yanayin A ta yi nasara da na B ta yi nasara?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka zaɓi yanayin da kowannensu ke da yiwuwar iri ɗaya?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka raba kuɗin kyautar bisa yiwuwoyin?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.model.0: Idan muka ɗauka an buga wasannin biyu da suka rage, sakamakon huɗu (A,A),(A,B),(B,A),(B,B) suna da yiwuwar iri ɗaya. Don B ta ci, dole ta ci duka biyun, wato (B,B) kawai; yiwuwarta 1/4 ce, ta A kuma 3/4. A ta samu won 60,000, B won 20,000.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s2.model.1: Don B ta yi nasara, dole ta ci wasanni biyu a jere, yiwuwar 1/2×1/2=1/4. Saboda haka A tana da 3/4, ta samu won 60,000 daga kyautar won 80,000.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.prompt: Minji ta ce, “Idan A ta ci wasa na gaba, wasan ya ƙare; don haka ba daidai ba ne a ɗauka za a buga wasanni biyu, domin ba haka abin ke faruwa.” Wace amsa ce ta fi dacewa?
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.hint.0: Nemo yiwuwar hanyoyi uku na ainihin ƙarshen wasa, ka tabbatar sun tara zuwa 1.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.hint.1: Idan aka buga wasannin biyu, yi teburin wanda ya zama zakara ga sakamako huɗu.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.a: Da gaske ana buga ƙarin wasanni biyu, saboda haka duk sakamako huɗu na iya faruwa.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.r.a: Wannan ya saɓa wa cewa wasan yana ƙarewa da wuri. Ba a buga su duka a zahiri.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.b: Yawan wasannin har zuwa ƙarshe dole ya zama iri ɗaya don rabon kyautar ya yi adalci.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.r.b: Ka dogara da adadin wasannin har ƙarshe wajen tantance adalci. Ma'aunin shi ne yiwuwar cin nasara.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.c: Sauƙaƙawa kawai ne, babu damuwa matuƙar ƙimar ta dace.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.r.c: Ba ka bayyana dalilin da ƙimar ta dace ba. Akwai dalilin da ya sa wannan hanyar ta dace.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.o.d: Wasannin da ake yi bayan an riga an yanke hukuncin ba sa canza mai nasara; sakamakon iri ɗaya ne ko an buga duka.
n-m-h3-prob-08.s.s3.explain: Idan A ta ci wasa na gaba, ita ce zakara, wasannin baya ba za su canza mai nasara ba. Don haka ko an ɗauka an buga wasannin biyu, “wanda ya ci” ba ya canzawa; sakamako huɗun suna da yiwuwar 1/4, wanda ke sauƙaƙa ƙirga. Ba daidai ba ne a ɗauki hanyoyin ainihin ƙarshe uku (“A ta ci” 1/2, “B ta ci sannan A ta ci” 1/4, “B ta ci sau biyu a jere” 1/4) a matsayin masu yiwuwa iri ɗaya.

n-m-h3-serieslim-01.thinking.0: Sabunta hukunci duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.title: Idan Mun Haɗa Kalmomin, Jimillar Za Ta Zama Ɗaya?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.topic: Jerin lissafi: jimlolin ɓangare da jerin geometric marar iyaka
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.goal: Ta rubuta jimlolin ɓangare da kanka, bincika ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa haɗuwar kalmomin da ke haɗuwa ba ta tabbatar da cewa jerin asali yana haɗuwa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.material: Abokai uku suna gardama kan jimillar jerin 1−1+1−1+1−1+… Ana bayyana bayani kaɗan-kaɗan. (Kalmar gabaɗaya (−1)^(n−1): 1 idan n bai rabu da 2 ba, −1 idan ya rabu.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.thinking.1: Tantance haɗuwar jerin ta jimlolin ɓangare
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.thinking.2: Tantance wace alkibla ce ta tabbata tsakanin jerin da aka haɗa da na asali
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.prereq.1: Ma'anar jimillar jerin a matsayin iyakar jimlolin ɓangare
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.prompt: A kowane mataki yi hukunci bisa abin da ka sani a lokacin.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.hint.0: Idan sabon bayani ya bayyana, sake duba ko hukuncin baya har yanzu ya dace.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta haɗuwa biyu daban-daban, ka kwatanta ko suna ba da ƙima iri ɗaya ko da an sauya haɗin kalmomi.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Mina ta haɗa kalmomi biyu-biyu: (1−1)+(1−1)+(1−1)+…, saboda haka kowane baka 0 ne.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Me kake ganin jimillar jerin nan ita ce?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Ya danganta da yadda aka haɗa, an samu 0 da 1. Saboda haka bai kamata a ayyana jimilla bisa cewa “na haɗa ta wata hanya” kawai ba.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka ɗauki sakamakon haɗuwa guda a matsayin jimillar jerin. Wannan shi ne hukuncin farko da ya zo rai.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: 1: domin barin kalmar farko 1 da haɗa 1+(−1+1)+(−1+1)+… yana ba da 1
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka gwada wata hanyar haɗawa kuma ka samu ƙima dabam. Amma ka yi gaggawar ɗaukar ƙimar a matsayin jimilla.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ya yi wuri a yanke hukunci: duba ko ƙimar ta kasance iri ɗaya idan an canza haɗuwar.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kana zargin sakamakon na iya sauyawa bisa yadda aka haɗa kalmomin.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Rubuta jimlolin ɓangare a jere: S_1=1, S_2=0, S_3=1, S_4=0, S_5=1, ….
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: An ayyana jerin ta iyakar jimlolin ɓangare. Yanzu wane hukunci za ka yanke?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Jimlolin ɓangare ba sa kusantar ƙima guda, saboda haka jerin ba ya haɗuwa. Ba a ƙayyade jimillarsa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Yana haɗuwa zuwa 0: domin S_2,S_4,… duk 0 ne
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka duba jimlolin masu lamba biyu kawai; ka manta masu lamba marar rabo da 2 su ne 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Yana haɗuwa zuwa 1: domin S_1,S_3,… duk 1 ne
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka duba masu lamba marar rabo da 2 kawai; ka manta masu lamba biyu su ne 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ba ya haɗuwa: jimlolin ɓangare na canzawa tsakanin 0 da 1, ba sa kusantar ƙima guda.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka duba halin dukkan jimlolin ɓangare, ka yanke hukunci bisa ma'anar iyaka.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Amma jerin 0+0+0+… da Mina ta samu ta hanyar haɗawa a fili yana haɗuwa zuwa 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Daga haɗuwar jerin da aka haɗa, me za a iya cewa game da jerin asali?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Idan jerin asali ya haɗu, jerin da aka haɗa zai haɗu da jimilla iri ɗaya. Amma akasin ba ya tabbata, domin jerin da aka haɗa yana amfani da S_2,S_4,… kawai.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Jerin asali ma yana haɗuwa da jimilla iri ɗaya: domin haɗa kalmomi kawai aka yi
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka yi amfani da tunanin cewa haɗa kalmomi ba ya sauya jimilla ta dukkan alkibla.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ba za a iya tantancewa ba: jimlolin ɓangare na jerin da aka haɗa wasu kaɗan ne kawai daga na asali
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka nuna cewa jerin da aka haɗa yana amfani da wasu jimlolin ɓangare na asali kaɗai.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Jimillar jerin asali duka 0 da 1 ce: domin kowane haɗuwa na da jimilla
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka ce jerin da ba ya haɗuwa yana da jimilla biyu. An ayyana jimilla a matsayin iyaka guda na jimlolin ɓangare.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s1.reflect: Da farko lissafin 0 ta hanyar haɗa rukuni ya yi kama da mai ma'ana, amma hukuncinka ya sauya bayan ka rubuta jimillar ɓangarori. Ko jerin yana da iyaka ana yanke hukunci ne da halin duk jimlolin ɓangare S_n, ba yadda aka haɗa rukuninsu ba.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.prompt: Soyoung ta ce, 'Haɗa cikin baka ya ba da 0+0+0+…, saboda haka jimillar 1−1+1−1+… ita ce 0.' Ka rubuta mata bayani. Haɗa yadda jimlolin ɓangare na jerin asali suke da kuma alaƙar jimlolin jerin da aka rukunta da na asali.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.hint.0: Fara rubuta S_1, S_2, S_3, S_4 da kanka, ka lura da yadda darajojin suke canjawa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.hint.1: Nuna waɗanne jimlolin ɓangare na asali ne suke zama jimlolin jerin da aka haɗa (1−1)+(1−1)+… .
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka bincika ainihin darajojin jimlolin ɓangare S_1, S_2, S_3, S_4?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka faɗi waɗanne jimlolin asali ne jerin rukuni ke amfani da su?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka yi la'akari ko 'jerin rukuni ya haɗu' yana tabbatar da 'jerin asali ya haɗu'?
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.model.0: Jimlolin ɓangare na jerin asali su ne 1, 0, 1, 0,…, suna canjawa tsakanin 0 da 1 ba tare da kusantar daraja guda ba. Saboda haka ba shi da jimilla. Jerin rukuni yana ɗauko wasu daga cikinsu kawai (masu lamba biyu), kamar S_2,S_4,…, shi ya sa ya zama 0 kawai.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.model.1: Jimlolin ɓangare suna maimaita 1,0,1,0 kuma ba sa haɗuwa. Idan muka sauya haɗin zuwa 1+(−1+1)+(−1+1)+…, zai ba da 1, saboda haka darajar ta dogara da yadda aka rukunta. Kasancewar jerin rukuni ya zama 0 ba shi da alaƙa da jimillar jerin asali.
n-m-h3-serieslim-01.s.s2.model.2: Soyoung, S_n na jerin asali 1 ne idan n marar-mabambanta ne, 0 kuma idan n mabambanta ne, saboda haka ba shi da iyaka (yana karkacewa). Rukunta cikin baka yana duba S_2,S_4,… kawai, waɗanda suke 0; wannan ba shaida ba ce cewa jerin asali ya haɗu.

n-m-h3-serieslim-04.topic: Jerin lissafi: jimlolin ɓangare da jerin geometric marar iyaka
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.title: Shin 0.999… Ya Kasa da 1 Kaɗan?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.goal: Ka bayyana ta amfani da iyakar bambanci cewa iyaka za ta iya zama jimilla ko da jimlolin ɓangare ba su taɓa kaiwa gare ta ba, sannan ka gina wani jerin mai irin wannan hali.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.material: Abokai biyu suna gardama ko 0.999… (inda 9 ke maimaituwa har abada) ya yi daidai da 1. Yuna: '0.9, 0.99, 0.999,… kullum ƙasa da 1 suke komai tsawon jerin, don haka 0.999… ƙasa da 1 ne.' Dohyun: '0.999…=9/10+9/100+9/1000+…, jerin geometric marar iyaka ne mai sharaɗin farko 9/10 da ma'aunin gama gari 1/10, saboda haka jimillarsa 1 ce.'
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.thinking.0: Tantance ko hujjar ikirari tana goyon bayan ƙarshe
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.thinking.2: Ƙirƙirar misalai masu irin wannan hali
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.prompt: Yi nazarin maganganun abokan biyu da hujjojinsu, sannan ka zaɓi hukunci mafi dacewa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.hint.0: Duba dabam ko hujjar Yuna gaskiya ce da ko ƙarshe ya biyo daga hujjar.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta ma'anar jimillar jerin, sannan ka kwatanta ko lissafin Dohyun ya dace da ma'anar.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.a: Dohyun ya yi daidai: jimillar jerin ita ce iyakar jimlolin ɓangare, kuma jimlolin suna kusantar 1 yadda ake so
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi hukunci bisa ma'anar jimilla (iyakar jimlolin ɓangare). Ka kuma ga cewa hujjar Yuna ba ta kai ga ƙarsheta ba.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.b: Ba a ƙayyade jimilla ba: jimlolin ɓangare suna canjawa har abada ba tare da samun daraja guda ba
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.b: Ka gauraya ci gaba da canjawar jimlolin ɓangare da rashin haɗuwa. Ko suna canjawa, jerin yana haɗuwa idan suna kusantar daraja guda.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.c: Yuna ta yi daidai: babu jimlar ɓangare da ta yi daidai da 1, don haka 0.999… ya bambanta da 1
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.c: Ka ɗauko halin kowace jimlar ɓangare kai tsaye zuwa iyaka. Iyakarsa ba ɗaya daga cikin jimlolin ɓangaren ba ce.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.o.d: Dukansu daidai ne: 0.999… ya gaza 1 da ƙaramin bambanci yadda ake so, amma a lissafi ana ɗaukarsa 1
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.r.d: Ka ce akwai tabbataccen bambanci daga 1 da ya rage, sannan kuma ka ce darajarsa da 1 ta yi daidai. A cikin lambobin gaske, lambobi biyu suna daidai ne kawai idan bambancinsu 0 ne.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s1.explain: Jimillar jerin ita ce iyakar jimlolin ɓangare S_n. A nan S_n=1−(1/10)^n kuma iyakarsa 1 ce, don haka 0.999…=1. Hujjar Yuna gaskiya ce, amma daga 'duk S_n sun gaza 1' ba ya biyo cewa 'lim S_n ya gaza 1' (a iyaka yana iya zama ≤).
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.prompt: Maganar Yuna 'ko da n nawa aka tara, jimlar ɓangaren tana ƙasa da 1' gaskiya ce. Amma ƙarsheta kuskure ne. Ka bayyana dalili ta amfani da 1−S_n, bambancin 1 da jimlar ɓangare S_n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta S_1,S_2,S_3 ka rubuta bambancin kowannensu da 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.hint.1: Haɗa yadda wannan bambanci yake canjawa yayin da n ke ƙaruwa da abin da aka ayyana jimillar jerin a matsayin iyaka.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana 1−S_n a matsayin tsari da ya danganta da n?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka danganta kusantar wannan daraja zuwa 0 da jimilla zama 1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka ce iyakar na iya zama 1 ko da jimlolin ɓangare ba su taɓa kaiwa 1 ba?
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.0: 1−S_n=1/10^n kullum ya fi 0, don haka S_n ƙasa da 1 ne. Amma yayin da n ke ƙaruwa, 1/10^n yana kusantar 0 yadda ake so, saboda haka iyakar S_n ita ce 1; da yake jimillar jerin wannan iyaka ce, 0.999…=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.1: Babu jimlar ɓangare da ta kai 1, amma 1−S_n=(1/10)^n yana haɗuwa zuwa 0. Jimillar jerin ita ce iyakar jimlolin ɓangare, saboda haka 1 ce. Ko da kowace jimlar ɓangare ƙasa da 1 ce, iyaka na iya zama 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s2.model.2: Kowane S_n ƙasa da 1 ne, amma bambancin 0.00…01 yana ƙara zama ƙarami yadda ake so yayin da n ke ƙaruwa; saboda haka iyaka 1 ce, kuma 0.999…=1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.prompt: Ka gina da kanka jerin mai irin wannan hali. Shigar da jerin geometric marar iyaka biyu a+ar+ar²+… mai sharaɗin farko a da ma'aunin gama gari r, jimillarsu 1 ne kuma duk jimlolin ɓangare ƙasa da 1 suke, tare da ma'aunai daban-daban. (Za ka iya shigar da adadi goma.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.hint.0: Fara rubuta lissafin da dole ne a da r su cika domin jimilla ta zama 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.hint.1: Lissafta S_1 da S_2 domin duba wace alamar r ake buƙata don duk jimlolin ɓangare su kasance ƙasa da 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.ok.c1: Cikakkiyar darajar ma'aunin gama gari ta gaza 1, don haka jerin yana haɗuwa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.fail.c1: |r|<1 ba ta cika ba, saboda haka wannan ba jerin haɗuwa mai jimilla 1 ba ne.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.ok.c3: Dukkan sharuɗɗan tabbatattu ne, saboda haka jimlolin ɓangare sun gaza 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.fail.c3: Ma'aunin gama gari ba tabbatacce ba ne, saboda haka jimlar ɓangare na iya wuce 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-04.s.s3.explain: Idan a=1−r da 0<r<1, jimlar ɓangare S_n=1−r^n kullum ƙasa da 1 ce amma iyakarsa 1 ce. a=0.9, r=0.1 daidai yake da 0.999…. Idan r mara kyau ne, a=1−r>1, don haka jimlar farko ta riga ta wuce 1.

n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko marar daidai a mafitar Seojin.
n-m-h3-integc-01.title: Naha Anjeun Bisa Percaya kana Nilai Hasil Integrasi Parsial?
n-m-h3-integc-01.topic: Integrasi: kasalahan dina integrasi parsial jeung mariksa tanda integran
n-m-h3-integc-01.goal: Panggihan sarta benerkeun baris salah anu pangheulana dina solusi integrasi parsial, jelaskeun cara mariksa tanda integral tangtu tina tanda integranna, sarta wates métode mariksa éta.
n-m-h3-integc-01.material: Seojin ngaréngsékeun ∫_0^π x sin x dx maké integrasi parsial. (∫_0^π nyaéta integral tangtu ti 0 nepi ka π. [F]_0^π = F(π) − F(0).)
n-m-h3-integc-01.thinking.1: Ngira-ngira tanda integral tangtu tina tanda integran
n-m-h3-integc-01.thinking.2: Mariksa rentang lumakuna métode mariksa (interval tempat tandana robah)
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.hint.0: Pikeun unggal baris anu méré fungsi anyar (u′, v), pariksa fungsi éta kana sarat aslina.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.hint.1: Dina baris v kapanggih, turunan v sorangan sarta pariksa naha sarua jeung v′.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.0: Pikeun ∫_0^π x sin x dx, candak u=x jeung v′=sin x.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.2: Ku rumus integrasi parsial, ∫_0^π x sin x dx = [x cos x]_0^π − ∫_0^π 1·cos x dx.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.3: [x cos x]_0^π = π·cos π − 0 = −π, sarta ∫_0^π cos x dx = [sin x]_0^π = 0.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.line.4: Ku kituna ∫_0^π x sin x dx = −π.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s1.explain: Baris 2 anu mimiti salah. Turunan cos x nyaéta −sin x, jadi v anu v′-na sin x nyaéta −cos x, lain cos x. Ti baris 3 saterusna v anu salah langsung diasupkeun kana rumus, jadi rumus jeung itungan aritmetikna bener, tapi hasilna salah.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.prompt: Gyara layin da ba daidai ba, ka nemo darajar ∫_0^π x sin x dx. Sannan, ta amfani da alamar x sin x a kan 0≤x≤π, ka bayyana cikin jimloli ɗaya ko biyu dalilin da ya sa −π na Seojin ba zai iya zama darajar ba.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ka sake nemo v inda v'=sin x, ka saka shi cikin tsarin da ke layi na 3, sannan ka lissafta a iyakokin.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ka duba a tebur ko x da sin x kowannensu ba ƙasa da 0 ba ne a kan 0≤x≤π, sannan ka yi tunani kan irin alamar da cikakken haɗin aikin da ba ƙasa da 0 ba yake da ita.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.placeholder: misali, idan muka ɗauki v, ..., darajar ita ce .... Amma x sin x ...
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka gyara v zuwa −cos x ka mayar da shi cikin tsarin?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka kawo cewa sin x ba ƙasa da 0 ba ne a kan 0≤x≤π a matsayin dalilinka?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka haɗa da ƙa'idar cewa idan integrand bai gaza 0 ba, cikakken haɗin ma ba zai gaza 0 ba?
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.model.0: Idan v'=sin x, to v=−cos x. [−x cos x]_0^π + ∫_0^π cos x dx = π + 0 = π. A kan 0≤x≤π, x≥0 da sin x≥0 ne, saboda haka x sin x≥0; wannan yana nufin cikakken haɗin ba zai iya zama mara kyau (−π) ba.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s2.model.1: Idan ka gyara v zuwa −cos x, darajar ita ce π. A wannan tazara x sin x kullum ba ya ƙasa da 0, don haka kamar yanki ne ba zai iya zama ƙasa da 0 ba; amma −π mara kyau ne, wannan kuma saɓani ne.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.prompt: Yanzu ana amfani da wannan aikin, amma an canja tazara zuwa [0,2π]. Zaɓi bayanin da ya dace game da hanyar duba alamar cikakken haɗi ta amfani da alamar integrand.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.hint.0: Duba alamar sin x a kan [π,2π], sannan ka yi tunanin siffar jadawalin x sin x.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.hint.1: Idan akwai ɓangarori masu kyau da marasa kyau duka, ka yi tunanin abin da alamar jimillar ta dogara da shi.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.a: x sin x ba ya ƙasa da 0 a kan [0,2π], saboda haka darajar dole ta zama tabbatacciya.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.a: Duba alamar sin x a kan [π,2π]. Ba ka bincika ko alamar tana nan iri ɗaya bayan an canja tazara ba.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.b: Ko da alamar ta canja, ɓangaren tabbatacce yana zuwa da farko, saboda haka darajar kullum tabbatacciya ce.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.b: Ka kalli tsarin zuwa ne kawai ba tare da kwatanta girman ɓangarorin tabbatacce da marasa kyau ba. Ɓangaren mara kyau na iya fi girma.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.c: Alamar x sin x tana canjawa a cikin tazara, saboda haka alamar kaɗai ba za ta iya ƙayyade alamar darajar ba.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.c: Ka lura cewa ana iya amfani da duba alama a tazarar da alamar take iri ɗaya a ko'ina.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.o.d: Ko da an tsawaita tazara, ƙarin ɓangaren yana soke kansa, saboda haka darajar ita ce π, kamar a kan [0,π].
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.r.d: Ka ɗauka ƙarin tazara [π,2π] za ta soke kanta ba tare da duba haɗinta kai tsaye ba.
n-m-h3-integc-01.s.s3.explain: A kan [π,2π], sin x≤0 ne, saboda haka x sin x≤0. Don haka alamar ba iri ɗaya ba ce a dukkan tazara; ɓangaren tabbatacce da mara kyau suna cin juna. A zahiri, [−x cos x + sin x]_0^{2π} = −2π, wanda mara kyau ne. Duba alama yana gaya maka alamar darajar ne kawai idan alamar ba ta canja a cikin tazara.

n-m-h3-integc-08.title: Yanki Guda, Yankewa Biyu Mabambanta
n-m-h3-integc-08.topic: Integral: yanki — haɗa bisa x ko bisa y (sauya wakilci)
n-m-h3-integc-08.goal: Ta amfani da siffar yankin, bayyana dalilin da ya sa haɗa bisa x da bisa y ke ba da yanki iri ɗaya, sannan tantance sharuɗɗan amfani da hanya ta biyu.
n-m-h3-integc-08.material: Mutane biyu sun nemo yankin R da lanƙwan y=ln x, axis x, da layin x=e suka kewaye da hanyoyi daban-daban. Jian ya warware ∫_1^e ln x dx ta haɗaɗɗen integral, ya samu [x ln x−x]_1^e=(e−e)−(0−1)=1. Soyul ta cire ∫_0^1 eʸdy=e−1 daga yankin murabba'i mai faɗin e (0≤x≤e, 0≤y≤1), ta samu e−(e−1)=1. (∫_1^e integral ne daga 1 zuwa e.)
n-m-h3-integc-08.thinking.1: Duba hoto domin gano yankin da aka cire
n-m-h3-integc-08.thinking.2: Tantance sharuɗɗan aiki (daidaiton ɗaya da ɗaya)
n-m-h3-integc-08.prereq.1: Ayyukan juyi da tabbatattun integrals na logarithm da exponent
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.prompt: A cikin hoton, wane yanki ne Soyul ta cire daga e ta amfani da ∫_0^1 eʸdy?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.hint.0: A ɗauki tsayi y, zana layin kwance cikin murabba'in, sannan nemo inda lanƙwan ya yanke wannan layin.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.hint.1: A wannan layin, bayyana ko R yana hagu ko dama da lanƙwan.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.a: Yankin R kansa, wanda muke son nemowa
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.a: Yankin R shi ne ƙimar da ake samu idan aka cire wannan magana daga e. Idan R da yankin maganar nan ɗaya ne, ba sai an cire shi daga e ba.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.b: Ka ga wannan ɓangare yana hagu da lanƙwan x=eʸ, wato sashen murabba'in da ba R ba.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.c: Sashen da ke ƙarƙashin y=ln x inda 1≤x≤e
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.c: Wannan shi ne R ɗin dai-dai. Soyul ba ta cire R daga e; tana cire sashen da ya rage.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.o.d: Sashen tsakanin axis x da lanƙwan inda 0<x<1
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.r.d: Ga 0<x<1 lanƙwan tana ƙarƙashin axis x, saboda haka ba ya cikin R kuma ba shi da alaƙa da wannan magana.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s1.explain: Yankin murabba'i 0≤x≤e, 0≤y≤1 shi ne e. A kowane tsayin y, wurin lanƙwan x=eʸ ne, saboda haka faɗin ɓangaren hagunta eʸ ne, yankinsa kuma ∫_0^1 eʸdy=e−1. R yana hannun dama, don haka yankinsa e−(e−1)=1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.prompt: Ta bin hanyar Soyul, nemo yankin da y=ln x, axis x, da x=e² suka kewaye. Nuna faɗi da tsayin murabba'i, da integral ɗin da za ka cire, sannan rubuta sakamakon.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo tsayin lanƙwan a x=e², wato y=ln e², domin sanin tsayin murabba'i.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ga kowane tsayi y, bayyana x-coordinate na lanƙwan ta amfani da y, sannan haɗa wannan magana daga 0 zuwa tsayin murabba'i.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka tabbatar cewa tsayin murabba'in ln e²=2 ne?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka duba ko ya yi daidai da ƙimar haɗaɗɗen integral?
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.model.0: Murabba'in yana da faɗin e² da tsayin ln e²=2, don haka yankinsa 2e² ne. Yankin hagu da lanƙwan shi ne ∫_0^2 eʸdy=e²−1. Saboda haka yankin R=2e²−(e²−1)=e²+1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s2.model.1: Da x=e², y yana daga 0 zuwa 2; yankin murabba'i 2e² ne, abin cirewa kuma ∫_0^2 eʸdy=e²−1. Yankin ya zama 2e²−e²+1=e²+1.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.prompt: Ana iya amfani da hanyar Soyul “idan za a iya rubuta lanƙwan da magana guda x=h(y).” Zaɓi duk lanƙwan da za a iya rubutawa haka a tazarar da aka bayar.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.hint.0: Ga kowace lanƙwa, ɗauki ƙimar y guda, ka ƙirga x nawa a tazarar suke da wannan y.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.hint.1: Duba ko zanen yana hawa da sauka a cikin tazarar (ko yana ƙaruwa kawai).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.a: Kowace ƙimar y tana dacewa da x biyu (x da −x). Ba za a iya rubuta ta da magana guda x=h(y) ba.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.b: Ka ga y ɗaya ka dace da x guda (x=ln y), saboda haka ana iya rubuta ta x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.c: Kowace ƙimar y tana da x biyu (x da π−x), don haka ba za a iya rubuta ta da magana guda x=h(y) ba.
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.r.d: Ka ga y ɗaya ka dace da x guda (x shi ne tushen kubik na y), don haka ana iya rubuta ta x=h(y).
n-m-h3-integc-08.s.s3.explain: y=eˣ (0≤x≤1) da y=x³ (−1≤x≤1) suna ƙaruwa a tazarorinsu, saboda haka kowane y yana da x guda (suna da ayyukan juyi). Ga y=x² ko y=sin x, x biyu ne ga y guda; ba za a rubuta su x=h(y) guda ba sai an raba tazara.

n-m-h3-vec-04.topic: Vektoci da lissafin siffa mai girma uku
n-m-h3-vec-04.title: Shin Kusurwar Tsakanin Layuka Daidai Take da Ta Tsakanin Vektocin Alkibla?
n-m-h3-vec-04.goal: Fahimci bambancin kusurwar vektocin alkibla da ta layuka ta hanyar gyara hukuncinka yayin ƙarin bayani, sannan ka yi amfani da tsarin daidai don kusurwar layuka.
n-m-h3-vec-04.material: Kana son nemo kusurwar θ tsakanin layuka biyu l da m a faifan ma'aunai. Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. (Ana karanta u·v 'u dot v', |u| girman u ne, √5 kuma ana karanta 'root 5'.)
n-m-h3-vec-04.thinking.1: Duba ko daraja iri ɗaya ce duk da zaɓin vektorin alkibla daban
n-m-h3-vec-04.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da ake buƙatar cikakkiyar daraja
n-m-h3-vec-04.prereq.0: Dot product na vektocin lebur da kusurwarsu
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane mataki, zaɓi hukunci ta amfani da abin da ka sani zuwa lokacin kawai.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.hint.0: Duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana, duba ko hukuncin baya yana nan daidai.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ga layi ɗaya, zaɓi vektorin alkibla na kishiya, yi lissafi iri ɗaya, ka kwatanta sakamako.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Ka zaɓi u=(1, 2) a matsayin vektorin alkiblar l da v=(1,−3) na m. Lissafin ya ba u·v=−5, |u|=√5, |v|=√10.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yaya za ka yanke hukunci kan kusurwar θ tsakanin layukan biyu?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Kusurwar tsakanin u da v tana da cos = −1/√2, wato 135°. Amma ba a tabbatar tukuna cewa wannan darajar za a iya ɗauka a matsayin kusurwar layukan ba.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka mayar da kusurwar vektocin biyu kai tsaye zuwa kusurwar layuka. Wannan shi ne hukunci na farko da ya zo rai.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Dole ne mu ƙara bincika ko wannan darajar da gaske tana bayyana kusurwar layukan, da ko tana nan iri ɗaya idan aka zaɓi vektocin alkibla dabam.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka tuna cewa vektorin alkibla ba daraja guda tabbatacciya ga kowane layi ba ne.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Tun da samfurin dot ɗin ba shi da kyau, abin da za mu iya cewa kawai shi ne layukan biyu ba su tsaye wa juna daidai ba.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka ce kawai ba su tsaye wa juna daidai ba. Ba ka tantance girman kusurwar ba.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Ko da ka ɗauki −v=(−1, 3) a matsayin vector ɗin alkiblar layi m maimakon v, layi m ɗin nan ɗaya ne.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Menene kusurwar da ke tsakanin u da −v, kuma wannan yana gaya mana me game da kusurwar θ tsakanin layukan?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Kusurwar da ke tsakanin u da v ita ce 135°, kuma ta tsakanin u da −v ita ce 45°. Ko da layuka guda biyu ne, ƙimar tana canzawa gwargwadon yadda aka zaɓi vector ɗin alkibla. Idan layuka biyu suka haɗu, ana samun kusurwoyi 45° da 135°, don haka muna buƙatar ƙa'ida ta zaɓar wacce za mu kira kusurwar da ke tsakanin layukan.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: u·(−v)=5 kuma cos=1/√2, saboda haka kusurwar ita ce 45°. Ga layuka guda ɗaya, ana samun kusurwoyi biyu, 135° da 45°, don haka alamar samfurin dot kaɗai ba ta tantance kusurwar da ke tsakanin layukan ba.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka duba kai tsaye cewa ƙimar tana canzawa gwargwadon zaɓin vector ɗin alkibla.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Samun 45° kuskuren lissafi ne, kuma 135° ce daidai.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Canza zuwa −v yana juya alamar samfurin dot, saboda haka cos ya zama +1/√2; wannan ba kuskure ba ne.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: u·(−v)=5 kuma kusurwar ita ce 45°, saboda haka 135° ɗin da aka samu a baya ba daidai ba ne, kuma kusurwar da ke tsakanin layukan ita ce 45°.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka yi daidai cewa an samu 45°, amma ka rasa cewa duka 135° da 45° sun fito ne daga layuka guda biyu. Muna buƙatar ƙa'ida ta zaɓar wacce za mu ɗauka a matsayin kusurwar da ke tsakanin layukan.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Mun yarda cewa kusurwar θ tsakanin layuka biyu ita ce ƙarama daga cikin nau'ikan kusurwoyi biyu da ake samu inda suka haɗu (45° da 135°), wato wadda ke da 0°<θ≤90°.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Wace dabara ce kullum take ba da θ komai yadda aka zaɓi vector ɗin alkibla?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.after: |u·v|=5, saboda haka cosθ=5/(√5·√10)=1/√2 kuma θ=45°. Dole ne a sami kusurwar da ke tsakanin layuka ta amfani da dabara da ke ɗaukar ƙimar cikakkiya ta samfurin dot, domin a samu ƙima ɗaya komai yadda aka zaɓi vector ɗin alkibla.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Alamar tana canzawa gwargwadon zaɓin vector ɗin alkibla, don haka ƙila ba za ta dace da ƙa'idar cewa θ tana tsakanin 0° da 90° ba.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Amfani da ƙimar cikakkiya ta samfurin dot yana ba da ƙima ɗaya ko da an juya vector ɗin alkibla, kuma cosθ≥0 ne, don haka θ ba ta wuce 90° ba.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan daidai ne ne kawai idan an yi amfani da −v; idan aka zaɓe shi ta wata hanya, alamar za ta bambanta, saboda haka wannan ba dabara ce da take daidai kullum ba.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s1.reflect: Da farko ka ɗauki kusurwar da ke tsakanin vector ɗin alkibla kai tsaye a matsayin kusurwar da ke tsakanin layukan, amma ra'ayinka ya canza sa’ad da aka ƙara bayanin cewa layi ɗaya yana da vector na alkibla biyu masu saɓanin juna. Kusurwar da ke tsakanin layuka dole ta zama ƙima da ba ta canzawa idan alamar vector ɗin alkibla ta juya, saboda haka muna samunta ta hanyar ɗaukar ƙimar cikakkiya ta samfurin dot.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.prompt: Vector ɗin alkiblar layi p shi ne (2, 1), kuma na layi q shi ne (1, −3). Nemo ƙimar cosθ ga kusurwar θ tsakanin layukan biyu, sannan ka rubuta a jimla ɗaya dalilin da ya sa dabara take buƙatar ƙimar cikakkiya.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo ƙimar samfurin dot da girman vector ɗin biyu, sannan ka saka su cikin dabara.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.hint.1: Yi lissafi iri ɗaya da (−1, 3), wato juyawar vector ɗin alkibla (1, −3), sannan ka gwada sakamakon.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.placeholder: misali, cosθ = ... Ana buƙatar ƙimar cikakkiya saboda ...
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka lissafa ƙimar u·v da girman vector ɗin biyu?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka kwatanta kusurwar da ake samu idan ka yi amfani da samfurin dot yadda yake lokacin da yake da alama mara kyau?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka danganta dalilin amfani da ƙimar cikakkiya da “yadda aka zaɓi vector ɗin alkibla”?
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.model.0: (2, 1)·(1, −3) = −1 kuma girman vector ɗin su ne √5 da √10, saboda haka cosθ = |−1|/(√5·√10) = 1/(5√2) ≈ 0.14. Idan muka juya vector ɗin alkibla, alamar samfurin dot tana canzawa, saboda haka muna buƙatar ƙimar cikakkiya domin a tantance kusurwar da ke tsakanin layukan ta hanya guda ɗaya tak.
n-m-h3-vec-04.s.s2.model.1: Samfurin dot ɗin shi ne −1, kuma |p|=√5, |q|=√10, saboda haka cosθ=1/√50=√2/10. Muna amfani da ƙimar cikakkiya domin mun amince cewa kusurwar da ke tsakanin layuka biyu ba ta wuce 90° ba, kuma muna son a samu ƙima ɗaya komai yadda aka zaɓi vector ɗin alkibla.

n-m-h3-dist-06.thinking.0: Sake duba hukuncinka yayin da bayanai suke ƙaruwa
n-m-h3-dist-06.title: Idan Ka Jefa Tsabar Kuɗi Sau da Yawa, Shin Kai Tsaye Rabin Zai Zama Fuskar Kai?
n-m-h3-dist-06.topic: Rarrabuwar yiwuwa: rarrabuwar binomial da yawan gwaje-gwaje
n-m-h3-dist-06.goal: Duba mataki-mataki yadda yiwuwar samun “daidai rabin” da yiwuwar samun “kusa da rabin” suke sauyawa dabam-dabam yayin da yawan gwaje-gwaje ke ƙaruwa, sannan ka sake duba tunaninka na farko.
n-m-h3-dist-06.material: Bari X ya zama yawan kawunan da aka samu idan aka jefa tsabar kuɗi mai adalci. Ana bayyana bayani ɗaya bayan ɗaya. (An nemo yiwuwar manyan yawan jefawa da kalkuleta.)
n-m-h3-dist-06.thinking.1: Bambance yiwuwar samun takamaiman ƙima da yiwuwar samun zangon ƙimomi
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.prompt: A kowane mataki, zaɓi hukunci bisa abin da ka sani zuwa lokacin.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.hint.0: Duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana, ka yi tunanin ko amsar tambaya ɗaya ya kamata ta sauya.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta a jere yiwuwar samun kawuna 4, 5, da 6 cikin jefawa 10, sannan ka duba yadda irin waɗannan ƙididdigar maƙwabta ke sauyawa yayin da yawan jefawa ke ƙaruwa.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kimanin wace yiwuwar ce za a samu kawuna daidai 5?
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.after: C(10,5)/2¹⁰=252/1024≈0.246. Ko da wannan ita ce ƙididdigar da ta fi yiwuwa, yiwuwarta kusan 25% ce kawai.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kusan 50%: domin rabin daidai ne sakamakon da ya fi zama dabi’a.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka yi tunanin cewa samun rabin ne ya fi zama dabi’a, saboda haka yiwuwarsa ya kamata ta zama 50%.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kusan 25%: domin ita ce ƙididdigar tsakiyar, amma tana raba yiwuwa da ƙididdigar maƙwabta kamar 4 da 6.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka ga cewa ko ƙididdigar tsakiyar da ta fi yiwuwa tana raba yiwuwar da ƙididdigarta maƙwabta.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kasa da 5%: domin samun ta daidai ba kasafai yake faruwa ba.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka yi tunanin cewa samun takamaiman ƙididdigar daidai ba kasafai yake faruwa ba.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.info: A wannan karon ka jefa tsabar kuɗin sau 100; tambayar ita ce yiwuwar samun kawuna daidai 50.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yaya wannan ya kwatanta da kusan 25% na jefawa 10?
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.after: C(100,50)/2¹⁰⁰≈0.080. Yayin da yawan jefawa ke ƙaruwa, yiwuwar samun “rabin daidai” a zahiri tana raguwa.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Tana raguwa: domin akwai ƙididdigar maƙwabta da yawa masu yiwuwar kama da ita.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka lura cewa ƙididdigar maƙwabta da yawa suna da yiwuwar kama da ta tsakiyar, saboda haka rabon ƙima guda ɗaya na tsakiyar yana raguwa.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Tana ƙaruwa: domin yayin da ake yawan jefawa, sakamakon yana ƙara kusantar rabin.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka yi tunanin cewa idan ana jefawa da yawa, rabin daidai zai ƙara fitowa.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Tana nan kusan iri ɗaya: domin har yanzu rabin da rabin ne.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka duba gaskiyar cewa rabin da rabin ne kawai, ba ka lura da tasirin sauyin yawan jefawa ba.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Yanzu tambayar ita ce yiwuwar cewa cikin jefawa 100, rabon kawuna yana tsakanin 40% da 60% har da iyakokin (kawuna 40 zuwa 60). Cikin jefawa 10, yiwuwar samun kawuna 4 zuwa 6 kusan 66% ce.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.ask: Me zai faru da wannan yiwuwar idan an jefa sau 100?
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.after: Yiwuwar samun kawuna 40 zuwa 60 kusan 0.965 ce. Yiwuwar samun daidai 50 ta ragu, amma yiwuwar sakamakon ya kasance kusa da rabin a zahiri tana ƙaruwa.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ƙasa da 66%: domin yiwuwar samun rabin daidai ma ta ragu.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka yi tunanin cewa da yake yiwuwar samun rabin daidai ta ragu, yiwuwar samun kusan rabin ma ta ragu.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Kusan 8%: domin yiwuwar jefawa 100 ta kasance 8%.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka rikita yiwuwar samun daidai 50 da yiwuwar zangon ƙimomi.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Fiye da 90%: domin sakamakon yana taruwa kusa da rabin.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka yi la’akari da jimillar yiwuwar zangon kusa da rabin, ba yiwuwar takamaiman ƙima ba.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s1.reflect: Da farko yana da sauƙi a yi tunanin cewa “yayin da ake ƙara jefawa, rabin daidai zai ƙara fitowa.” Amma yawan jefawa yana ƙaruwa, yiwuwar samun rabin daidai tana raguwa, alhali yiwuwar rabon kawuna ya kasance kusa da rabin tana ƙaruwa. Dole ne a bambance “takamaiman ƙima” da “zango”.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta yadda yiwuwar samun rabin kawuna daidai da yiwuwar samun sakamako kusa da rabin kowannensu ke sauyawa yayin da yawan jefawa ke ƙaruwa. Idan ra’ayinka ya bambanta da na farko, ka haɗa shi ma.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta a jere yiwuwar samun “rabin daidai” cikin jefawa 10 da kuma jefawa 100.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta yadda yiwuwar samun “kusa da rabin” ta bambanta tsakanin yanayin biyun.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: idan aka kwatanta da jefawa 10, a jefawa 100 yiwuwar samun rabin daidai ...
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka kwatanta ƙimomin yiwuwar a yanayin biyun?
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bambance yiwuwar takamaiman ƙima da yiwuwar zangon ƙimomi?
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka faɗi yadda ra’ayinka na farko ya sauya?
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.model.0: Yayin da yawan jefawa ke ƙaruwa, yiwuwar samun kawuna daidai rabin tana sauka daga kusan 25% cikin jefawa 10 zuwa kusan 8% cikin jefawa 100. Amma yiwuwar samun sakamako kusa da rabin tana ƙaruwa: cikin jefawa 100, yiwuwar samun kawuna 40 zuwa 60 ta wuce 96%.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.model.1: Da farko na yi tunanin cewa yawan jefa tsabar kuɗi zai kawo rabin daidai, amma wannan ba daidai ba ne. Yiwuwar rabin daidai tana raguwa, alhali yiwuwar rabon kawuna ya taru kusa da rabin tana ƙaruwa.
n-m-h3-dist-06.s.s2.model.2: Yayin da ake ƙara yawan jefawa, rabon sakamako guda na rabin daidai yana raguwa, amma yiwuwar samun sakamako kusa da rabin tana ƙaruwa.

n-m-h3-serieslim-02.topic: Jerin lissafi: jimlolin ɓangare da jerin geometric marar iyaka
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.title: Duba Mafita da Ta Nemo Babban Sharaɗi Daga Tsarin Jimillar Ɓangare
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.goal: Koyi cewa dole ne a nemo a_1 dabam lokacin nemo babban sharaɗi daga jimillar ɓangare S_n, gyara mafita kuskure, sannan ka tabbatar ta amfani da jimillar lim S_n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.material: Jimillar sharuɗɗan farko n na jerin ita ce S_n = 4 − 3·(1/2)^(n−1). Karanta mafitar Minjae don nemo jimillar jerin. ((1/2)^(n−1) yana nufin rabin ɗaya a ƙarfin n−1.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.thinking.0: Nemo layin farko da aka yi kuskure a mafita
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.thinking.1: Duba iyakar da tsarin yake aiki (n≥2)
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.thinking.2: Tabbatar ta wata hanya (iyakar jimlolin ɓangare)
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.thinking.3: Nemo sharadin da zai sa tsarin ya dace da n=1 ma
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.prereq.1: Tsarin jimillar jerin geometric marar iyaka
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko da ba daidai ba a mafitar Minjae.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.hint.0: Duba layi-layi ko kowane layi yana biyo baya daga wanda ya gabata da gaske.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta ko sharadin (iyakar n) da aka yi amfani da shi wajen samo tsari ya ci gaba da kasancewa a layi na gaba.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.0: Jimillar jerin ita ce lim S_n, kuma idan n≥2, a_n=S_n−S_(n−1).
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.2: Da aka ɗauka wannan tsarin ya dace da n=1 ma, sa a_n = 3·(1/2)^(n−1) ga duk n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.line.3: Wannan jerin geometric marar iyaka ne mai sharaɗin farko 3 da ma'aunin gama gari 1/2, saboda haka jimilla ita ce 3/(1−1/2) = 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne. Ana amfani da S_n−S_(n−1) ne kawai idan n≥2, saboda haka sai an duba dabam ko tsarin da aka samu ya dace da n=1. A nan a_1=S_1=4−3=1, amma saka n=1 cikin tsarin yana ba da 3, wanda ya bambanta. Layi na 1 da 2 daidai ne, kuma layi na 4 sakamako ne na layi na 3.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.prompt: Gyara mafitar Minjae ka nemo jimillar jerin. Sannan nemo ainihin a_1 kai tsaye, kwatanta da darajar Minjae, ka bayyana dalilin sauyin jimilla.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo iyakar S_n kai tsaye, ka kwatanta da darajar Minjae.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.hint.1: Saka cikin tsarin domin nemo a_1 daga S_1, sannan ka kwatanta da darajar da aka samu idan aka saka n=1 a babban tsarin sharaɗin Minjae.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka duba ko tsarin da aka samu ga n≥2 ya dace da n=1?
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka sake tabbatar da jimilla ta lim S_n?
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.0: a_1=S_1=4−3=1. Amma idan aka saka n=1 cikin 3·(1/2)^(n−1), ana samun 3, saboda haka a_1 ya bambanta. a_1=1, daga n≥2 kuwa sharaɗin shi ne 3·(1/2)^(n−1). Jimillar ita ce 1+(3/2)/(1−1/2)=1+3=4, wadda kuma ta yi daidai da lim S_n=4.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.1: Sharaɗin farko S_1=1 ne, ba 3 na babban tsarin ba. Daga n=2, sharaɗin farko 3/2 ne kuma ma'aunin gama gari 1/2, don haka ɓangaren nan 3/2÷(1/2)=3 ne; idan aka ƙara 1, jimilla 4 ce.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.2: Idan aka ɗauki iyakar S_n kai tsaye, 4−0=4 ne; 6 da Minjae ya rubuta ya ƙara 3 bisa kuskure domin ya ɗauki a_1=3. Ainihin a_1=S_1=1 ne.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s2.model.3: lim S_n=4. a_1=S_1=1, amma Minjae ya ɗauka 3 ne. Saboda haka amsar daidai 4 ce, ba 6 ba.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.prompt: Ga kowane S_n a ƙasa, zaɓi wanda babban tsarin sharaɗin da aka samu ga n≥2 yake aiki yadda yake a n=1 ma.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.hint.0: Ga kowane tsari, nemo S_1, ka kwatanta da darajar da aka samu idan aka saka n=1 cikin tsarin da aka samu daga S_n−S_(n−1).
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.hint.1: Ga kowane tsari, saka darajoji daban-daban na n cikin S_n ka kwatanta, sannan ka nemi abin da tsarin da S_1 ɗinsu ya yi daidai da a_1 suke tarayya.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.a: Wannan jerin Minjae ne. a_1=1 amma tsarin ya ba da 3, don haka bai yi daidai ba.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.b: a_1=S_1=1 ne, amma saka n=1 cikin tsarin 2·(1/2)^(n−1) da ya dace da n≥2 yana ba da 2; bai yi daidai ba.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.c: a_1=S_1=3 ne; saka n=1 cikin tsarin 3·(1/2)^(n−1) da ya dace da n≥2 ma yana ba da 3, don haka sun yi daidai.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.r.d: a_1=S_1=7/2 ne, amma saka n=1 cikin tsarin 3·(1/2)^n na n≥2 yana ba da 3/2, don haka ba su yi daidai ba.
n-m-h3-serieslim-02.s.s3.explain: Idan saka n=0 cikin tsarin S_n ya ba S_0=0 (c: 6−6=0), tsarin yana aiki a n=1 ma. Ga sauran kuwa, S_0 su ne −2, −1, 2, saboda haka dole ne a nemo a_1 dabam.

n-m-h3-serieslim-05.topic: Jerin lissafi: jimlolin ɓangare da jerin geometric marar iyaka
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.prompt: A kowane mataki yi hukunci bisa abin da ka sani a lokacin.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.title: Idan x=0 ne, jimillar jerin tana amfani da wannan tsari ɗaya ne?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.goal: Ga jerin geometric wanda ma'aunin gama gari yake canjawa da x, bincika iyakar da tsarin jimilla ke aiki, sannan ka bayyana cewa lissafi dabam a x=0 yana nuna jimillar a wannan wurin ta bambanta.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.material: Ga lambar gaske x, a sa f(x)=x²+x²/(1+x²)+x²/(1+x²)²+x²/(1+x²)³+…. (Jeri ne mai sharaɗin farko x², inda ake ninka kowane sharaɗi na gaba da 1/(1+x²).) Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.thinking.0: Gyara hukunci yayin da bayanai ke ƙaruwa
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.thinking.1: Duba sharadin amfani da tsari (sharaɗin farko ≠ 0)
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.thinking.2: Gwada ta maye gurbin darajar iyaka kai tsaye
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.hint.0: Duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana, sake duba ko tsarin da ka yi amfani da shi baya yana aiki yadda yake.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.hint.1: Saka x=0 kai tsaye ka rubuta sharuɗɗan farko.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wane tsari kake tsammanin f(x) yake da shi ga kowace lambar gaske x?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.after: x²/(1−1/(1+x²))=1+x² tsari ne da aka samu bayan soke. Ka tuna akwai x da x² ɗin da aka soke yake 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: f(x)=1+x²: domin waɗannan darajoji biyu sun dace da 1+x²
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka shimfiɗa tsarin da ya dace da maki biyu zuwa duk x. Wannan shi ne hukunci na farko da ya zo rai.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: f(x)=1+x², amma dole ne a bincika daban x ɗin da ma'aunin gama gari yake na musamman
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kana shakkar ko sakamakon maki biyu ya shafi kowace x.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: f(x)=x²+1/x²: domin wani tsari kuma na iya dacewa da darajojin biyun
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: A x=1 yana ba 2, amma a x=2 yana ba 4.25, saboda haka bai dace da ɗaya daga darajojin ba. Ba ka saka darajoji don bincika tsarin ba.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Yanzu ka yi la'akari da x=0. Saka x=0 kai tsaye cikin tsarin ma'anar f.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.after: f(0)=0. Ko da ma'aunin gama gari ya zama 1, idan sharaɗin farko 0 ne, duk jimlolin ɓangare 0 ne, saboda haka yana haɗuwa zuwa 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 1: sabab urang bisa ngasupkeun x=0 kana rumus 1+x²
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Anjeun langsung nerapkeun rumus anu dicokot pikeun x≠0 kana x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 0: sabab unggal suku 0, jadi sakabéh jumlah parsialna 0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Anjeun ngamimitian tina wangenan jeung ngitung jumlah parsialna langsung.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Teu bisa ditangtukeun: sabab rasio umumna 1, jadi runtuyan éta divergen
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Anjeun nyangka rasio umum 1 salawasna divergen. Anjeun teu merhatikeun kaayaan suku kahijina 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Kasimpulanana, f(x)=1+x² lamun x≠0, jeung f(0)=0 lamun x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Pernyataan mana anu bener ngeunaan limit f(x) nalika x→0 jeung kontinuitas di x=0?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Unggal suku kontinyu, tapi jumlah f pegat di x=0. Pikeun jumlah tanpa wates, “lamun unggal suku kontinyu, jumlahna kontinyu” teu salawasna bener.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Limitna 1 jeung f(0)=0, jadi f henteu kontinyu di x=0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Anjeun nangtukeun kontinuitas ku ngabandingkeun nilai limit jeung nilai fungsi.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Unggal suku mangrupa fungsi kontinyu, jadi jumlah f kontinyu pikeun sakabéh x
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Anjeun langsung nerapkeun sipat anu lumaku pikeun jumlah aya watesna kana jumlah tanpa wates.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Limit jeung f(0) duanana 0, jadi f kontinyu di x=0
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Anjeun teu mariksa nilai rumus 1+x² pikeun x≠0 nalika x→0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s1.reflect: Mimitina anjeun rék ngagunakeun rumus anu cocog jeung dua titik pikeun sakabéh x, tapi pamadegan anjeun robah sanggeus mariksa sarat x²≠0 anu dipaké dina panyederhanaan. Nalika ngagunakeun rumus, uji langsung dina nilai wates naha sarat lumakuna rumus éta kacumponan dina kasus ieu.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.prompt: Unggal suku x²/(1+x²)^n mangrupa fungsi kontinyu tina x. Tuliskeun nilai f(0) nalika x=0, jeung bédana ti rumus 1+x² pikeun x≠0, katut alesanana.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.hint.0: Gantikeun x=0 langsung kana rumus pangwangen f, tuluy tuliskeun sababaraha suku kahiji.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.hint.1: Nalika ngagunakeun rumus jumlah runtuyan géométris, pariksa naha aya kaayaan anu ngajadikeun pangbagina 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Naha anjeun bener-bener ngagantikeun x=0 jeung nuliskeun sababaraha suku kahiji?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Naha anjeun mikirkeun naha rumus pikeun x≠0 bisa dipaké dina x=0?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Naha anjeun nyebutkeun yén sanajan unggal suku kontinyu, jumlahna bisa jadi henteu kontinyu?
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.0: Lamun x=0, unggal suku 0²/1^n=0, jadi f(0)=0. Tapi lamun x≠0, f(x)=1+x², jadi deukeut x=0 nilaina deukeut ka 1. Ku kituna limit 1 béda jeung f(0)=0, sarta f henteu kontinyu di x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.1: Lamun x=0 diasupkeun, rasio umumna jadi 1, tapi unggal suku mimitian ti suku kahiji nyaéta 0, jadi jumlahna 0. Ieu béda ti 1, nyaéta hasil ngasupkeun 0 kana 1+x², sarta f pegat di x=0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.2: Rumus 1+x² ngan dipaké lamun x≠0. Lamun x=0, sakabéh sukuna 0 jadi jumlahna 0, béda ti 1+0²=1; ku kituna fungsi henteu nyambung dina titik éta.
n-m-h3-serieslim-05.s.s2.model.3: Lamun x=0, rasio umumna jadi 1 jadi rumus éta teu bisa dipaké; unggal suku 0, ku kituna f(0)=0. Ieu béda ti 1 anu dicokot ku ngasupkeun 0 kana 1+x².

n-m-h3-serieslim-06.topic: Jerin lissafi: jimlolin ɓangare da jerin geometric marar iyaka
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.ok.c1: Cikakkiyar darajar ma'aunin gama gari ta gaza 1, don haka jerin yana haɗuwa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.title: Runtuyan géométris taya wates anu suku kahijina leuwih gedé tibatan jumlahna
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.goal: Jieun conto runtuyan géométris taya wates anu jumlahna 6 jeung suku kahijina leuwih gedé ti 6, tuluy jéntrékeun kumaha tanda rasio umum ngajadikeun jumlah parsial leuwih luhur jeung leuwih handap batan jumlahna.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.material: Anggap runtuyan géométris taya wates a + ar + ar² + …, kalayan suku kahiji a jeung rasio umum r, jumlahna 6. Gampang nyangka, “Jumlahna 6, jadi suku kahijina kudu kurang ti 6.”
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.thinking.0: Nyieun sorangan conto anu nyumponan sarat pikeun néangan pola
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.thinking.1: Mastikeun hubungan ukuran antara jumlah jeung jumlah parsial ku sababaraha kasus
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.prereq.0: Jumlah runtuyan géométris taya wates a/(1−r)
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.prompt: Jieun runtuyan géométris taya wates anu jumlahna 6 jeung suku kahiji a leuwih gedé ti 6, sarta pilih n (bilangan asli ti 1 nepi ka 9) sangkan jumlah parsial S_n-na leuwih gedé ti 6. Eusian a, r, n. Jieun tilu conto kalayan (r, n) anu béda. (S_n nyaéta jumlah ti suku kahiji nepi ka suku ka-n.)
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.hint.0: Tulis heula persamaan antara a jeung r sangkan jumlahna 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.hint.1: Sanggeus milih r tina persamaan éta, pariksa naha a leuwih gedé ti 6; lamun henteu, robah tanda atawa gedéna r.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.hint.2: Kalayan r anu dipilih, itung langsung S_1, S_2, S_3 tuluy pilih n anu jumlahna leuwih gedé ti 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.var.n: n anu ngajadikeun S_n leuwih gedé ti 6
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.fail.c1: |r|<1 teu kacumponan, jadi runtuyan ieu teu boga jumlah.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.fail.c3: Suku kahijina henteu leuwih gedé ti 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.ok.c4: Dina n ieu, S_n=6(1−r^n) leuwih gedé ti 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.fail.c4: Dina n ieu, S_n henteu leuwih gedé ti 6. Itung langsung S_1, S_2, S_3 tuluy bandingkeun jeung 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s1.explain: Kusabab a=6(1−r), a>6 merlukeun r<0. Terus S_n=6(1−r^n), jadi sangkan S_n leuwih gedé ti 6 perlu r^n<0, nyaéta n kudu ganjil. Contona, lamun a=9 jeung r=−1/2, S_1=9 jeung S_3=6(1+1/8)=6.75 leuwih gedé ti 6, ari S_2=4.5 leuwih leutik. r=−1 teu meunang sabab |r|<1 teu kacumponan, sarta a=8, r=−1/2 jumlahna 8/1.5≈5.33.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.prompt: Pilih sakabéh hal anu kudu bener pikeun runtuyan géométris taya wates anu jumlahna 6 jeung suku kahijina leuwih gedé ti 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.hint.0: Susun dina tabél hal-hal anu sarua tina conto anu dijieun dina léngkah saméméhna.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.hint.1: Itung S_1, S_2, S_3 tina conto anjeun, tuluy bandingkeun naha unggal-unggalna leuwih luhur atawa leuwih handap ti 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.o.a: S_2 salawasna leuwih gedé ti 6, sarua jeung S_1
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.r.a: S_1 leuwih gedé ti 6, tapi suku kadua négatif, jadi S_2 leuwih leutik ti S_1. Dina conto a=9, r=−1/2, S_2=4.5.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.o.b: Sakabéh suku positif sarta terus ngurangan
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.r.b: Sangkan suku kahiji leuwih gedé ti jumlahna, kudu aya suku anu négatif. Lamun sakabéh suku positif, jumlahna moal bisa leuwih leutik tibatan suku kahiji.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.r.c: Rasio umumna négatif jeung suku kahijina positif, jadi suku kadua ar négatif.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.o.d: Jumlah parsial anu leuwih gedé ti 6 jeung anu leuwih leutik ti 6 silih gentian
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.r.d: S_n=6(1−r^n) jeung r<0, jadi tanda r^n silih gentian, sarta tanda S_n−6=−6r^n ogé silih gentian.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s2.explain: Kusabab r<0, suku kadua négatif, sarta dina S_n=6−6r^n tanda bédana ti 6, nyaéta −6r^n, silih gentian. Ku kituna S_2 kurang ti 6, jeung mustahil sakabéh suku positif.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.prompt: Jelaskeun naha runtuyan géométris taya wates anu jumlahna 6 bisa boga suku kahiji leuwih gedé ti 6. Lebetkeun ogé kumaha gumantungna gedé-leutik S_n ti 6 kana n.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.hint.0: Paké salah sahiji conto anu dijieun di luhur, itung S_1, S_2, S_3 sarta bandingkeun jeung 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.hint.1: Tulis S_n dina wangun a jeung r, tuluy pikirkeun tanda bédana jeung jumlah 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Naha anjeun ngitung S_1, S_2, S_3 tina conto anu dijieun?
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Naha anjeun ngahubungkeun tanda rasio umum jeung paripolah jumlah parsial?
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Naha anjeun ngabandingkeun jeung kaayaan nalika sakabéh suku positif?
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.model.0: Lamun rasio umumna négatif, tanda suku-sukuna silih gentian. Lamun suku kahiji leuwih gedé ti 6, S_1 leuwih gedé ti 6, sedengkeun suku kadua négatif, jadi S_2 kurang ti 6. Ku kituna jumlah parsial silih naék jeung turun ngurilingan 6 bari beuki ngadeukeutan ka 6.
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.model.1: Jumlahna 6 henteu hartina suku kahiji kudu kurang ti 6. Lamun r négatif, S_n=6(1−r^n), jadi n ganjil nilaina leuwih luhur ti 6, ari n genap leuwih handap. Ku kituna nilaina naék-turun bari konvergén kana 6. (jumlahna 6)
n-m-h3-serieslim-06.s.s3.model.2: Ngan lamun suku-sukuna positif jumlah parsialna leuwih handap ti jumlah runtuyan. Lamun rasio umum négatif, jumlah parsial sababaraha kali ngaleuwihan 6 tuluy turun deui, jadi suku kahiji bisa leuwih gedé tibatan jumlahna.

n-m-h3-serieslim-07.topic: Jerin lissafi: jimlolin ɓangare da jerin geometric marar iyaka
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.title: Iraha runtuyan jumlah tina dua runtuyan konvergén?
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.goal: Tangtukeun kombinasi nalika konvergénsi Σ(a_n+b_n) bisa dipastikeun tina konvergénsi Σa_n jeung Σb_n, sarta nalika teu bisa dipastikeun; tuluy jieun conto bantahan.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.material: Aya dua runtuyan taya wates Σa_n jeung Σb_n, sarta rék dipikanyaho naha runtuyan Σ(a_n+b_n), anu dijieun ku ngajumlahkeun unggal suku, konvergén atawa divergen. Gumantung kana informasi anu aya, hasilna kadang bisa ditangtukeun, kadang henteu.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.thinking.1: Nunjukkeun kasus anu teu bisa ditangtukeun ku conto bantahan
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.prereq.1: Jumlah jeung kelipatan konstanta tina runtuyan konvergén
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.prompt: Pilih sakabéh informasi anu bisa nangtukeun sacara pasti naha Σ(a_n+b_n) konvergén atawa divergen.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.hint.0: Pikeun unggal informasi, pikirkeun dua pasangan a_n, b_n anu béda tapi nyumponan éta, tuluy pariksa naha runtuyan jumlahna méré hasil anu sarua.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.hint.1: Pikirkeun naha nambahkeun atawa ngurangan runtuyan konvergén bisa ngajadikeun runtuyan divergen jadi konvergén.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.a: Jumlah dua runtuyan konvergén ogé konvergén, jadi hasilna bisa ditangtukeun.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.b: Lamun a_n=b_n=1 hasilna divergen, tapi lamun a_n=1, b_n=−1 runtuyan jumlahna konvergén, jadi teu bisa ditangtukeun.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.c: Lamun Σa_n anu konvergén dikurangan, sésana Σb_n. Jadi lamun runtuyan jumlahna konvergén, Σb_n ogé kudu konvergén; ku kituna runtuyan jumlahna divergen.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.o.d: a_n jeung b_n duanana konvergén ka 0
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.r.d: Lamun a_n=b_n=1/n, runtuyan jumlahna divergen; lamun a_n=1/n², b_n=1/n², runtuyan éta konvergén. Jadi teu bisa ditangtukeun.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s1.explain: Lamun duanana konvergén, runtuyan jumlahna konvergén; lamun ngan hiji anu konvergén, runtuyan jumlahna divergen (sabab lamun konvergén, Σb_n=Σ(a_n+b_n)−Σa_n ogé kudu konvergén). Lamun duanana divergen, atawa suku-sukuna ngadeukeutan ka 0, éta waé teu cukup pikeun nangtukeun.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.prompt: Tuduhkeun kasus anu informasina teu cukup. Candak a_n=p·r^n, b_n=q·r^n (p≠0, q≠0, |r|≥1); mangka Σa_n jeung Σb_n duanana divergen. Eusian p, q, r dua kali, ku nilai r anu béda, sangkan Σ(a_n+b_n) konvergén.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.hint.0: Kelompokkeun a_n+b_n dumasar kana r^n, tuluy pikirkeun sabaraha koéfisiénna sangkan runtuyan éta konvergén.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.hint.1: Panggihan cara sangkan koéfisiénna 0 bari tetep nyumponan sarat yén p jeung q duanana lain 0.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Suku umum Σa_n jeung Σb_n lain 0, jadi duanana divergen.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.fail.c1: p atawa q sarua jeung 0, jadi salah sahiji runtuyan henteu divergen.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.ok.c2: |r|≥1, jadi suku umumna henteu ngadeukeutan ka 0, sarta duanana divergen.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.fail.c3: (p+q)r^n lain 0, jadi runtuyan jumlahna ogé divergen.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s2.explain: Kusabab a_n+b_n=(p+q)r^n, lamun p+q=0 unggal suku 0, jadi runtuyan jumlahna konvergén ka 0. Tapi lamun p≠0 jeung |r|≥1, a_n jeung b_n henteu ngadeukeutan ka 0, jadi masing-masing divergen. Lamun p=q=1, runtuyan jumlahna ogé divergen, ari lamun |r|<1 unggal runtuyan konvergén.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.prompt: Jelaskeun naha pernyataan “lamun Σa_n jeung Σb_n duanana divergen, mangka Σ(a_n+b_n) ogé divergen” téh salah. Paké conto tina léngkah saméméhna, tuluy tuliskeun sarat pikeun misahkeun runtuyan jumlah jadi jumlah dua runtuyan.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.hint.0: Tuliskeun a_n+b_n pikeun conto anu diasupkeun dina léngkah saméméhna.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.hint.1: Pikirkeun naha unggal bagian kudu boga nilai nalika jumlahna dipisahkeun.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Naha anjeun ngitung sorangan a_n+b_n pikeun conto dina léngkah saméméhna?
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Naha anjeun nyebutkeun sarat anu diperlukeun pikeun misahkeunana?
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Naha anjeun ngajelaskeun naon anu bisa kajadian lamun dua runtuyan divergen dihijikeun?
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.model.0: Sanajan duanana divergen, saperti Σa_n kalawan p·r^n jeung Σb_n kalawan −p·r^n, lamun dijumlahkeun unggal sukuna jadi 0, jadi konvergén. Ku kituna lamun duanana divergen, konvergén henteuna runtuyan jumlah teu bisa ditangtukeun. Pikeun misahkeun jadi Σa_n+Σb_n, duanana kudu konvergén.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.model.1: Aya conto bantahan. Lamun a_n=2^n jeung b_n=−2^n, duanana divergen, tapi a_n+b_n=0, jadi runtuyan jumlahna konvergén ka 0. Ku kituna Σ(a_n+b_n)=Σa_n+Σb_n ngan bisa dipaké lamun duanana runtuyan konvergén.
n-m-h3-serieslim-07.s.s3.model.2: Jumlah dua runtuyan divergen bisa konvergén lantaran silih mupus (1 jeung −1 jadi 0), atawa divergen lamun tandana sarua. Jadi saméméh misahkeun, pariksa heula naha unggal runtuyan konvergén.

n-m-h3-serieslim-08.topic: Jerin lissafi: jimlolin ɓangare da jerin geometric marar iyaka
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.title: Ngagunakeun tabél jumlah parsial pikeun nangtukeun itungan mana anu bener
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.goal: Pilah klaim anu salah maké angka jumlah parsial, téangan jumlah runtuyan téléskopik ku nangtukeun suku anu nyésa sacara pasti, tuluy jéntrékeun pola lamun jarakna robah.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.material: Dua babaturan méré hasil béda pikeun jumlah runtuyan 1/(1·3) + 1/(2·4) + 1/(3·5) + … + 1/(n(n+2)) + …. Jiho: “Sukuna silih mupus ti hareup jeung tukang, jadi jumlahna 1/2.” Seoa: “Jumlahna 3/4.” Tina kalkulator, jumlah parsialna nyaéta S_1=0.333, S_2=0.458, S_3=0.525, S_4=0.567, S_5=0.595.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.thinking.2: Ngarobah wangun (pecahan parsial) pikeun nembongkeun strukturna
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.thinking.3: Ngalegaan pola kana jarak anu béda
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.prompt: Pilih kacindekan anu pangdipercaya tina tabél jumlah parsial wungkul.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.hint.0: Lamun sakabéh suku positif, pariksa naha jumlah parsialna ngan nambahan atawa bisa ogé ngurangan.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.hint.1: Bandingkeun angka dina tabél jeung dua nilai anu diklaim, pariksa naha salah sahijina geus kaliwatan.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.o.a: Seoa bener: jumlah parsial terus nambahan sarta ngadeukeutan ka 3/4
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.r.a: Anjeun nyimpulkeun 3/4 ngan tina kanyataan yén nilaina nambahan. Padahal nilaina bisa waé nambahan ka angka séjén.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.o.b: Jiho salah: jumlah parsial ngan nambahan, sarta S_3 geus ngaleuwihan 1/2
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.r.b: Anjeun ngagunakeun kanyataan yén sakabéh suku positif, jadi S_n henteu ngurangan, pikeun nolak 1/2.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.o.c: Jiho bener: jumlah parsial siga nu ngurilingan 1/2
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.r.c: Ti S_3 satuluyna, nilaina geus ngaleuwihan 1/2. Anjeun teu maca tabél nepi ka ahir.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.o.d: Tina tabél wungkul, urang teu bisa nangtukeun Jiho atawa Seoa anu bener
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.r.d: Sanajan jumlahna teu bisa dipastikeun, urang bisa nolak 1/2.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s1.explain: Sakabéh suku positif, jadi S_n ngan nambahan. S_3=0.525 geus leuwih gedé ti 1/2, jadi jumlahna moal bisa 1/2. Tina tabél wungkul, klaim Seoa 3/4 teu bisa dipastikeun, jadi urang kudu néangan langsung.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.prompt: Paké 1/(n(n+2))=½(1/n−1/(n+2)) pikeun nuliskeun S_n; sebutkeun sacara pasti suku mana anu nyésa sanggeus nu séjén silih mupus, tuluy téangan jumlah runtuyan. Jelaskeun ogé naha suku éta nyésa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.hint.0: Kembangkeun kurungna, sajajarkeun 5 atawa 6 suku munggaran dina hiji jajar, tuluy corét pasangan anu silih mupus.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.hint.1: Itung sabaraha suku anu teu kapupus.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Naha anjeun bener-bener ngamekarkeun jeung nuliskeun sababaraha suku kahiji?
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Naha anjeun ngajelaskeun naha aya dua suku anu nyésa?
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Naha anjeun manggihan jumlahna ku ngagunakeun limit S_n?
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.model.0: Dina S_n=½{(1−1/3)+(1/2−1/4)+(1/3−1/5)+…}, ti 1/3 unggal suku dipupus ku suku dua posisi saterusna, ari 1 jeung 1/2 di awal sarta −1/(n+1) jeung −1/(n+2) di tungtung nyésa. S_n=½(1+1/2−1/(n+1)−1/(n+2)) sarta limitna ½·3/2=3/4.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.model.1: Sukuna boga jarak dua posisi, jadi dua suku kahiji, 1 jeung 1/2, teu boga pasangan pikeun mupus. Dua suku panungtung ngadeukeutan ka 0 nalika n→∞, jadi jumlahna ½(1+½)=3/4.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.model.2: Kusabab S_n=½(3/2−1/(n+1)−1/(n+2)), nilaina konvergén ka 3/4 nalika n ngagedéan. Lantaran dua suku kahiji 1 jeung 1/2 nyésa, anu diasupkeun kana kurung téh 3/2, lain 1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s2.model.3: Suku awal 1 jeung 1/2 teu kapupus. Jumlahna 3/4
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.prompt: Lamun métode anu sarua dipaké kana runtuyan 1/(1·4) + 1/(2·5) + 1/(3·6) + … + 1/(n(n+3)) + …, sabaraha jumlahna?
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.hint.0: Téangan heula rumus anu nulis 1/(n(n+3)) minangka bédana dua pecahan.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.hint.1: Idan bambancin ya zama wurare 3, ƙirga sharuɗɗan farko nawa ba su soke ba.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.r.a: Wannan yanayi ne inda 1 na farko kaɗai ya rage. Idan tazarar 3 ce, sharuɗɗa 3 na farko suna ragewa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.r.b: Wannan yanayi ne inda sharuɗɗan farko biyu kaɗai suka rage. Idan tazarar 3 ce, sharuɗɗa uku ne suke ragewa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.r.c: 1/(n(n+3))=⅓(1/n−1/(n+3)), sharuɗɗan da suka rage kuma 1, 1/2, 1/3 ne, don haka ⅓(1+1/2+1/3)=11/18.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.r.d: Wannan yanayi ne inda sharuɗɗa huɗu na farko suka rage. Yawan sharuɗɗan da suka rage 3 ne, daidai da tazarar.
n-m-h3-serieslim-08.s.s3.explain: Idan tazarar k ce, 1/(n(n+k))=(1/k)(1/n−1/(n+k)), sharuɗɗan farko k kuma 1, 1/2,…, 1/k ne suke ragewa. Jimillar (1/k)(1+1/2+…+1/k) ce. Ga k=2, 3/4 ne; ga k=3, 11/18.

n-m-h3-est-03.prereq.0: Ma’anar jama’ar bincike da samfurin bincike
n-m-h3-est-03.title: Binciken mutane 900 ko binciken bazuwar mutane 60: wanne ya kamata ka amince da shi?
n-m-h3-est-03.topic: Ƙiyasta ƙididdiga: son zuciya a binciken samfurin.
n-m-h3-est-03.goal: Bambanta samfurin da yake da yawa da samfurin da yake wakiltar yawan jama'a, kuma ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa son zuciyar da hanyar zaɓen samfurin ke haifarwa ba ya gushewa idan girman samfurin ya ƙaru.
n-m-h3-est-03.material: Kana son gano matsakaicin lokacin karatu na yau da kullum na duk ɗalibai 1200 a wata makaranta. Hanya A ta saka hanyar haɗin bincike a shafin yanar gizon makarantar, ta ɗauki matsakaicin ɗalibai 900 da suka amsa da kansu: sa'o'i 3.1. Hanya B ta tambayi ɗalibai 60 da aka zaɓa ta lambobin bazuwar daga jerin ɗalibai, kuma duk sun amsa: matsakaicin sa'o'i 2.4 ne.
n-m-h3-est-03.thinking.0: Kimanta girman samfurin da hanyar zaɓensa dabam-dabam.
n-m-h3-est-03.thinking.1: Gano son zuciya daga hanyar zaɓe kamar amsa da son rai.
n-m-h3-est-03.thinking.2: Yi hukunci kan ƙarfin shaida ka kuma bayyana dalilinsa.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi binciken da ya fi aminci wajen ƙiyasta matsakaicin lokacin karatun dukkan ɗalibai.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kwatanta ko a kowace hanya kowane ɗalibi a makarantar yana da dama iri ɗaya ta shiga samfurin.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.hint.1: Yi tunani ta amfani da misali ko 'samfurin yana da yawa' da 'samfurin yana wakiltar dukkan ɗalibai' suna nufin abu ɗaya.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.o.a: B: domin an zaɓe shi daga jerin ta amfani da lambobin bazuwar, don haka kowane ɗalibi yana da dama iri ɗaya.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.o.b: A: domin samfurin 900 ya fi girma sosai, don haka matsakaicin samfurin yana kusa da matsakaicin yawan jama'a.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.r.b: Gaskiya ne cewa samfurin da ya fi girma yana rage yaɗuwar da sa'a ke haddasawa. Amma idan waɗanda suka shiga samfurin sun karkata ta wata hanya, wannan son zuciya ba ya raguwa da girman samfurin.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.o.c: Ba za a iya amfani da ɗayansu ba: domin wasu ɗalibai ne kawai, ba duka ba, aka bincika.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.r.c: Binciken samfurin hanya ce ta ƙiyasta duka daga wani ɓangare. Abin tambaya shi ne ko yadda aka zaɓi ɓangaren yana wakiltar yawan jama'a.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.o.d: Yi amfani da su duka: kawai ka ɗauki matsakaicin matsakaitan biyun, 3.1 da 2.4.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.r.d: Haɗa bayanan da ke da son zuciya da wasu bayanai yana barin son zuciyar a ciki. Da farko dole ne ka tambayi waɗanne bayanai ne ke wakiltar yawan jama'a.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s1.explain: A binciken yanar gizon, ɗaliban da ke da sha'awa ko lokaci ne ke amsawa da kansu, don haka damar zaɓen kowane mutum daga cikin yawan jama'a ta bambanta. Irin wannan son zuciyar zaɓe ba ya ɓacewa ko da adadin masu amsa ya ƙaru. A hanya B, samfurin ƙarami ne, mutane 60, saboda haka yaɗuwar da sa'a ke haddasawa ta fi yawa; amma an zaɓi kowane ɗalibi da dama iri ɗaya, don haka matsakaicin samfurin yana yaɗuwa a kusa da matsakaicin yawan jama'a, wanda ya sa ya fi zama tushe abin dogaro don ƙiyasta.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.prompt: Hanya A tana da samfurin da ya fi girma sosai, mutane 900, amma yana da wuya a amince da matsakaicinta na sa'o'i 3.1 a matsayin ƙiyasin matsakaicin duk ɗalibai. Ka bayyana dalili, kana danganta shi da ƙarin girman samfurin.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin yadda ɗaliban da suka ga hanyar haɗin binciken amma ba su amsa ba za su bambanta da waɗanda suka amsa.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin ko wannan bambanci zai ragu idan ka ninka masu amsa daga 900.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: A ya ƙunshi ɗaliban ... kawai, don haka ... ko da samfurin ya ƙaru ...

n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Shin ka ce son zuciyar yana nan ko da samfurin ya ƙaru?
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Shin ka danganta dalilin amincewa da B (dama iri ɗaya)?
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.model.0: Binciken yanar gizon ya haɗa da ɗaliban da suka amsa da kansu kawai, don haka wasu ɗalibai, kamar waɗanda suke da matuƙar sha'awar karatu, na iya zama fiye da kima a samfurin. Wannan son zuciyar ba ya canzawa ko masu amsa 900 ne ko 9000, don haka yana da wuya a amince da sakamakon duk da girman samfurin.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.model.1: A samfurin mutane ne kawai da suka amsa da son rai, don haka ba ya wakiltar dukkan ɗalibai. Ko yawan samfurin ya kai nawa, idan hanyar zaɓen ta karkata ta wata hanya, matsakaicin zai ci gaba da bambanta da matsakaicin yawan jama'a.
n-m-h3-est-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Duka kalmomin 'da son rai' da 'ba ya wakilta' maganganu ne masu muhimmanci.

n-m-h3-conic-01.title: Duba mafita game da yankin alwatika PF₁F₂.
n-m-h3-conic-01.topic: Sassan mazugi: ma’anoni da layukan tangenti na parabola, ellips, da hyperbola; alaƙa tsakanin siffofi da lissafinsu.
n-m-h3-conic-01.goal: Fahimci cewa ko da duk ƙididdigar mafita daidai ce, ƙarshe na iya zama marar ma’ana idan ba a duba ko sharadin matsalar zai iya cika ba; nemo iyakar inda sharadin yake cika.
n-m-h3-conic-01.material: Wani littafin atisaye yana da wannan matsala da amsa: “A ce F₁ da F₂ su ne cibiyoyin fokal biyu na ellips x²/25 + y²/16 = 1. Ga wani maki P a kan ellips mai ∠F₁PF₂ = 90°, nemo yankin alwatika PF₁F₂. (Amsa: 16)” A ƙasa akwai mafitar da ta samu wannan amsa.
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.0: Bambanta ko kowanne layi na mafita lissafi ne ko kuma karɓar sharadi.
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.1: Gwada ko sharadin da aka bayar zai iya cika da gaske ta duba matsayi mafi tsauri.
n-m-h3-conic-01.thinking.2: Nemo iyakar ma’aunin siga inda sharadin ke cika.
n-m-h3-conic-01.prereq.0: Ma’anar ellips da daidaitattun wuraren foci ɗinsa.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.prompt: Kowanne layi na mafitar da ke ƙasa daidai ne a matsayin lissafi. Amma amsar 16 ga wannan matsala tana da wuya a gaskata. Zaɓi layin farko da ya sa amsar ta zama abin shakka.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bambanta ko kowanne layi ya biyo daga layin baya ta lissafi ko kuma kawai ya karɓi sharadin da aka ɗauka daga matsalar.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.hint.1: Haɗa sakamakon layin da ya karɓi sharadi da sakamakon wani layi da aka samu tun da farko, sannan ka saka lambobi domin duba ko duka biyun za su iya cika lokaci guda.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.0: Ga ellips x²/25 + y²/16 = 1, a=5 da b=4, saboda haka c²=a²−b²=9, c=3, kuma F₁(−3, 0), F₂(3, 0).
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.1: Bisa ma’anar ellips, PF₁ + PF₂ = 2a = 10, kuma F₁F₂ = 6.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.2: Tunda ∠F₁PF₂ = 90°, bisa ka’idar Pythagoras PF₁² + PF₂² = F₁F₂² = 36.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.3: Tunda (PF₁ + PF₂)² = PF₁² + PF₂² + 2·PF₁·PF₂, muna samun 100 = 36 + 2·PF₁·PF₂, saboda haka PF₁·PF₂ = 32.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.line.4: Yankin alwatika PF₁F₂ shi ne ½·PF₁·PF₂ = 16.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne. Wannan layin ya ɗauki “∠F₁PF₂=90°” da aka rubuta a matsalar a matsayin gaskiya, sannan ya kafa lissafi. Amma tunda daga layi na 2 mun san PF₁+PF₂=10, PF₁²+PF₂² yana zama mafi ƙanƙanta idan tsawon biyun daidai ne, don haka dole ya zama aƙalla 5²+5²=50. Ba zai iya zama 36 ba; saboda haka babu irin wannan maki P a kan ellips. Layi na 4 da na 5 lissafi ne da suka biyo daga sakamakon layi na 3, don haka ko da ƙididdigar daidai ce, ba su da ma’ana.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.prompt: Ka yi bayani, kana amfani da lambobin da suka bayyana a mafita, dalilin da ya sa ba za ka gaskata amsar 16 ba. Ka kuma rubuta abin da ya dace a faɗa game da wannan matsalar.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin mafi ƙarancin ƙimar PF₁²+PF₂² da za a iya samu idan PF₁+PF₂ an kayyade shi a 10.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zana hoto domin hasashen inda ∠F₁PF₂ zai fi girma yayin da P ke tafiya a kan ellips, sannan ka kimanta kusurwar a wurin.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka yi amfani da lambobi daga mafita (36, 10, 50, da sauransu) kai tsaye a bayaninka?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana ƙarshe a matsayin “sharadin ba zai iya cika ba” maimakon “lissafin ba daidai ba ne”?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka lura cewa za a iya duba wannan ta hoto ko matsayi mafi tsauri (ƙarshen ƙaramin axis)?
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.0: Idan PF₁+PF₂=10, jimillar murabba’ai tana zama mafi ƙanƙanta idan tsawon biyun daidai ne, saboda haka aƙalla 5²+5²=50 ce. Amma layi na 3 ya ba da 36, wanda ya saba. Babu irin wannan maki P, don haka ƙimar 16 ba ta da ma’ana.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.1: A ƙarshen ƙaramin axis (0, 4), PF₁=PF₂=5 kuma F₁F₂=6, saboda haka 25+25>36; wannan yana nufin ∠F₁PF₂ ƙasa da 90° ce a wannan wurin. Wannan kusurwa ce mafi girma a kan ellips, don haka babu wurin da za ta zama 90°. Saboda haka ba za a iya nemo yankin ba.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.2: Amsa 16 ba daidai ba ce. Idan jimillar 10 ce, jimillar murabba’ai aƙalla 50 ce, amma 36 ce aka samu, saboda haka ba ta dace ba. Babu irin wannan maki.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s2.model.3: 16 ba daidai ba ne. Idan jimillar tsawon biyun 10 ce, jimillar murabba’ai ba za ta zama 36 ba; saboda haka irin wannan P ba ya wanzuwa.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.prompt: Yanzu sauya ellips zuwa x²/25 + y²/b² = 1 (0 < b < 5). Nemo ka shigar da ƙimomin b mabambanta guda 3 waɗanda maki P mai ∠F₁PF₂ = 90° yake wanzuwa da gaske a kan ellips.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko duba yadda tazarar foci biyun ke canzawa yayin da b ke ƙaruwa.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ga kowace ƙimar b, kimanta ko kusurwar a wurin ellips inda ∠F₁PF₂ ta fi girma za ta kai 90°.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.fail.c1: Dole ne ya zama lamba cikin iyakar 0<b<5.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.ok.c2: Ga wannan b, akwai maki a kan ellips mai ∠F₁PF₂=90°.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.fail.c2: Ga wannan b, ∠F₁PF₂ ba ya kai 90° a ko’ina a kan ellips.
n-m-h3-conic-01.s.s3.explain: Domin foci su ga maki P a kan ellips da kusurwar 90°, ∠F₁PF₂ dole ya zama aƙalla 90° a ƙarshen ƙaramin axis, inda kusurwar ta fi girma. Wannan yana faruwa idan c ≥ b, wato idan 25−b² ≥ b². Saboda haka b² ≤ 12.5, kuma a cikin 0<b<5, akwai maki P idan b bai wuce kusan 3.54 ba. b=3.5 ya dace, amma 3.6 bai dace ba.

n-m-h3-conic-02.topic: Sassan mazugi: ma’anoni da layukan tangenti na parabola, ellips, da hyperbola; alaƙa tsakanin siffofi da lissafinsu.
n-m-h3-conic-02.title: Me kuma muke buƙata domin tantance lissafin hyperbola?
n-m-h3-conic-02.goal: Yanke hukunci ko bayanin ya isa tantance lissafin wata lanƙwasa ta kwatanta yawan abubuwan da ba a sani ba da yawan lissafi masu zaman kansu.
n-m-h3-conic-02.material: Wani littafin atisaye yana da matsalar “Nemo lissafin hyperbola x²/a² − y²/b² = 1 (a>0, b>0) mai foci (5, 0) da (−5, 0).” Malami ya ce, “Wannan matsalar ba ta da sharadi guda.” Kana son kammala matsalar ta cike sharadin da ya ɓace.
n-m-h3-conic-02.thinking.0: Ƙirga lissafin da bayanan da aka bayar ke samarwa.
