n-m-h3-conic-02.thinking.1: Rarrabe abin da ka riga ka sani da sabon bayani.
n-m-h3-conic-02.thinking.2: Nuna cewa bayanin bai isa ba ta amfani da misalin da ya karyata magana (wani lanƙwasar da ke da foci iri ɗaya).
n-m-h3-conic-02.prereq.0: Siffar misali x²/a²−y²/b²=1 ta hyperbola, da ma’anar foci, ƙwanƙolin lanƙwasa, da asymptotes.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk bayanan da idan aka ƙara su ga foci (5, 0) da (−5, 0) su kaɗai za su tantance a da b ta hanya guda. (a>0, b>0.)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko kowane bayanin yana bayar da sabon lissafi tsakanin a da b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.hint.1: Da farko gano wane lissafi tsakanin a da b yake cika idan foci kaɗai aka sani.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.o.a: Ɗaya daga cikin ƙwanƙolin lanƙwasar ita ce (3, 0).
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.o.b: Tazarar da ke tsakanin foci biyun ita ce 10.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.b: An riga an san wannan daga daidaitattun wuraren foci (±5, 0), saboda haka ba sabon bayani ba ne. Har yanzu lissafi guda ɗaya ne kawai cikin waɗanda ake buƙata tsakanin a da b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.o.c: Gangaren ɗaya daga cikin asymptotes ita ce 4/3.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.o.d: Lanƙwasar tana da daidaito game da asalin wuri.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.d: Wannan koyaushe gaskiya ne ga kowace lanƙwasa ta nau’in x²/a²−y²/b²=1. Ba sabon bayani ba ne game da a da b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.o.e: Lanƙwasar ba ta taɓa axis y.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.r.e: Saka x=0 yana ba da −y²/b²=1; saboda haka hyperbola irin wannan ba ta taɓa axis y. Ba sabon bayani ba ne game da a da b.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s1.explain: Bayanin foci yana ba da lissafi guda ɗaya kawai, a²+b²=25. Ƙwanƙolin (3, 0) yana ba da a=3, saboda haka ana tantance b=4; gangaren asymptote 4/3 kuma tana ba da b/a=4/3, saboda haka an tantance a=3 da b=4. An riga an sani ko kuma gaskiya ce koyaushe cewa tazarar foci 10 ce, lanƙwasar tana da daidaito game da asali, kuma ba ta taɓa axis y; don haka ba sa ƙara wani lissafi.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.prompt: Gina hyperbola biyu masu siffofi mabambanta, masu foci (5, 0) da (−5, 0), kuma na nau’in x²/a² − y²/b² = 1; shigar da (a, b). (Idan ka rubuta ƙimomin goma, yi amfani da wurare goma biyu.)
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.hint.0: Saka ƙimar c cikin lissafin da ke cika tsakanin a, b, da c ga hyperbola.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi ƙimar a guda ɗaya da ta cika lissafin sannan ka duba ƙimar b da za ta fito.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a da b dole su zama tabbatattu.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Da wannan (a, b), foci ba (±5, 0) ba ne.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.explain: Idan foci iri ɗaya ne, c=5, saboda haka a²+b²=25. Ba (3, 4) da (4, 3) kaɗai ba; nau’i-nau’i kamar (2, kusan 4.58) ma suna yiwuwa, saboda haka akwai hyperbola marasa iyaka masu siffofi mabambanta.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa hyperbola mabambanta suke samuwa duk da cewa foci iri ɗaya ne.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ƙirga lissafin nawa ne tsakanin a da b, da kuma abubuwan da ba a sani ba nawa ne.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ƙididdige a²+b² ga kowane nau’i-nau’i biyun da ka gina, sannan ka kwatanta su.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka faɗi cewa lissafi guda ɗaya ne kawai yake cika tsakanin a da b?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka bayar da misalai biyu ko fiye na (a, b) da ke cika wannan lissafin?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan foci su ne (±5, 0), to c=5, kuma ga hyperbola lissafi guda ɗaya ne kawai ke samuwa: a²+b²=c²=25. Akwai abubuwa biyu da ba a sani ba, a da b; saboda haka b yana canzawa gwargwadon zaɓin a, kuma akwai lanƙwasai marasa iyaka.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Abin da aka bayar shi ne a²+b²=25 kaɗai, saboda haka (3, 4) ya dace, (4, 3) ma ya dace, da wasu da yawa. Saboda haka foci kaɗai ba sa tantance shi ta hanya guda.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.prompt: A wannan karon, zaɓi hanya da za a iya amfani da ita ga lanƙwasai ban da hyperbola ma. Idan ka samu sabon bayani, wace hanya ce mafi tabbas domin yanke hukunci ko wannan bayanin kaɗai zai tantance lanƙwasar ta hanya guda?
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.hint.0: Sanya gefe da gefe yawan lissafin da bayanai biyun da aka yi amfani da su zuwa yanzu suka bayar, da kuma yawan abubuwan da ba a sani ba.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.hint.1: Yi tunanin yadda sabon bayani guda ɗaya ke sauya waɗannan ƙirga.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.a: Yanke hukunci ta duba ko sabon bayanin yana ɗauke da takamaiman lambobi.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.a: Ko da akwai lambobi, wataƙila kawai suna maimaita abin da aka riga aka sani (misali tazarar foci). Kasancewar lambobi ba zai zama ma’auni ba.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.b: Duba ko yana bayar da ƙarin lissafi guda ɗaya tsakanin a da b wanda ya bambanta da sharadin foci.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.c: Duba ko za a iya zana lanƙwasar ta amfani da sabon bayanin.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.c: Iya zana siffa ba ya nufin an tantance lambobin. Dole ne ka yanke hukunci ta amfani da lissafi ko an tantance su.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.o.d: Yanke hukunci ta duba ko an bayyana sabon bayanin kamar yadda aka bayyana foci.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.r.d: Yadda aka bayyana wani abu ba ya da alaƙa da yawan bayanai. Abin da ya fi muhimmanci shi ne lissafin da yake ƙara.
n-m-h3-conic-02.s.s3.explain: Domin a tantance ƙima ta hanya guda, ana buƙatar yawan lissafi masu zaman kansu ya kai yawan abubuwan da ba a sani ba. Foci sun bayar da lissafi guda ɗaya, a da b kuma abubuwa biyu ne da ba a sani ba; saboda haka dole ne ka duba ko sabon bayanin yana bayar da wani lissafi guda ɗaya dabam da abin da aka sani. Duk da haka, ko da akwai lissafi biyu, mafita ba lallai ta zama guda ɗaya ba; saboda haka a ƙarshe ka warware domin tabbatarwa.

n-m-h3-conic-04.topic: Sassan mazugi: ma’anoni da layukan tangenti na parabola, ellips, da hyperbola; alaƙa tsakanin siffofi da lissafinsu.
n-m-h3-conic-04.title: Gina layukan tangenti ga hyperbola da kanka
n-m-h3-conic-04.goal: Ka gina layukan tangenti da dama da kanka, ka gano cewa akwai wani zangon gangara da layin tangenti zai samu, sannan ka bayyana wannan da diskriminant.
n-m-h3-conic-04.material: Akwai hyperbola x²/4−y²/9=1. Za ka bincika layukan y=mx+k da suke tangenti da wannan lanƙwasa ta hanyar gina su da kanka.
n-m-h3-conic-04.thinking.0: Saka a cikin daidaito sannan ka tsara diskriminant
n-m-h3-conic-04.thinking.1: Gina layukan tangenti da kanka ka nemo tsarin da suke bi
n-m-h3-conic-04.thinking.2: Bayyana zangon gangarorin da suke yiwuwa
n-m-h3-conic-04.prereq.0: Diskriminant na daidaiton digiri na biyu
n-m-h3-conic-04.prereq.1: Alaƙar matsayin layi da conic (daidaitattun lokaci guda)
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.prompt: Gina layukan tangenti 3 daban-daban y=mx+k ga hyperbola x²/4−y²/9=1, sannan ka shigar da (m,k). (Yi amfani da lambobin goma zuwa wuraren goma 3.)
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.hint.0: Saka daidaiton layi a cikin daidaiton hyperbola domin samun daidaito mai ɗauke da x.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin wane yanayi ne dole daidaiton ya cika domin layin ya taɓa lanƙwasa a wuri guda tak.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.fail.c1: Da wannan gangara, saka layin ba ya ba da daidaiton digiri na biyu.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.ok.c2: Daidaiton digiri na biyu yana da tushe biyu masu maimaituwa (tangenti).
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.fail.c2: Wannan layin ba tangenti ba ne ga hyperbola (diskriminant ɗin ba 0 ba ne).
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.explain: Saka y=mx+k a cikin 9x²−4y²=36 yana ba da (9−4m²)x²−8mkx−4k²−36=0. Diskriminant ɗin shi ne 144(k²+9−4m²), saboda haka domin tangenti, k²=4m²−9. Misali, idan m=2.5, k²=16 ne, saboda haka k=±4.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.prompt: Ka tuna da layukan da ka gina a baya. Zaɓi duk gangarorin da suke ba da layin y=mx+k tangenti ga wannan hyperbola.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta sharadin da diskriminant na daidaiton da ka tsara a baya ya zama 0, a matsayin daidaito mai ɗauke da k².
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ga kowace gangara m, tantance ko k² zai zama mara kyau.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.r.a: Layin kwance y=k ko dai yana ratsa rassan hyperbola biyun sau ɗaya kowanne, ko kuma bai haɗu da ɗayansu ba. Ba zai taɓa zama tangenti ba.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.r.d: Da alama ka ɗauka cewa ƙaramin gangara yana da layin tangenti. Idan ka yi amfani da ƙa’idar tangenti ta ellipse k²=a²m²+b² ba tare da sauyi ba, za ka samu k=±√13, amma wannan layin yana haɗuwa da hyperbola a maki biyu.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s2.explain: Domin tangenti, ana buƙatar k²=4m²−9≥0, kuma a cire yanayin da layin ya yi daidai da asymptote (gangara ±3/2), wato 4m²>9, ko |m|>3/2. Gangarorin 2 da −3 sun dace; ga 0 da 1, k² mara kyau ne, saboda haka ba su dace ba.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.prompt: Layin mai gangara 1 ba zai iya zama tangenti ga wannan hyperbola ba. Bayyana dalili, sannan ka bayyana zangon gangara m da layin tangenti zai samu.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.hint.0: Saka m=1, sannan ka nemo k da ke sa diskriminant ya zama 0.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.hint.1: Nemo zangon da m dole ya kasance a cikinsa domin k² kada ya zama mara kyau.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana dalilin ta amfani da diskriminant (ko alamar k²)?
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka faɗi cewa iyakar zangon tana da alaƙa da gangarar asymptote?
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.model.0: Saka y=x+k yana ba da diskriminant 144(k²+5), wanda ba zai taɓa zama 0 ba. Domin a sami tangenti, ana buƙatar k²=4m²−9≥0, saboda haka cikakkiyar ƙimar m dole ta fi 3/2.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s3.model.1: Idan gangara 1 ce, k²=−5, saboda haka babu k na ainihi, kuma ba a samun layin tangenti. Gangarar layin tangenti dole ta sa 4m²−9 ya kai aƙalla 0, amma ±1.5 waɗanda suke layi ɗaya da asymptote dole a cire su; saboda haka |m|>1.5.
n-m-h3-conic-04.s.s1.ok.c1: Saka layin yana ba da daidaiton digiri na biyu a x.

n-m-h3-conic-05.topic: Sassan mazugi: ma’anoni da layukan tangenti na parabola, ellips, da hyperbola; alaƙa tsakanin siffofi da lissafinsu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.title: Idan k ya sauya, shin nau’in lanƙwasar ma yana sauyawa?
n-m-h3-conic-05.goal: A cikin daidaiton conic mai ɗauke da harafi, nemo sannan ka tabbatar kai tsaye da zangon da nau’in siffa ke sauyawa bisa alamar ma’aunin rabawa.
n-m-h3-conic-05.material: Ga k na ainihi, bincika yadda siffar da daidaiton x²/(9−k)+y²/(4−k)=1 ke wakilta take sauyawa bisa k. Idan aka saka k=2, za a samu x²/7+y²/2=1, wato ellipse.
n-m-h3-conic-05.thinking.1: Gina misali da ya cika dukan zangon
n-m-h3-conic-05.thinking.2: Bincika yiwuwar cewa daidaiton ba ya wakiltar wata siffa kwata-kwata
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.prompt: Idan aka saka k=6, za a samu x²/3+y²/(−2)=1. Wace siffa ce wannan daidaito yake wakilta?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.hint.0: Sake rubuta kalmar da ke da ma’aunin rabawa mara kyau a sigar ragewa.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta daidaiton da aka sake rubutawa da sigar daidaitacciya, sannan ka duba wace kalma ce tabbatacciya.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.a: Ellipse ce, domin an rubuta daidaiton a matsayin jimillar kalmomi biyu.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.a: Ka rasa cewa alamar ma’aunin rabawa na iya sauyawa idan ka saka k. Ka duba yanayin daidaiton na waje kawai.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.b: Hyperbola ce mai babban axis a alkiblar y, domin alamar mara kyau tana kan ɓangaren y².
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.b: Idan ma’aunin rabawa mara kyau yana kan ɓangaren y², kalmar x² tana da kyau, saboda haka lanƙwasar tana buɗewa ta alkiblar axis x. Duba wace kalma ce tabbatacciya.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.c: Ba wata siffa ba ce, domin ɗaya daga cikin ma’aunan rabawa mara kyau ne.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.r.c: Idan ma’aunin rabawa ɗaya mara kyau ne, daidaiton yana zama na ragewa. Ba wai babu maki ba ne; nau’in lanƙwasar ne yake sauyawa.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.o.d: Hyperbola ce, domin ɗaya daga cikin ma’aunan rabawa ya zama mara kyau, daidaiton kuma ya koma sigar ragewa.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s1.explain: y²/(−2) shi ne −y²/2, saboda haka daidaiton x²/3−y²/2=1 ne. Kalmar x² tabbatacciya ce, saboda haka hyperbola ce da ke buɗewa ta alkiblar axis x.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.prompt: Nemo sannan ka shigar da ƙimomin k guda 3 daban-daban da za su sa daidaiton x²/(9−k)+y²/(4−k)=1 ya zama hyperbola mai sigar x²/A−y²/B=1 (A>0, B>0).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta yadda alamomin ma’aunan rabawa biyun dole su kasance domin daidaiton ya koma sigar ragewa.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.hint.1: Mayar da wannan sharadin alama zuwa rashin daidaito a k, sannan ka nemo zangon.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Ma’aunin rabawa na kalmar x² tabbatacce ne.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Ma’aunin rabawa na kalmar x² ba tabbatacce ba ne.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.ok.c2: Kalmar y² tana cikin sigar ragewa.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Kalmar y² ba ta koma sigar ragewa ba.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.explain: Idan ma’aunin rabawa 9−k na kalmar x² tabbatacce ne, ma’aunin rabawa 4−k na y² kuma mara kyau ne, daidaiton yana koma x²/(9−k)−y²/(k−4)=1. Wato duk k da ya cika 4<k<9 ya dace (k=4 da 9 ba su dace ba saboda ma’aunin rabawa ya zama 0).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Lokacin da k=2 ellipse ce, amma lokacin k=6 ta koma hyperbola. Bayyana wane ɓangare na daidaiton ya sauya da yadda ya sauya.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Rubuta alamomin ma’aunan rabawa biyun idan k=2 da kuma idan k=6, sannan ka kwatanta.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Nemo wane ma’aunin rabawa ne ya sauya alama.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka kwatanta sauyin alamomin ma’aunan rabawa biyu lokacin k=2 da k=6?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana ainihin ma’aunin rabawa da ya sauya alama?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Lokacin k=2, ma’aunan rabawa biyun su ne 7 da 2, duka tabbatattu ne, saboda haka sigar jimilla ce (ellipse). Lokacin k=6, ma’aunin rabawa 4−k a ɓangaren y² ya zama −2, mara kyau, saboda haka daidaiton ya koma sigar ragewa (hyperbola).
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan k ya wuce 4, 4−k yana zama mara kyau. Sai alamar da ke gaban kalmar y² ta sauya, ellipse ɗin ya koma hyperbola. 9−k yana nan tabbatacce.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.prompt: Idan aka saka k=10, daidaiton ya koma x²/(−1)+y²/(−6)=1. Wace magana ce daidai game da siffar da wannan daidaito yake wakilta?
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.hint.0: Sake rubuta ɓangaren hagu ta hanyar kawar da ma’aunan rabawa.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta zangon ƙimomin da ɓangaren hagu zai iya samu da ɓangaren dama, wato 1.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.a: Babu maki (x,y) da ya cika wannan daidaiton.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.b: Ellipse ce, domin ko da ma’aunan rabawa biyun sun sauya, har yanzu sigar jimilla ce.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.b: Ko da ma’aunan rabawa biyun ba su da kyau, har yanzu sigar jimilla ce; amma ba ka bincika cewa ɓangaren hagu ba zai iya wuce 0 ba, don haka ba zai iya zama daidai da 1 a dama ba.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.c: Hyperbola ce da ke buɗewa ta alkiblar axis x, domin 9−k mara kyau ne.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.c: Ma’aunan rabawa biyun ba su da kyau, saboda haka ba sigar ragewa ba ce. Sake duba alamomin.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.o.d: Da’ira ce, domin kalmomin biyun suna kama da juna.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.r.d: Ma’aunan rabawa ba su da ƙima iri ɗaya, don haka ba zai iya zama da’ira ba; haka kuma ba ka duba alamomin ba.
n-m-h3-conic-05.s.s3.explain: Ɓangaren hagu shi ne −x²−y²/6, wanda bai fi 0 ba. Ba zai iya zama 1 a dama ba, saboda haka babu x,y na ainihi da suka cika daidaiton. Dangane da ko ma’aunan rabawa tabbatattu ne ko marasa kyau, sakamakon na iya zama ellipse, hyperbola ko babu siffa ko kaɗan.

n-m-h3-conic-07.topic: Sassan mazugi: ma’anoni da layukan tangenti na parabola, ellips, da hyperbola; alaƙa tsakanin siffofi da lissafinsu.
n-m-h3-conic-07.title: Jimillar hanyoyi biyu da suka bi ta maki a kan parabola
n-m-h3-conic-07.goal: Ta amfani da matsayin maki, ka ga cewa ƙaramar iyakar daga rashin daidaiton alwatika ba koyaushe take zama ƙimar da ake samu ba; sake nemo mafi ƙaranci ta amfani da ma’anar parabola (tazara zuwa wurin mai da hankali = tazara zuwa layin jagora).
n-m-h3-conic-07.material: Parabola y²=8x tana da wurin mai da hankali F(2, 0) da layin jagora x=−2. Seoyun ta ce, “Ga maki P a kan lanƙwasar da kowane maki A, mafi ƙarancin PA+PF koyaushe AF ne bisa rashin daidaiton alwatika.”
n-m-h3-conic-07.thinking.0: Bincika sharadin samun daidaito a rashin daidaito
n-m-h3-conic-07.thinking.1: Sake rubutawa a wata siga ta amfani da ma’ana
n-m-h3-conic-07.thinking.2: Raba zuwa yanayi bisa matsayin maki
n-m-h3-conic-07.prereq.0: Ma’anar parabola (wurin mai da hankali da layin jagora)
n-m-h3-conic-07.prereq.1: Ka’idar triangle inequality da sharadin samun daidaito.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.prompt: Ga parabola y² = 8x mai focus F(2, 0) da maki A(4, 2), ka matsar da maki P a kan lanƙwasar domin nemo mafi ƙarancin PA+PF. Wace ƙima da dalili ne suka fi dacewa?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.hint.0: Zaɓi maki P da dama a kan lanƙwasar, ka ƙididdige PA+PF kai tsaye sannan ka rubuta a tebur.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tuna ma’anar parabola, ka duba ko za ka iya sake rubuta PF a matsayin wani tsawo idan maki yana kan parabola.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.a: 6, domin yana daidai da nisan daga A zuwa directrix.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.b: 2√2, domin PA+PF ≥ AF, kuma akwai maki P da daidaito ke cikawa.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.b: Daidaito a triangle inequality yana faruwa ne kawai idan P yana kan sashen AF. Ba ka duba ko irin wannan P yana kan lanƙwasar ba.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.c: 4, domin yana daidai da haɗin x na A.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.c: Ka kalli haɗin maki A kawai. Babu bayani kan nisan da wannan ƙima ta tara.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.o.d: 2+2√5, domin wannan ita ce ƙima a ƙwanƙolin P=(0, 0).
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.r.d: Ka nemo ƙima a maki guda ɗaya kawai, ba ka duba ko ita ce mafi ƙaranci ba.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s1.explain: Ga maki a kan parabola, PF yana daidai da nisan P daga directrix x=−2. Saboda haka PA+PF shi ne PA da “nisan P daga directrix,” wanda aƙalla 6 ne, nisan A daga directrix. Ana samun 6 a wani maki a kan lanƙwasar da ke tsayi ɗaya da A, kamar P=(0.5, 2). 2√2 ita ce AF, amma A da F duka suna cikin lanƙwasar; sashen AF ba ya ketare lanƙwasar, saboda haka ba za a iya kaiwa gare shi ba.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.prompt: A wannan karon zaɓi maki A(x, y) mai haɗin integer (daga −10 zuwa 10), sannan ka nemo ka shigar da maki A mabambanta guda 3 da mafi ƙarancin PA+PF ya yi daidai da AF yayin da P ke motsi a kan lanƙwasar.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko faɗi inda P dole yake domin daidaito a triangle inequality ya faru.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.hint.1: Raba zuwa yanayin da A yake ciki da wajen lanƙwasar, sannan ka zana ko sashen AF yana ketare lanƙwasar.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Waɗannan haɗin integer ne da ke cikin iyaka.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Haɗin dole su zama integer daga −10 zuwa 10 har da iyakokin.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Sashen AF yana ketare lanƙwasar, saboda haka akwai P da PA+PF=AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Ga wannan maki, babu P a kan lanƙwasar da ya sa jimillar ta yi daidai da AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s2.explain: PA+PF ≥ AF, kuma daidaito yana faruwa ne kawai idan P yana kan sashen AF. F yana cikin lanƙwasar; saboda haka idan A yana kan lanƙwasar ko wajenta (y² ≥ 8x), sashen AF yana ketare lanƙwasar. Idan A yana ciki (y² < 8x), sashen ba ya ketare ta, saboda haka mafi ƙarancin ƙimar ya fi AF.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.prompt: Ga A(4, 2), mafi ƙarancin ƙimar ta fi AF. Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa da’awar Seoyun “mafi ƙarancin PA+PF koyaushe AF ne” ba daidai ba ce.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.hint.0: Faɗi inda P dole ne ya kasance domin daidaito a rashin daidaiton da Seoyun ta yi amfani da shi ya faru.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.hint.1: Duba ta amfani da matsayin sashen AF da lanƙwasar ko wannan sharadi ya cika ga A(4, 2).
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana sharadin samun daidaito na triangle inequality?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka ce sakamakon yana bambanta gwargwadon matsayin maki A (ciki/waje da lanƙwasar)?
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.model.0: PF daidai yake da nisan P daga directrix, saboda haka PA+PF aƙalla 6 ne, wato nisan A daga directrix. Wannan 6 ya fi AF=2√2 girma sosai. Da’awar Seoyun ba gaskiya ba ce koyaushe, domin akwai yanayi da AF ne mafi ƙarancin ƙima.
n-m-h3-conic-07.s.s3.model.1: Daidaito a triangle inequality PA+PF≥AF yana faruwa ne kawai idan P yana kan sashen AF. Idan A da F duk suna cikin lanƙwasar, sashen AF ba ya ketare ta, saboda haka babu irin wannan P. Don haka mafi ƙarancin ƙimar ta fi AF.

n-m-h3-diffc-05.title: Idan aikin ciki yana da kusurwa, shin hadadden aikin ma yana da ita?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.topic: Differentiation: iya samun derivative na hadadden aiki
n-m-h3-diffc-05.goal: Gwada ikirarin “idan aikin ciki ba shi da derivative, to hadadden aikin ma ba shi da derivative” da misalai. Sannan ka tabbatar da sharuɗɗan da ke sa hadadden aikin ya sami derivative ta amfani da misalan da ka ƙirƙira da kanka.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.material: g(x)=|x| ba shi da derivative a x=0. (Gangara a hagu na x=0 ita ce −1, a dama kuma 1.) Minseo ta ce, “Idan aikin ciki g ba shi da derivative a x=0, to ga kowane aiki f mai derivative, hadadden aiki h(x)=f(g(x))=f(|x|) ba zai sami derivative a x=0 ba.”
n-m-h3-diffc-05.thinking.0: Nemo misalin da zai nuna cewa wannan ikirari ba daidai ba ne
n-m-h3-diffc-05.thinking.1: Ƙirƙira ka kuma gwada misalin da ya cika sharuɗɗan
n-m-h3-diffc-05.thinking.2: Bayyana sakamakon a yanayin da ba za a iya amfani da chain rule ba
n-m-h3-diffc-05.prereq.0: Aikin absolute value |x| ba shi da derivative a x=0
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk ayyukan f da ke sa h(x)=f(|x|) ya sami derivative a x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane f, rubuta h(x)=f(|x|) kai tsaye ta amfani da |x|.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.hint.1: A kusa da x=0, yi amfani da |x|=x idan x>0 da |x|=−x idan x<0, sannan ka kwatanta siffar h a hagu da dama.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.a: h(x)=x²+|x|, kuma x² ba zai iya ɓoye kusurwar |x| ba. Ga wannan f, gangara a x=0 ba 0 ba ce.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.b: h(x)=|x|³, saboda haka gangarorin a ɓangarorin biyu na x=0 suna matsowa zuwa 0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.c: h(x)=3|x|+2, kuma siffar kusurwar ta ci gaba da kasancewa.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.r.e: h(x)=(|x|−1)²=x²−2|x|+1, kuma saboda −2|x| yana da kusurwa a x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s1.explain: Derivative na dama na h a x=0 shi ne f′(0), na hagu kuma −f′(0). Don su zama daidai, ana buƙatar f′(0)=0. x³ da x²+3 suna da f′(0)=0, saboda haka suna da derivative. Sauran suna da f′(0) daidai da 1, 3, da −2 bi da bi, saboda haka suna da kusurwa.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.prompt: A ɗauki f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx. Shigar da triples (a, b, c) guda biyu ko fiye dabam-dabam da ke sa h(x)=f(|x|) ya sami derivative a x=0. A nan a da b ba 0 ba ne, kuma dukansu lambobi ne daga −9 zuwa 9, har da iyakokin.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta f(|x|) a matsayin wata magana, sannan ka ware kalmomin da |x| ke nan a matsayin iko marar lamba biyu daga waɗanda |x| ke ɓacewa saboda ikonsu lamba ce mai lamba biyu.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo kalmar da ke barin |x| yadda yake kuma ke haifar da kusurwa a x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Dukkan coefficients ukun lambobi ne a cikin kewayon.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.fail.c1: a, b, da c dole ne su zama lambobi daga −9 zuwa 9, har da iyakokin.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.fail.c2: a da b ba za su zama 0 ba.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Gangarorin hagu da dama a x=0 daidai suke.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Idan coefficient na x ba 0 ba ne, h yana da kusurwa a x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s2.explain: A cikin h(x)=a|x|³+bx²+c|x|, a|x|³ da bx² suna da derivative a x=0, amma c|x| yana da kusurwa idan c≠0. Saboda haka c dole ya zama 0, wato f′(0)=c=0. (1, 2, 1) yana da c≠0, saboda haka yana da kusurwa; (0, 2, 0) da (1, 0, −2) suna da a=0 da b=0 bi da bi, don haka sun saɓa wa sharadi c2, kuma na ƙarshe ya kuma saɓa wa c3.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.prompt: Ta amfani da misalan da ke sama, bayyana dalilin da ya sa ikirarin Minseo ba daidai ba ne, kuma rubuta sharadin da f dole ya cika domin f(|x|) ya sami derivative a x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.hint.0: Sanya kusa da juna ayyukan f da suka sami derivative a matakin baya da waɗanda ba su samu ba, sannan ka kwatanta gangarar f a x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.hint.1: Bayyana gangarar dama da ta hagu na h a x=0 ta amfani da gangarar f.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka bayar da takamaiman aikin f guda ɗaya ka nuna cewa h(x) yana da derivative a x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka bayyana yadda gangarar hagu da ta dama suke zama daidai?
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.model.0: Idan f(x)=x²+3, to h(x)=x²+3, kuma yana da derivative a x=0. Duk da cewa |x| yana da kusurwa, hadadden aikin ba shi da ita. Gangarar dama ta h ita ce f′(0), ta hagu kuma −f′(0); saboda haka idan f′(0)=0, gangarorin biyu daidai suke kuma aikin yana da derivative. Don haka ikirarin Minseo ba daidai ba ne.
n-m-h3-diffc-05.s.s3.model.1: Misalin da ya nuna akasin ikirarin shi ne f(x)=x³. h(x)=|x|³ yana da gangara 0 a x=0. Gabaɗaya, idan f′(0)=0, derivative na hagu 0 ce kuma na dama 0 ce, don haka aikin yana da derivative; idan f′(0) ba 0 ba ne, yana da kusurwa.

n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.prompt: Informasi dibuka saeutik-saeutik. Dina unggal léngkah, pilih pamadegan dumasar kana hal anu geus dipikanyaho.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.title: Me zai faru idan gangara ta zama 0 kuma lanƙwasawar ma ta zama 0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.topic: Differentiation: fassarar jadawalai, ƙimomin matsananci, da derivative na biyu
n-m-h3-diffc-04.goal: Yayin da ake ƙara bayani a hankali, sake duba hukuncinka game da ƙimomin matsananci. Ka fahimci cewa idan ƙimar derivative na biyu ta zama 0, dole ne ka duba kai tsaye ko alamar derivative tana sauyawa.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.material: Aikin polynomial f yana cika f′(0)=0 a x=0. Duk lokacin da aka bayyana sabon bayani, sake duba hukuncinka game da siffar jadawalin a x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.thinking.0: Sake duba hukuncinka bisa sabon bayani
n-m-h3-diffc-04.thinking.1: Lura da yanayin da gwaji ba ya aiki
n-m-h3-diffc-04.thinking.2: Duba ƙimomin matsananci ta sauyin alamar derivative
n-m-h3-diffc-04.prereq.0: Dangantakar ƙimomin matsananci da sauyin alamomin derivative
n-m-h3-diffc-04.prereq.1: Derivative na biyu da lanƙwasawar jadawali
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.hint.0: Duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana, yanke shawarar gwajin da ake amfani da shi da kuma ko sharuɗɗansa sun dace don fitar da hukunci.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta ko kasancewar f′ da f″ duka 0 tana nufin abu ɗaya da alamomin hagu da dama na wannan wurin.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.info: f′(0)=0. (A x=0, layin tangent yana a layi ɗaya da axis x.)
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Za mu iya cewa f yana da ƙimar matsananci a x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.after: f′(x)=0 yana nuna wurin da zai iya zama ƙimar matsananci kawai. Kana buƙatar ƙarin bayani game da alamar f′ gab da x=0 da bayansa, ko alamar f″.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ƙaramin ƙima ne na kusa: idan layin tangent ya kwanta, jadawalin yana haɗuwa da shi daga ƙasa
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka ɗauka cewa kowane wuri mai layin tangent kwance ƙaramin ƙima ne na kusa. Layin tangent kwance na iya kasancewa a babban ƙima na kusa, ƙaramin ƙima na kusa, ko wurin juyawar lanƙwasawa.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Babban ƙima ne na kusa: idan layin tangent ya kwanta, wannan shi ne saman jadawalin
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka ɗauka cewa kowane wuri mai layin tangent kwance babban ƙima ne na kusa.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ba mu sani ba tukuna: yana iya zama ƙimar matsananci ko ba haka ba, saboda haka muna buƙatar ƙarin bayani
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka lura cewa layin tangent kwance shi kaɗai bai isa ya tabbatar da cewa wurin ƙimar matsananci ne ba.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Da aka ga wannan bayani, menene hukuncinka yanzu?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Gwajin da ke cewa f″(0)>0 yana nuna ƙaramin ƙima na kusa, sannan f″(0)<0 yana nuna babban ƙima na kusa, ba ya ba da amsa idan f″(0)=0. Ayyukan f(x)=x⁴, −x⁴, da x³ duk suna da f′(0)=f″(0)=0, amma siffofinsu sun bambanta.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ba ƙimar matsananci ba ce: idan f″(0)=0, ba ƙimar matsananci ba ce
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka ɗauki f″(0)=0 a matsayin shaida cewa wurin ba ƙimar matsananci ba ne. A zahiri, wannan yana nufin kawai ba za a iya amfani da gwajin “derivative na biyu tabbatacce yana nuna ƙaramin ƙima na kusa, mara kyau kuma babban ƙima na kusa” ba.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ba za a iya yanke hukunci daga wannan bayani ba: gwajin derivative na biyu ya daina aiki
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka lura cewa idan f″(0)=0, ba za a iya amfani da f″ wajen tantance ko wurin babban ƙima ne ko ƙarami ba.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ƙaramin ƙima ne na kusa: gangara 0 ce, lanƙwasawa kuma 0 ce, saboda haka shi ne mafi kwance
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka tabbatar da ƙaramin ƙima na kusa saboda wurin ya yi kama da “kwance.” Wuri mai kwance ba lallai ya zama ƙasa ba.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: A ƙarshe, wace siffa f ke da ita a x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.after: f′(x)=4x³ ba ta da kyau idan x<0, kuma tana da kyau idan x>0, don haka f tana da ƙaramin ƙima na kusa a x=0. Haka kuma f″(x)=12x²≥0, saboda haka lanƙwasawar ba ta sauyawa, kuma wannan ba wurin juyawar lanƙwasawa ba ne.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Yana da ƙaramin ƙima na kusa, kuma wannan wurin ba wurin juyawar lanƙwasawa ba ne
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka haɗa lura da cewa alamar f′ tana sauyawa daga mara kyau zuwa tabbatacciya da kuma cewa f″ aƙalla 0 ce kuma ba ta sauya alama.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ba shi da ƙimar matsananci, kuma wannan wurin wurin juyawar lanƙwasawa ne
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka ce wurin juyawar lanƙwasawa ne saboda f″(0)=0 kawai. Don ya zama wurin juyawar lanƙwasawa, dole ne alamar f″ ta sauya.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Yana da ƙaramin ƙima na kusa, kuma wannan wurin ma wurin juyawar lanƙwasawa ne
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka ɗauka cewa f″(0)=0 yana nufin wurin juyawar lanƙwasawa ne. Amma f″(x)=12x² aƙalla 0 ce, don haka alamarta ba ta sauyawa.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s1.reflect: Da farko f′(0)=0 kaɗai ya sa wurin ya yi kama da ƙimar matsananci, kuma da f″(0)=0 ta bayyana, gwajin ya daina aiki. Duk da haka, za ka iya yanke hukunci ta hanyar duba kai tsaye ko alamar f′ tana sauyawa. Ƙima ta zama 0 ba daidai yake da alama ta sauya ba.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi aikin da ke da f′(0)=0 da f″(0)=0 amma ba shi da ƙimar matsananci a x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo derivative na kowane aiki, sannan ka kwatanta alamarta a hagu da dama na x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.hint.1: Raba su zuwa ayyukan da alamar f′ ke sauyawa da waɗanda ba ta sauyawa.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.a: x⁴ yana da f′(0)=f″(0)=0 amma yana da ƙaramin ƙima na kusa a x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.b: −x⁶ yana da f′(0)=f″(0)=0 amma yana da babban ƙima na kusa a x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.c: x⁶ ma yana da ƙaramin ƙima na kusa a x=0. Duba ko ma'aunin iko (exponent) lamba ce mai lamba biyu.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.r.d: Ga x³, f′(x)=3x² ba ta sauya alama, saboda haka babu ƙimar matsananci.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s2.explain: Ga x³, f′(x)=3x²≥0, don haka alamar f′ iri ɗaya ce kafin da bayan x=0, kuma babu ƙimar matsananci. Ga sauran ayyuka ukun, alamar f′ tana sauyawa, don haka suna da ƙimomin matsananci. Wannan yana nuna cewa f′(0)=f″(0)=0 kaɗai ba ya gaya mana wane hali ne.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.prompt: Idan f′(0)=0 kuma f″(0)=0, rubuta abin da ya kamata ka duba da yadda za ka duba shi domin yanke shawarar ko akwai ƙimar matsananci a x=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta yadda za ka bayyana kasancewar ƙimar matsananci ta amfani da alamar f′.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.hint.1: Ka ware hanyar da ba za a iya amfani da ita idan f″(0)=0 ba daga hanyar da har yanzu za a iya amfani da ita.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.placeholder: misali, idan f″(0)=0, to ... maimakon haka ...
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka rubuta cewa kana kwatanta alamar f′ a hagu da dama na x=0?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka ce f″(0)=0 ba ya nufin babu ƙimar matsananci?
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.model.0: Idan f″(0)=0, derivative na biyu ba zai iya gaya maka ko wurin babban ƙima ne na kusa ko ƙarami ba. Saboda haka dole ne ka duba kai tsaye ko alamar f′ tana sauyawa a hagu da dama na x=0. Idan ta sauya, akwai ƙimar matsananci; idan ba ta sauya ba, babu.
n-m-h3-diffc-04.s.s3.model.1: Idan ƙimar derivative na biyu ta zama 0, gwajin ya daina aiki, saboda haka zana jadawalin alamar f′(x). Idan f′ tana sauyawa daga mara kyau zuwa tabbatacciya (ƙaramin ƙima), ko daga tabbatacciya zuwa mara kyau (babban ƙima) a kusa da 0, akwai ƙimar matsananci. Idan alamar ta kasance iri ɗaya, babu.

n-m-h3-diffc-08.title: Shin layin tangent yana haɗuwa da lanƙwasa ne kawai a wurin taɓawa?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.var.a: a shi ne haɗin x na wurin taɓawa.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.ok.c1: a da b lambobi cikakku ne cikin kewayon.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.topic: Diferenshiyal: lissafin layukan tangenti, layukan tangenti na lanƙwasai kubik.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.goal: Ka gina da kanka misalin layin tangenti ga lanƙwasar kubik da ke sake haɗuwa da lanƙwasar a wani maki dabam da wurin tangenti, sannan ka bambanta wuraren tangenti da hakan ba ya faruwa.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.material: Layin tangenti ga lanƙwasar y=x³−3x a maki A(1, −2) shi ne y=−2. Ga jadawalin aikin quadratic, ka ga cewa layin tangenti yana haɗuwa da lanƙwasar ne kawai a wurin tangenti guda. Shin haka yake ga wannan lanƙwasar ma?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.thinking.1: Ka gina misali da kanka wanda ya cika sharuddan.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.thinking.2: Nemo wuraren tangenti waɗanda ba sa bin wannan ka’ida.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.prereq.1: Fitar da abubuwan da ke raba lissafin kubik (tushen ninki biyu).
n-m-h3-diffc-08.prereq.2: Dangantaka tsakanin tushe da ƙimomin ma’auni.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.prompt: Idan ka nemo dukkan haɗin x na wuraren da layin tangenti y=−2 yake haɗuwa da lanƙwasar y=x³−3x, me za ka samu?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.hint.0: Makin da layin tangenti da lanƙwasar suke haɗuwa su ne mafitar lissafin da ke daidaita furucinsu. Kafa wannan lissafin.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.hint.1: Yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa x=1 mafita ce domin fitar da wannan abu daga gefen hagu.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi tunanin cewa tunda layin tangenti ne, yana haɗuwa da lanƙwasar ne kawai a wurin tangenti. Warware lissafin x³−3x=−2 kai tsaye.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.b: Ka ɗauki x=1 da −1 a matsayin biyu. Saka x=−1 cikin lissafin domin duba.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.c: Wannan sakamakon ne na fitar da x³−3x+2=0 a matsayin (x−1)²(x+2)=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.r.d: Ka rasa tushen ninki biyu x=1. x=1 shi ne wurin tangenti, saboda haka yana kan layin tangenti.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s1.explain: x³−3x+2=(x−1)²(x+2), saboda haka mafita su ne x=1 (tushen ninki biyu, wurin tangenti) da x=−2. A maki (−2, −2), layin tangenti yana sake haɗuwa da lanƙwasar.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.prompt: Shigar da nau’i-nau’i biyu ko fiye na (a, b) mabambanta ta yadda layin tangenti ga lanƙwasar y=x³−3x a maki (a, a³−3a) zai kuma haɗu da lanƙwasar a wani maki (b, b³−3b), dabam da wurin tangenti. (a da b lambobin integer ne daga −6 zuwa 6 har da iyakokin, kuma b≠a.)
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi ƙimar haɗin x a na wurin tangenti, nemo lissafin layin tangenti, sannan ka rubuta lissafin da ake samu idan aka daidaita shi da lanƙwasar.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.hint.1: Yi amfani da mafitar da ka riga ka sani a cikin wannan lissafin (wurin tangenti) domin nemo sauran mafita.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.var.b: Haɗin x na maki inda yake sake haɗuwa.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.fail.c1: a da b dole su zama lambobin integer daga −6 zuwa 6, har da iyakokin.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Maki ne dabam da wurin tangenti.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.fail.c2: b dole ya bambanta da a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.ok.c3: Maki (b, b³−3b) yana kan layin tangenti.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Maki (b, b³−3b) ba ya kan layin tangenti.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.explain: Daidaita lissafin layin tangenti a maki (a, a³−3a) da lanƙwasar yana ba da (x−a)²(x+2a)=0; saboda haka haɗin x na maki inda yake sake haɗuwa shi ne b=−2a. (1, −2), (2, −4), da (−3, 6) misalai ne; (1, 1) wurin tangenti ne da kansa, kuma (1, −1) ba maki ne a kan layin tangenti ba.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.prompt: Duba nau’i-nau’i na (a, b) da ka samu, ka rubuta dangantakar da ke bayyana b ta amfani da a, sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa take aiki.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sanya ƙimomin a da b daga misalanka gefe da gefe a tebur, sannan ka kwatanta b da yawan ninkin a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin cewa lissafin haɗaka kubik ne, da kuma irin tushen da x=a yake (tushen guda ko tushen ninki biyu), sannan ka rubuta tushen ukun.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.placeholder: Misali: daidaita layin tangenti da lanƙwasar yana ba da ...
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa lissafin kubik da ya samo daga layin tangenti da lanƙwasar yana da tushen ninki biyu a wurin tangenti?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka nemo b ta amfani da gaskiyar cewa jimillar tushen ukun 0 ce, ko kuwa ta hanyar fitar da abubuwa?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.model.0: b=−2a. Daidaita layin tangenti da lanƙwasar yana ba da lissafin kubik mai siffar x³−3x=m(x−a)+a³−3a. Wurin tangenti x=a tushen ninki biyu ne, saboda haka ana iya rubuta shi a matsayin (x−a)²(x−b). Ma’aunin x² shi ne 0, don haka jimillar tushen ukun a+a+b=0, kuma hakan yana ba da b=−2a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s2.because.model.1: Na duba cewa ya zama (x−a)²(x+2a)=0. Wurin tangenti tushen ninki biyu ne, saboda haka akwai abin (x−a)²; kuma babu kalmar x², saboda haka tushen da ya rage shi ne −2a, wato b=−2a.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.prompt: A cikin maki na lanƙwasar y=x³−3x, ga wane haɗin x ne layin tangenti a wannan maki ba ya sake haɗuwa da lanƙwasar a wani wuri dabam da wurin tangenti?
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.hint.0: Ta amfani da dangantakar da ka samu a matakin baya, nemo haɗin x na wurin sake haɗuwa ga wurin tangenti na kowace zaɓi.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin abin da ke faruwa idan maki inda ake sake haɗuwa ya zama ɗaya da wurin tangenti.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.a: Idan a=−1, layin tangenti yana sake haɗuwa da lanƙwasar a x=2.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.b: Ka yi la’akari da yanayin da haɗin x na wurin sake haɗuwa ya zama ɗaya da na wurin tangenti.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.c: Idan a=1, layin tangenti yana sake haɗuwa da lanƙwasar a x=−2.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.r.d: Idan a=2, layin tangenti yana sake haɗuwa da lanƙwasar a x=−4.
n-m-h3-diffc-08.s.s3.explain: Haɗin x na wurin sake haɗuwa shi ne −2a; saboda haka yana daidai da wurin tangenti ne kawai idan −2a=a, wato a=0. Layin tangenti y=−3x yana haɗuwa da lanƙwasar a maki x=0 kaɗai, daga x³=0. Wannan maki kuma wurin canjin lanƙwasar ne.

n-m-h3-diffc-06.prereq.0: Alamar derivative da ƙaruwa/raguwa na aiki.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.title: Ta yaya za ka bayyana wa ƙaramin ɗalibi ma'anar kasancewar derivative na biyu tabbatacce?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.topic: Differentiation: fassarar jadawalai, derivative na biyu da convexity
n-m-h3-diffc-06.goal: Nemo jimlar da ba daidai ba a bayanin babban ɗalibi, gwada ta da misalin da ya nuna akasin haka, sannan ka sake rubuta ta a matsayin jimla madaidaiciya da ƙaramin ɗalibi zai fahimta.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.material: Ƙaramar ɗalibarka Haeun ta tambaya, “Idan f″(x)>0 ne, shin jadawalin yana hawa yayin da ake tafiya zuwa dama?” Babban ɗalibinka Jihu ya amsa kamar haka. Duba wannan rubutun, sannan ka sake rubuta shi domin Haeun ta fahimta. (f″ shi ne derivative na derivative na f.)
n-m-h3-diffc-06.thinking.0: Nemo jimlar da ba daidai ba a cikin bayanin
n-m-h3-diffc-06.thinking.1: Duba ta da misalin da ya nuna akasin haka
n-m-h3-diffc-06.thinking.2: Sake rubuta domin ta dace da mai sauraro
n-m-h3-diffc-06.prereq.1: Derivative na biyu shi ne derivative na derivative
n-m-h3-diffc-06.prereq.2: Ma'anar lanƙwasawa ƙasa (concave up) da lanƙwasawa sama (concave down)
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi jimla guda ɗaya marar daidai a amsar Jihu.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.hint.0: Bi yadda kowace jimla take ci gaba daga wadda ta gabata, ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunani kan alamar wane aiki kake buƙatar sani domin ka ce “ƙimar tana ƙaruwa.”
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.line.0: Idan f″(x)>0 ne, derivative f′(x) tana ƙaruwa.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.line.1: Kasancewar f′(x) tana ƙaruwa yana nufin gangarar layin tangent tana ƙara girma.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.line.2: Saboda haka a wani tazara da f″(x)>0, ƙimar f(x) ma tana ƙaruwa yayin tafiya zuwa dama.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.line.3: A wannan yanayin, jadawalin yana lanƙwasawa ƙasa.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s1.explain: Jimla ta 3 ba daidai ba ce. Alamar f′(x) ce ke ƙayyade ko ƙimar f(x) tana ƙaruwa ko raguwa. f″>0 yana gaya mana kawai cewa f′ tana ƙaruwa. Saboda haka a wani tazara da f′ take mara kyau, f(x) na iya raguwa duk da cewa f″>0.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.prompt: Wane aiki da tazara ne ke nuna mafi sarari cewa jimla ta 3 ba daidai ba ce?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.hint.0: Misalin da ke nuna akasin haka shi ne yanayin da “sharadi na farko yake gaskiya amma ƙarshe ba gaskiya ba ne.” Ga kowane aiki, duba daban alamar f″ da ko f yana ƙaruwa.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ga kowace zaɓi, nemo alamar f′ ma.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.a: A wannan tazara f″=2>0 ne, kuma f yana ƙaruwa, saboda haka wannan ba ya karyata magana ta 3.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.b: f″=2>0 amma f′=2x<0 ne, saboda haka f yana raguwa. Wannan misali ne da ke karyata magana ta 3.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.c: f″=−2<0 ne, saboda haka ba yanayin f″>0 ba ne.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.r.d: f″=6x>0 ne, kuma f yana ƙaruwa, saboda haka wannan ba ya karyata magana ta 3.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s2.explain: Ga f(x)=x² idan x<0, f″(x)=2>0 amma f′(x)=2x<0, saboda haka f(x) yana raguwa. Jadawalin yana da lanƙwasar sama amma yana gangarawa ƙasa.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.prompt: Sake rubuta magana ta 3 ta yadda Haeun za ta fahimta. Ya ƙunshi abin da f″(x)>0 yake gaya maka, da abin da ke tantance ko f(x) yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta a ginshiƙai biyu abin da f″>0 yake gaya maka da abin da ba ya gaya maka.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.hint.1: Duba misalin da ke karyata magana daga matakin baya, sannan ka gano ko abin da ke tantance “hawa ko sauka” alamar f, f′, ko f″ ce.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Idan f″(x)>0, to ... amma ko f yana ƙaruwa ...
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana abin da f″>0 yake gaya maka dangane da gangare ko lanƙwasa?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta cewa alamar f′ ce ke tantance ƙaruwa da raguwa?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka ba da misali da Haeun za ta iya bi ta kallon alamomi kawai?
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.model.0: Idan f″(x)>0, gangaren layin tangenti yana ƙaruwa kullum kuma jadawalin yana lanƙwasawa sama. Amma alamar f′(x) ce ke tantance ko f(x) yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa. Misali, ga f(x)=x², f″=2>0 idan x<0, amma f′=2x<0, saboda haka yana raguwa.
n-m-h3-diffc-06.s.s3.model.1: f″>0 yana nufin f′ yana ƙaruwa, wato gangaren yana ƙaruwa. Ko jadawalin yana hawa zuwa dama kuwa yana dogara ne da ko gangaren yana da kyau, wato ko f′>0. Idan gangaren mara kyau ne kuma yana ƙaruwa, jadawalin yana gangarawa amma f″>0 ne har yanzu.

n-m-h3-prob-04.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri misalai da dama da suka cika sharuɗɗan.
n-m-h3-prob-04.topic: Yiwuwar: sharaɗantaccen yiwuwa, independence da dogaro, tunanin Bayes, tsara sample space
n-m-h3-prob-04.title: Saka tabarau da shiga ƙungiya: Gina Teburin Halaye Marasa Alaƙa
n-m-h3-prob-04.goal: Ka ƙirƙiri tebura 2×2 da dama inda al'amura biyu masu zaman kansu ne, sannan ka bincika yadda ake karanta zaman kai a matsayin 'adadin cikin rukuni daidai suke.'
n-m-h3-prob-04.material: Za ka gina teburin ƙirga ɗalibai 60 na aji bisa 'ko suna saka tabarau' da 'ko sun shiga ƙungiya.'
n-m-h3-prob-04.thinking.0: Fassara ma'anar zaman kai zuwa tebur
n-m-h3-prob-04.thinking.2: Bayyana zaman kai ta hanyar kwatanta adadi
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.prompt: An rarraba ɗalibai 60 bisa 'saka tabarau' da 'shiga ƙungiya.' Wane bayani ne ya fi bayyana ma'anar zaman kansu ga waɗannan biyun?
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.hint.0: Yi tunanin ko cikin masu tabarau kaɗai, kaso na waɗanda suka shiga ƙungiya ya yi daidai da kaso na shiga gaba ɗaya.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.hint.1: Idan suna zaman kansu, dole ne 'sanin ko ɗalibi yana saka tabarau ba ya sauya yiwuwar shiga ƙungiya' ya zama gaskiya. Duba ko kowane zaɓi yana faɗin hakan.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.o.a: Adadin masu saka tabarau ya yi daidai da marasa saka.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.r.a: Ka ɗauka girman rukuni ne zai yi daidai. Zaman kai yana magana ne kan adadi cikin rukuni, ba girman rukuni ba.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.o.b: Adadin membobi cikin masu saka tabarau ya yi daidai da cikin marasa sakawa.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.r.b: Ka kwatanta jimillar mutane. Idan girman rukuni ya bambanta, adadin zai bambanta ko da yawan mutane ya yi daidai.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.o.c: Kason membobi cikin masu saka tabarau ya yi daidai da na marasa saka.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.o.d: Duk mai tabarau ya shiga, duk wanda ba shi da tabarau kuma bai shiga ba.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.r.d: Ka ɗauki halaye biyu da suke faruwa tare kullum a matsayin masu zaman kansu. Wannan ita ce dangantaka mafi ƙarfi, inda sanin ɗaya ke ƙayyade ɗayan.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s1.explain: Idan kaso na shiga ƙungiya cikin masu tabarau ya yi daidai da na marasa tabarau, sanin ko ɗalibi yana saka tabarau ba ya sauya yiwuwar shiga. Wato P(join|glasses)=P(join), wanda yake daidai da P(glasses∩join)=P(glasses)P(join).
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.prompt: Ka gina tebura ga ɗalibai 60. Bari a=yawan masu tabarau da suka shiga, b=masu tabarau da ba su shiga ba, c=marasa tabarau da suka shiga, d=marasa tabarau da ba su shiga ba. Duk lambobi huɗun su zama lambobin halitta aƙalla 1, jimillarsu 60, saka tabarau da shiga ƙungiya su zama masu zaman kansu, kuma yawan masu tabarau ya bambanta da yawan membobi. Shigar da tebura 3 daban-daban.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko yanke shawarar yawan masu tabarau x da yawan membobi y. Idan suna zaman kansu, yawan a na masu tabarau da suka shiga dole ya zama x×y÷60.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi x da y ta yadda a ya zama lamba cikakkiya, sannan cika b,c,d domin jimilla ta zama 60, ka duba adadin membobi na rukunan biyu daidai suke.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Dukkan lambobi huɗu lambobin halitta ne aƙalla 1.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a,b,c,d duk lambobin halitta ne aƙalla 1.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Jimillar lambobin huɗun ba 60 ba ce.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Saka tabarau da shiga ƙungiya suna zaman kansu (P(glasses∩join)=P(glasses)P(join)).
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Ba su zaman kansu ba. Kwatanta adadin membobi na masu tabarau da na marasa tabarau.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.ok.c4: Yawan masu tabarau ya bambanta da yawan membobi.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.fail.c4: Yawan masu tabarau ya yi daidai da yawan membobi.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.explain: (10,10,20,20): cikin masu tabarau 20, 10 sun shiga (1/2); cikin marasa tabarau 40, 20 sun shiga (1/2), saboda haka adadin ya yi daidai. A (5,15,10,30), rukunan biyu suna da adadin shiga 1/4; a (12,18,12,18) kuma 2/5. A (10,10,10,30), adadin masu tabarau 1/2 ne amma na marasa tabarau 1/4, don haka ba su zaman kansu. (15,15,15,15) yana da zaman kai, amma masu tabarau sun yi daidai da membobi, saboda haka bai cika sharadi na 4 ba.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Zaɓi tebur ɗaya daga naka, nemo ka rubuta adadin shiga cikin masu tabarau da marasa tabarau, ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa wannan shaida ce ta zaman kai.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: A teburin da ka zaɓa, fara rubuta yawan masu tabarau da marasa tabarau, sannan ka raba yawan membobi a kowane rukuni da yawan ɗaliban rukuni.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Rubuta adadin biyu gefe da gefe, kwatanta ko sun yi daidai, sannan ka haɗa wannan da ma'anar zaman kai.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.placeholder: misali, cikin masu tabarau, adadin shiga ƙungiya shi ne ...
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ga kowane rukuni biyu, ka nemo adadin ta raba yawan membobi da yawan ɗaliban rukunin?
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka haɗa daidaiton adadi da ra'ayin cewa saka tabarau ba ya sauya yiwuwar shiga ƙungiya?
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Cikin masu tabarau 20, 10 sun shiga, saboda haka adadin 1/2 ne; cikin marasa tabarau 40, 20 sun shiga, don haka 1/2 ne kuma. Da yake adadin biyu daidai suke, sanin ko ɗalibi yana saka tabarau ba ya sauya yiwuwar shiga, saboda haka suna zaman kansu.
n-m-h3-prob-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Rukunan masu tabarau da marasa tabarau duk suna da adadin shiga 50%. Saboda haka saka tabarau ba ya shafar yiwuwar shiga ƙungiya; za mu iya cewa suna zaman kansu.

n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko da ya yi kuskure a mafitar Seoyeon.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.title: Bambanci na biyu na lanƙwasa da aka bayar ta siga.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.topic: Diferenshiyal: bambanci na biyu na aiki da aka bayar ta siga.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.goal: Ga lanƙwasa da aka bayar ta siga, nemo kuma ka gyara kuskure a mafitar da ta sake bambanta dy/dx, sannan ka zaɓi dabara madaidaiciya.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.material: Wannan ita ce mafitar Seoyeon wajen nemo bambanci na biyu d²y/dx² a t=2 ga lanƙwasar x=t², y=t³−3t (t>0). (t² murabba’in t ne, t³ kuma kubin t ne.)
n-m-h3-diffc-07.thinking.0: Nemo layin farko da kuskure ya fara a cikin mafita.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.thinking.1: Sake nemo ƙimar ta amfani da hanyar da ta dace.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.thinking.2: Kwatanta tsarin furucin domin zaɓar dabara madaidaiciya.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.hint.0: Tabbatar cewa dy/dx a layi na 2 furuci ne a cikin t, sannan ka yi tunanin yadda za a rubuta aikin bambance shi game da x ta amfani da ka’idar sarkar.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.hint.1: Bayyana da kalmomi bambancin da kowane layi yake nema, sannan ka gwada ko ya biyo bisa ƙa’ida daga layin baya da misali mai sauƙi kamar x=t², y=t³.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne layin farko da ba daidai ba. dy/dx furuci ne a cikin t, saboda haka domin bambance shi game da x, dole ne ka fara bambance shi game da t sannan ka raba da dx/dt. Bambance y da x sau biyu sannan a raba ba wannan lissafin ba ne. Layi na 4 kawai ya yi amfani da sakamakon layi na 3.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ƙimar d²y/dx² a t=2 ta amfani da hanyar da ta dace, sannan ka rubuta yadda ka same ta.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.hint.0: Sauƙaƙa dy/dx a matsayin furuci a cikin t, sannan ka bambance wannan furuci game da t.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.hint.1: Domin bambance game da x, yi amfani da dx/dt domin gane abin da za ka raba bambancin da ka yi game da t da shi.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka fara sauƙaƙa dy/dx a matsayin furuci a cikin t?
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bambance furucin game da t sannan ka raba da dx/dt?
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka duba ta hanyar saka ƙimar 15/32 kai tsaye?
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.model.0: dy/dx=(3t²−3)/(2t)=(3/2)(t−1/t), kuma bambance wannan game da t yana ba da (3/2)(1+1/t²). Raba wannan da dx/dt=2t domin samun d²y/dx². A t=2, (3/2)(5/4)=15/8; idan aka raba da 4, ana samun 15/32.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s2.model.1: d²y/dx²=(d/dt(dy/dx))÷(dx/dt). Saka t=2 cikin d/dt{(3/2)(t−1/t)}=(3/2)(1+1/t²) yana ba da 15/8, sannan idan aka raba da dx/dt=4 ana samun 15/32.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.prompt: Zaɓi dabara madaidaiciya domin nemo d²y/dx² ga lanƙwasa da aka bayar ta siga.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta abin da za a iya karanta d²y/dx² a matsayin: “ana bambance me game da me”.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.hint.1: Yi amfani da ka’idar sarkar domin tunanin abin da dole ne ka ninka ko raba da shi domin sauya bambancewa game da t zuwa bambancewa game da x.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.a: Raba y da aka bambanta sau biyu game da t da x da aka bambanta sau biyu game da t.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.a: Wannan ita ce hanyar da Seoyeon ta yi amfani da ita. Rabo tsakanin ƙimomin da aka bambanta sau biyu game da t ya bambanta da dy/dx da aka bambanta game da x.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.b: Raba dy/dx da aka bambanta sau ɗaya game da t da x da aka bambanta sau ɗaya game da t.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.b: Wannan yana bayyana aikin bambance dy/dx game da x ta amfani da ka’idar sarkar.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.c: Raba dy/dx da aka bambanta sau ɗaya game da t da x da aka bambanta sau biyu game da t.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.c: Ka saka bambanci na biyu na x a ƙasan rabon. Domin sauya zuwa bambancewa game da x, ana raba da dx/dt sau ɗaya.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.o.d: Raba dy/dx da aka bambanta sau ɗaya game da t da murabba’in x da aka bambanta sau ɗaya game da t.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.r.d: Ka ɗauki ƙasan rabon zuwa murabba’i. A ka’idar sarkar, abin da ka raba da shi domin sauya bambancewa game da t zuwa game da x shi ne dx/dt sau ɗaya kawai.
n-m-h3-diffc-07.s.s3.explain: d²y/dx²=d/dx(dy/dx)=[d/dt(dy/dx)]·(dt/dx)=[d/dt(dy/dx)]÷(dx/dt). A t=2, dabarun da ke sama suna bayar da 6, 15/16, da 15/128 bi da bi, kuma duk sun bambanta da madaidaiciyar ƙima 15/32.

n-m-h3-conic-03.topic: Sassan mazugi: ma’anoni da layukan tangenti na parabola, ellips, da hyperbola; alaƙa tsakanin siffofi da lissafinsu.
n-m-h3-conic-03.title: Ta yaya hanyar maki P ke canzawa idan maki F ya motsa?
n-m-h3-conic-03.goal: Tabbatar daga ma’anoni cewa a wannan ginin, sauya matsayin maki F yana sauya hanyar maki zuwa da’ira, ellips, ko hyperbola; ka saba da guje wa ɗaukar ƙarshe daga wani yanayi ka yi amfani da shi ba tare da sauyi a wani yanayin ba.
n-m-h3-conic-03.material: A cikin fili akwai da’ira mai cibiyar O da radius 6, da maki F. Ga maki Q da ke motsi a kan da’irar, bari P ya zama wurin da rabin layin da ke a tsaye da sashen FQ ya haɗu da layin OQ. Za mu binciki siffar da P ke bi yayin da Q ke zagaya da’irar, muna sauya matsayin F.
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.0: Sake duba hukuncinka a duk lokacin da sharadin ya canza.
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.1: Nemo hanyar maki ta amfani da jimilla da bambancin nisa.
n-m-h3-conic-03.thinking.2: Lura da haɗarin faɗaɗa ƙarshe daga yanayi na musamman (F=O).
n-m-h3-conic-03.prereq.0: Ma’anar ellips da hyperbola (jimillar nisa, bambancin nisa).
n-m-h3-conic-03.prereq.1: Ka’idar cewa maki da ke kan rabin layin da ya tsaya a tsaye da sashi yana da nisa iri ɗaya daga ƙarshen sashen biyun.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya yayin da matsayin maki F ke canzawa. A kowane mataki, zaɓi hukunci bisa abin da ka sani zuwa lokacin kawai.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.hint.0: A duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana, zana hoto da ke nuna inda maki P yake a kan sashen OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.hint.1: Yi amfani da PF=PQ domin duba ko jimilla ko bambancin PO da PF yana sauƙaƙa zuwa ƙima tabbatacciya.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Da farko ka yi la’akari da yanayin da F yake daidai da cibiyar O. Maki a kan rabin layin da ya tsaya a tsaye da sashen FQ yana da nisa iri ɗaya daga F da Q, saboda haka PF=PQ. Maki P yana kan layin OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yayin da Q ke zagaya da’irar sau ɗaya, wace siffa ce P ke bi?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Idan F=O, to PO=PQ kuma PO+PQ=OQ=6, saboda haka PO=3. P maki ne mai nisa 3 daga O, don haka yana bin da’ira mai radius 3.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Da’ira mai cibiyar O da radius 6.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka sake faɗin da’irar da Q ke bi kawai. P ba Q ba ne; maki ne a kan rabin layin da ya tsaya a tsaye da FQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Da’ira mai cibiyar O da radius 3.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka lura cewa nisan P daga O ba ya canzawa.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ellips mai O da wani maki a matsayin foci.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Har yanzu ba mu kai yanayin da foci biyu suke ba. F da O maki ɗaya ne.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Yayin da Q ke motsi, P ma yana motsi.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.info: An matsar da F zuwa maki a cikin da’irar mai nisa 4 daga O. Har yanzu PF=PQ gaskiya ne. Idan ka zana hoton, P yana kan sashen OQ (tsakanin O da Q).
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yanzu wace hanya ce P ke bi?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yanzu wace hanya ce P ke bi?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Tunda P yana kan sashen OQ, PO+PF=PO+PQ=OQ=6. Jimillar nisan daga maki O da F guda biyu ƙima tabbatacciya 6 ce; saboda haka ellips ce mai foci O da F, kuma tsawon babban axisi 6 ne.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Har yanzu da’ira ce mai cibiyar O, domin Q yana kan da’irar.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Idan F ya bar O, PO ba ya da ƙima tabbatacciya. Ka ɗauko ƙarshe daga matakin da ya gabata ba tare da canza shi ba.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Hyperbola mai bambancin nisa tabbatacce daga O da F.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Hyperbola mai bambancin nisa tabbatacce daga O da F.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ba ka bincika ko ana tara PO da PF ko ana cire ɗaya daga ɗaya ba. Yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa P yana kan sashen OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ellips mai jimillar nisa tabbatacciya daga O da F.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka lura cewa jimillar tabbatacciya ce, tunda PO+PF=PO+PQ=OQ.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Parabola mai maki da ke da nisa iri ɗaya daga F da wani layi.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Daidaiton nisan yana tsakanin F da Q (PF=PQ), kuma nisa daga maki Q ake nufi, ba daga layi ba.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.info: A wannan karon an matsar da F zuwa maki a wajen da’irar, mai nisa 9 daga O. Idan ka zana hoton, P ba ya kan sashen OQ; yana kan tsawaita layin OQ (a gefen Q ko gefen O). Har yanzu PF=PQ gaskiya ne.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.after: A kan tsawaita layin gefen Q, PO=OQ+PQ ne, don haka PO−PF=6; a kan tsawaita layin gefen O kuma PF−PO=6. A kowane hali, |PO−PF|=6 yana nan daram, saboda haka lanƙwasar hyperbola ce mai wuraren mai da hankali O da F, da tsawon babban axis 6 (OF=9>6).
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ellipse mai jimilla tabbatacciya, kamar yanayin ciki
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka yi amfani da sakamakon yanayin ciki ba tare da sauyi ba. Idan P ba ya kan sashen OQ, PO+PQ ba daidai yake da OQ ba.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Duba ko PO yana nan daram. Idan F yana nesa da O, PO ba ya nan daram.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ba a tantance ko wane batu ba.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Layin tsaye-tsakiyar yanki da layin OQ suna haɗuwa ga kusan duk Q.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s1.reflect: Yayin da matsayin F ke sauyawa, ginin iri ɗaya ya bayar da da’ira, ellipse, sannan hyperbola. Yin amfani da sakamakon ciki a wajen da’ira ba tare da sauyi ba kuskure ne. Ya danganta da ko batu P yana kan sashen OQ ko kan tsawaitarsa, ko jimillar ko bambancin PO da PF ne yake nan daram.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.prompt: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa wurin dukkan P ya bambanta idan F yana cikin da’ira da idan F yana wajenta, ta amfani da PO, PF da radius 6 na da’irar.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.hint.0: Faɗi inda P yake a kan layin OQ a yanayin ciki da kuma a yanayin waje.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.hint.1: A kowane yanayi, haɗa alaƙar PO da PQ da tsawon 6.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta cewa PO+PF=6 a ciki, kuma |PO−PF|=6 a waje?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana cewa jimilla da bambanci sun rabu ne saboda matsayin P ya bambanta (a kan sashen ko kan tsawaita layin)?
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.model.0: Idan F yana ciki, P yana kan sashen OQ, saboda haka PO+PF=PO+PQ=6, jimilla tana nan daram, kuma lanƙwasar ellipse ce. Idan F yana waje, P yana kan tsawaita layin, saboda haka bambancin PO da PQ shi ne 6, bambancin PO da PF ma bambanci ne tabbatacce mai ƙima 6, kuma lanƙwasar hyperbola ce.
n-m-h3-conic-03.s.s2.model.1: Idan F yana cikin da’ira, jimillar tazara daga O da F ita ce 6, saboda haka ellipse ce; idan F yana wajen da’ira, cikakkiyar ƙimar bambancin tazarorin ita ce 6, saboda haka hyperbola ce. Dalili shi ne P yana sauyawa daga kasancewa a kan sashen zuwa kan tsawaita layin.

n-m-h3-conic-06.topic: Sassan mazugi: ma’anoni da layukan tangenti na parabola, ellips, da hyperbola; alaƙa tsakanin siffofi da lissafinsu.
n-m-h3-conic-06.title: Ina wuraren mai da hankali da layin jagora suke idan aka matsar da parabola?
n-m-h3-conic-06.goal: Karanta alkiblar matsawa daidai daga daidaito, matsar da wurin mai da hankali da layin jagora da wannan matsawar, sannan ka rubuta bayani ga ƙaramin ɗalibi.
n-m-h3-conic-06.material: Ƙaramar ƙanwarka Haeun ta aiko maka da saƙo yayin da take neman wurin mai da hankali da layin jagora na parabola (y−1)²=−8(x+2).
n-m-h3-conic-06.thinking.0: Karanta yadda alamomin daidaiton suka nuna alkiblar matsawa
n-m-h3-conic-06.thinking.2: Sake tsara bayanin domin ya dace da wanda kake yi wa bayani
n-m-h3-conic-06.prereq.0: Wurin mai da hankali da layin jagora na parabola y²=4px
n-m-h3-conic-06.prereq.1: Matsawa da yadda daidaito ke sauyawa
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.prompt: Wannan shi ne saƙon da ƙaramar ƙanwarka Haeun ta aiko. Zaɓi layin farko da ya yi kuskure.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko nemo maki a sabon daidaito inda ɓangarorin biyu suka zama 0. Kwatanta da wurin da wannan matsayin yake a tsohon daidaito.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.hint.1: Bambance ko ƙididdigar kowane layi ta biyo daga layin da ya gabata ko kuma sabon hukunci ne.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.0: Ga y²=−8x, 4p=−8, don haka p=−2, wurin mai da hankali shi ne (−2, 0), layin jagora kuma x=2.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.1: (y−1)²=−8(x+2) yana da x+2 da y−1, saboda haka matsawar y²=−8x ce da +2 a alkiblar x, da −1 a alkiblar y.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.2: Matsar da wurin mai da hankali daidai da haka yana ba da (−2+2, 0−1)=(0,−1).
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.3: Matsar da layin jagora daidai da haka yana ba da x=2+2=4.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.line.4: Saboda haka wurin mai da hankali shi ne (0,−1), layin jagora kuma x=4.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 ne. Saka x+2 a maimakon x yana matsar da −2 a alkiblar x, saka y−1 kuma yana matsar da +1 a alkiblar y. Alamomin suna akasin juna. Duk abin da ke layi na 3 zuwa gaba ƙididdiga ce bisa alkiblar da aka faɗa a layi na 2; idan alkiblar ba daidai ba ce, dukansu ba daidai ba ne. Layi na 1 daidai ne.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi hanya mafi aminci da za a tabbatar ko alkiblar matsawar Haeun daidai ce.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin sifar da maki mai matsayin kololuwa na daidaito na asali zai samu a cikin sabon daidaiton siffar da aka matsar.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.hint.1: Da farko ka tuna ko wurin mai da hankali da layin jagora suna kan lanƙwasar.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.a: Saka wurin mai da hankali da aka samu, (0,−1), domin duba ko yana cika sabon daidaito (y−1)²=−8(x+2).
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.a: Wurin mai da hankali ba maki ne a kan lanƙwasar ba, saboda haka ba dole ne ya cika daidaiton idan aka saka shi ba. Wannan bincike ba zai iya gaya maka alkiblar matsawar ba.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.b: Kwatanta ko ma’aunin −8 a sabon daidaito iri ɗaya ne da ma’aunin da ke cikin daidaito na asali.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.b: Ma’aunin yana bayyana sifar lanƙwasar (alkiblar buɗewa da faɗinta) kawai. Ba ya bayyana ta wace hanya aka matsar da wurin.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.c: Nemo maki da ke sa ɓangarorin biyu na sabon daidaito 0, sannan ka duba ko shi ne wurin da kololuwar asali (0, 0) ta koma.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.o.d: Zana jadawali a taƙaice, ka duba ko alkiblar buɗewarsa iri ɗaya ce da ta farko.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.r.d: Matsawa ba ta sauya alkiblar buɗewa, saboda haka sifar tana kama da farko ko da alkiblar matsawar ba daidai ba ce.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s2.explain: Kololuwa ita ce maki (0, 0) da ke sa ɓangarorin biyu na tsohon daidaito 0. Saboda haka maki (−2, 1) da ke sa ɓangarorin biyu na sabon daidaito 0 shi ne inda kololuwar ta koma. Don haka matsawar ita ce −2 a axis x da +1 a axis y. Wurin mai da hankali da layin jagora ba su kan lanƙwasar, saboda haka ba za a iya gwada su ta hanyar sakawa a cikin daidaito ba.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.prompt: Haeun ɗalibar shekarar farko ce a makarantar sakandare wadda ta fara koyon matsawa. Rubuta amsar da za ka aika mata. Dole ta ƙunshi inda kuskuren ya faru, alkiblar matsawa daidai, wurin mai da hankali da layin jagora daidai, da hanyar dubawa.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.hint.0: Tsara jerin amsar: inda kuskuren ya faru, gyaran matsawa, wurin mai da hankali da layin jagora, yadda za a bincika.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.hint.1: Ta amfani da matsawar da aka gyara, matsar da kololuwa, wurin mai da hankali da layin jagora na daidaito na asali.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka nuna inda kuskuren ya faru da kalmomin da Haeun za ta fahimta?
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka nuna yadda wurin mai da hankali da layin jagora suka motsa daga tsoffin matsayinsu?
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: An haɗa hanyar dubawa a cikin amsar?
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.model.0: Haeun, alkiblar layi na 2 ta juya. Saka x+2 a maimakon x yana matsar da jadawali da −2 a alkiblar x; saka y−1 kuma yana matsar da shi da +1 a alkiblar y. Maki a sabon daidaito da ke sa ɓangarorin biyu 0 shi ne (−2, 1), don haka za ka ga kololuwa ta koma daga (0, 0) zuwa nan. Saboda haka wurin mai da hankali (−2, 0) ya koma (−4, 1), layin jagora x=2 kuma ya koma x=0.
n-m-h3-conic-06.s.s3.model.1: Haeun, alkiblar matsawa a layi na 2 ba daidai ba ce. (x+2) yana matsar da 2 zuwa hagu, (y−1) kuma yana matsar da 1 zuwa sama. Za ka iya tabbatar da kololuwar ita ce (−2, 1) ta saka ƙimomin. Saboda haka wurin mai da hankali shi ne (−4, 1), layin jagora kuma x=0.

n-m-h3-diffc-01.title: Yaya za a karanta gangaren da ƙasansa ya zama 0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.topic: Diferenshiyal: bambance-bambance a fakaice da layukan tangenti a wuraren da gangare ba a bayyana ba.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.goal: Bincika ko layin tangenti yana wanzuwa a wurin da ƙasan gangaren da aka samu ta implicit differentiation yake 0, sannan ka nemo kuma ka gyara ƙarshe marar daidai a cikin mafita.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.material: Wannan ita ce mafitar Hayoon wajen nemo layin tangenti a maki P(2, −1) na lanƙwasar C: x²+xy+y²=3. (x² da y² suna nufin x murabba’i da y murabba’i. An tabbatar cewa P yana kan C ta 4−2+1=3.)
n-m-h3-diffc-01.thinking.0: Nemo layin da bai dace ba a mafitar.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.thinking.1: Fassara layin tangenti a wurin da ba a bayyana gangare a matsayin siffar jadawalin.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.thinking.2: Zaɓi sharuddan da za a bincika kafin yanke ƙarshe.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.prereq.0: Implicit differentiation (ɗauki y a matsayin aiki na x, sannan ka bambance ɓangarorin biyu game da x).
n-m-h3-diffc-01.prereq.1: Nemo lissafin layin tangenti a maki kan lanƙwasa.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko da ba daidai ba a mafitar Hayoon.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.hint.0: Karanta kowanne layi daga sama, ka duba ta ƙididdiga kai tsaye ko ya biyo daga layin da ke gabansa.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta ko ƙarshe a layi na ƙarshe yana nufin abu ɗaya da abin da aka gano a layin baya (abin da ba a bayyana ba).
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.0: Bambancewar ɓangarorin biyu game da x tana ba da 2x + (y + x·y′) + 2y·y′ = 0.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.1: Warwarewa game da y′ yana ba da y′ = −(2x + y)/(x + 2y).
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.2: Saka P(2, −1), ƙasan x+2y ya zama 2+2·(−1)=0; saboda haka ba a bayyana gangaren ba.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka babu layin tangenti a maki P.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 4 ba daidai ba ne. Lissafin layi na 1 zuwa 3 daidai ne. Amma “ba a bayyana furucin gangare ba” yana nufin “babu lamba da ake kira gangare,” ba wai babu layin tangenti ba. Lamba ta sama 2x+y=3 ba 0 ba ce, saboda haka gangaren na iya ƙaruwa ba iyaka; wato ana iya samun layin tangenti da yake layi ɗaya da axis y.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.prompt: Idan akwai layin tangenti ga lanƙwasar C a maki P, rubuta lissafinsa, sannan ka rubuta dalilin hukuncinka.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ƙididdige ƙimar da lamba ta sama take ɗauka idan ƙasan lamba 0 ne, sannan ka yi tunanin yadda gangaren ke girma.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zana yadda layin da gangarensa ke ƙaruwa ba iyaka yake kama a faifan haɗin, sannan ka rubuta lissafin layin nan da ya ratsa P.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: Idan aka kalli alkiblar layin tangenti ...
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka duba cewa ƙasan lamba 0 ne amma lambar sama ba 0 ba ce?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka saka x=2 cikin lissafin lanƙwasar ka duba yadda lanƙwasar da layin suke haɗuwa?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Za ka iya bayyana bambanci tsakanin “babu gangare” da “babu layin tangenti”?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.model.0: Ƙasan lamba 0 ne kuma lambar sama 3 ce, saboda haka gangaren yana ƙaruwa ba iyaka. Layin tangenti shi ne x=2, wanda yake layi ɗaya da axis y. Saka x=2 cikin lanƙwasar yana ba da y²+2y+1=0, saboda haka y=−1 ne kawai mafita; wannan yana nufin layin ya taɓa lanƙwasar a maki P kawai, wanda ya dace.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.model.1: Akwai layin tangenti. Ba a bayyana gangaren ba domin layin tangenti a tsaye yake, kuma lissafinsa x=2 ne. Na kuma duba cewa lambar sama 2x+y ita ce 3, ba 0 ba, saboda haka ba nau’in 0/0 ba ne.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ya isa a duba lambar sama, ko da ba a yi amfani da hanyar saka x=2 a cikin lanƙwasar ba.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.prompt: Me ya kamata ka duba kafin ka yanke cewa “akwai layin tangenti a tsaye” a wurin da ƙasan furucin gangare yake 0?
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.hint.0: A tsarin y′ = (lamba ta sama)/(lamba ta ƙasa), kwatanta yadda rabon yake idan lamba ta ƙasa 0 ce, kuma ƙimar lambar sama ta bambanta.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.hint.1: Shin yanayin 0/0 da 3/0 iri ɗaya ne? Ka yi tunanin abin da kowanne yake nunawa.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.a: Ko idan lambar ƙasa 0 ce, lambar sama ita ma ba 0 ba ce (wato ba nau’in 0/0 ba ne).
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.a: Ka yi tunanin duba lambar sama ma.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.b: Ko ƙimar y ba ta zama mara kyau ba idan maki yana kan lanƙwasar.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.b: Alamar y ba ta da alaƙa da wanzuwar layin tangenti. Wataƙila ka gauraya alamar haɗin da alkiblar layin tangenti.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.c: Ko ƙimar da aka bambanta sau biyu y″ ba 0 ba ce.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.c: Bambanci na biyu yana gaya maka alkiblar karkatar lanƙwasar ne kawai; ba ya yanke shawarar wanzuwar layin tangenti.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.o.d: Ko za a iya rubuta lanƙwasar a matsayin y = (wani furuci a cikin x).
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.r.d: Layin tangenti yana wanzuwa ko da ba za a iya rubuta aikin a fakaice a matsayin y=f(x) ba. Ba a buƙatar wannan sharadi.
n-m-h3-diffc-01.s.s3.explain: Ko da ƙasan lamba 0 ne, idan lambar sama ba 0 ba ce, gangaren yana ƙaruwa ba iyaka kuma layin tangenti a tsaye yana bayyana. Idan lambar sama ma 0 ce, yanayin 0/0 ne, don haka wannan furuci kaɗai ba ya yanke hukunci; dole ne a duba siffar lanƙwasar a wannan wurin ta wata hanya.

n-m-h3-diffc-02.title: A lokacin da saurin motsi ya zama 0, shin maki yana juyawa?
n-m-h3-diffc-02.topic: Diferenshiyal: sauri da hanzari, da sharuddan sauyin alkibla.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.goal: Fahimci ta hanyar sauyin alamar sauri bambanci tsakanin lokacin da saurin ya zama 0 da lokacin da alkiblar motsi ta canza; ƙirƙiri da kanka furucin sauri da ya cika sharuddan, sannan ka tabbatar da shi.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.material: Saurin maki P da ke motsi a kan layin lambobi a lokacin t (t≥0) shi ne v(t), kuma v(1)=0. Minsu ya ce, “A lokacin da saurin ya zama 0, maki tabbas yana canza alkibla.” (Canza alkibla yana nufin motsi daga dama zuwa hagu ko daga hagu zuwa dama. Idan sauri tabbatacce ne, yana motsi zuwa dama; idan mara kyau ne, zuwa hagu.)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.thinking.1: Gina furucin sauri da ya cika sharuddan sannan ka tabbatar da shi.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.thinking.2: Bambanta abin da za a iya yanke hukunci daga ƙimar sauri da hanzari kaɗai.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.prereq.0: Dangantakar matsayi, sauri, da hanzari (sauri shi ne bambancin matsayi, hanzari kuma shi ne bambancin sauri).
n-m-h3-diffc-02.prereq.1: Dangantakar alamar sauri da alkiblar motsi.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.prereq.2: Sauyin alamar furuci da aka rubuta a matsayin ninkawa.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi magana mai ma’ana ɗaya da “maki P yana canza alkibla a lokacin t₀.”
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko rubuta alkiblar da maki ke motsawa idan sauri tabbatacce ne da kuma idan mara kyau ne.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin abin da alamar sauri dole ta yi domin alkibla ta canza, sannan ka kwatanta da yanayin da sauri ya zama 0 sannan ya koma alama iri ɗaya.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.o.a: Hanzari a t₀ ba 0 ba ne.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.a: Ko da hanzari ba 0 ba ne, idan sauri ba 0 ba ne alkiblar tana nan yadda take. Wataƙila ka gauraya sauri da hanzari.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.o.b: Matsayi a t₀ ya fi matsayi a duk lokutan da suka gabace shi da kuma suka biyo bayansa.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.b: Wannan yana la’akari da lokacin da matsayi ya kai mafi girma (ƙarshen dama) kawai. Ya bar yanayin juyawa a ƙarshen hagu.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.c: v(t₀)=0 siffa guda ce kawai ta lokacin canjin alkibla, ba daidai yake da maganar cewa alkibla ta canza ba. Ka yi tunanin yanayin da v=0 amma alamar ta kasance iri ɗaya.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.o.d: Alamomin sauri kafin da bayan t₀ sun bambanta.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.r.d: Ka fahimci sauyin alkibla ta hanyar sauyin alamar sauri.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s1.explain: Alkibla tana canzawa idan alamar sauri ta canza daga tabbatacce zuwa mara kyau ko daga mara kyau zuwa tabbatacce. Saurin zama 0 sharadi ne na dole da ke faruwa a lokacin sauyin alama, amma ba isasshen sharadi ba ne.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.prompt: Idan saurin v(t)=(t−1)^m (t−p)^n ne, shigar da nau’i-nau’i uku ko fiye na (m, n, p) mabambanta da suka cika waɗannan duka: maki P ba ya canza alkibla a t=1, amma yana canza alkibla a t=p. (m da n lambobin natural ne daga 1 zuwa 6, p kuma lambar natural ce daga 2 zuwa 9.)
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.hint.0: Gwada ƙimomi da dama na m da n, sannan ka yi tebur na alamun (t−1)^m da (t−p)^n kafin da bayan t=1 da t=p.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.hint.1: Raba zuwa yanayin da ma’aunin ƙarfin lamba yake even ko odd, sannan ka kwatanta ko alamar tana nan iri ɗaya ko tana bambanta kafin da bayan wurin.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c1: m, n, da p lambobin natural ne cikin iyakokinsu.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne su zama lambobin natural masu 1≤m≤6, 1≤n≤6, 2≤p≤9.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Alamar sauri iri ɗaya ce kafin da bayan t=1.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Alamar sauri tana canzawa kafin da bayan t=1, saboda haka maki yana canza alkibla.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Alamar sauri ta bambanta kafin da bayan t=p.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Alamar sauri iri ɗaya ce kafin da bayan t=p, saboda haka maki ba ya canza alkibla.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.explain: Idan ma’aunin ƙarfin lamba na (t−1) even ne, wannan ɓangaren yana da alama iri ɗaya kafin da bayan t=1; idan na (t−p) odd ne, alamar tana bambanta kafin da bayan t=p. Sauran ɓangarorin ba sa canza alama a kusa da wannan wurin (p≥2). Ga (1, 1, 3), alamar tana canzawa a t=1 ma; ga (2, 2, 3), ba ta canzawa a t=3.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Zaɓi misali guda daga waɗanda ka samo, sannan ka rubuta dalilin da ya sa maki ba ya canza alkibla a t=1 duk da cewa v(1)=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Rubuta v(t) ta amfani da (m, n, p) da ka zaɓa, sannan ka kwatanta alamomin idan ka saka ƙima kaɗan ƙasa da 1 da kuma kaɗan sama da 1.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Haɗa ko (t−1)^m tabbatacce ne ko mara kyau kafin da bayan t=1 da ko m odd ne ko even.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.placeholder: Misali: kafin da bayan t=1, alamar (t−1)^m ita ce ...
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: A misalin da ka zaɓa, ka ƙididdige ainihin alamar sauri kafin da bayan t=1?
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka kwatanta da yanayin da ma’aunin ƙarfin lamba odd ne?
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Na zaɓi (2, 1, 3). A cikin v=(t−1)²(t−3), (t−1)² aƙalla 0 ne a ɓangarorin biyu na t=1, saboda haka alamar ba ta canzawa; (t−3) kuma yana nan mara kyau. Saboda haka v=0 a t=1 amma alamar ta kasance iri ɗaya, don haka alkibla ba ta canzawa.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Ma’aunin ƙarfin lamba m even ne, saboda haka (t−1)^m ba ya zama ƙasa da 0 yayin da t ya wuce 1. Saurin ya taɓa 0 sannan ya dawo da alama iri ɗaya, don haka alkiblar ba ta canzawa.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Ya haɗa duka ma’aunin ƙarfin lamba even da gaskiyar cewa alamar ba ta canzawa.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.prompt: Idan sauri v aiki ne mai bambancewa kuma hanzari a(t)=v′(t) ne, zaɓi duk maganganun da suka dace.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.hint.0: Ka ƙirƙiri da kanka sauƙaƙan furucin sauri kamar v=(t−1)² da v=(t−1)³, ka ƙididdige v′(1) ga kowanne, sannan ka kwatanta da ko alkibla tana canzawa.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.hint.1: Ga kowace magana, nemo misali guda da ke karyata ta domin gwada ko tana cika “koyaushe”.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.a: Idan v(t₀)=0 kuma a(t₀)≠0, maki yana canza alkibla a t₀.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.a: Ka yi tunanin cewa idan hanzari ba 0 ba ne, jadawalin sauri yana ratsa 0 kuma alamar tana canzawa.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.b: Idan v(t₀)=0 kuma a(t₀)=0, maki ba ya canza alkibla a t₀.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.b: Ko da a(t₀)=0, a yanayi kamar v=(t−1)³ alkibla tana canzawa. Ka rasa gaskiyar cewa idan hanzari 0 ne, wannan kaɗai ba zai yanke hukunci ba.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.c: Idan v(t₀)=0 kuma a(t₀)=0, lallai maki yana canza alkibla a t₀.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.c: Ko da a(t₀)=0, a yanayi kamar v=(t−1)² alkibla tana nan yadda take.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.o.d: Idan maki ya canza alkibla a t₀, to dole v(t₀)=0.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.r.d: Ka yi tunanin cewa domin alkibla ta canza, sauri dole ya ci gaba da canzawa ya ratsa 0.
n-m-h3-diffc-02.s.s3.explain: Idan v(t₀)=0 kuma v′(t₀)=a(t₀)≠0, to v yana ratsa 0 kuma yana canza alama. Akasin haka, idan a(t₀)=0, alamar na iya kasancewa iri ɗaya kamar (t−1)², ko ta canza kamar (t−1)³; saboda haka dole ne ka duba alamar sauri kai tsaye. Domin alkibla ta canza, v mai ci gaba dole ya canza alama, don haka v=0 a wannan lokacin.

n-m-h3-diffc-03.title: Za mu iya nemo gangaren aikin haɗaka daga ƙimomin da ke tebur?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.topic: Diferenshiyal: bambancin aikin haɗaka da teburin ƙimomin aiki da ƙimomin bambanci.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.goal: Yayin nemo bambancin aikin haɗaka, yanke shawarar a wane maki ya kamata a karanta bambancin aikin waje, sannan ka tantance abin da ƙimomin tebur kaɗai za su iya ba da shi.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.material:
An nuna ƙimomin ayyuka biyu f da g masu bambancewa a teburin da ke ƙasa. Ba a san ƙimomin da ba sa cikin teburin ba. (f∘g)(x) na nufin f(g(x)), (g∘f)(x) kuma na nufin g(f(x)).
 x=1: f(1)=3, f′(1)=4, g(1)=2, g′(1)=−3
 x=2: f(2)=5, f′(2)=7, g(2)=1, g′(2)=6
n-m-h3-diffc-03.thinking.1: Bambanta abin da za a iya samu da abin da ba za a iya samu ba.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.prereq.1: Karanta tebur domin nemo ƙimomin aiki.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk ƙimomin da ake amfani da su wajen nemo (f∘g)′(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta bambancin aikin haɗaka f(g(x)) a matsayin ninkin ɓangaren waje da na ciki, sannan ka duba ƙimar da ɓangaren waje ke ɗauka a matsayin shigarwarsa.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.hint.1: Yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa idan x=1, sakamakon saka 1 cikin g ya zama shigarwar f, domin yanke shawarar waɗanne bayanai a tebur za a karanta.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.a: Ka karanta gangaren f a x=1. Aikin waje f dole ne ya yi amfani da gangarensa a ƙimar aikin ciki g(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.b: Ka karanta bambancin aikin waje a ƙimar aikin ciki g(1).
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.c: Ana buƙatar g(1) domin a zaɓi wurin da za a yi derivation na aikin waje.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi tunanin ɓangaren da ake ninka da abin da ya samo asali na aikin ciki.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.e: g′(2) shi ne gangara a x=2, saboda haka ba a amfani da shi wajen nemo ƙimar a x=1.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.r.f: Ƙimar aikin f(2) tsayi ce, ba gangara ba, don haka ba a amfani da ita wajen ƙididdige derivative.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.explain: (f∘g)′(1)=f′(g(1))·g′(1). Da yake g(1)=2, karanta f′(2)=7 sannan ka ninka da g′(1)=−3 don samun −21. Muhimmin abu shi ne amfani da f′(g(1)), ba f′(1) ba.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s1.acc.0: Ana amfani da g(1)=2 wajen zaɓar wurin da za a karanta f′; ba ya shiga kai tsaye cikin ninkawa. Amma ninka f′(2) da g′(1) kaɗai shi ne lissafin da ya dace.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk ƙimomin da za a iya tantancewa daga ƙimomin da ke cikin jadawalin kaɗai.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowace hadadden aiki, fara nemo ƙimar aikin ciki ka rubuta ta.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.hint.1: Duba ko derivative na aikin waje a wannan shigarwar yana cikin jadawalin.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.a: Muna buƙatar gangarar g′(3) a g(f(1))=g(3), amma ba ta cikin jadawalin. Amfani da g′(1) daga jadawalin yana amfani da wata shigarwa dabam.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.b: Gangarar f′(2) a shigarwar aikin waje g(1)=2 tana cikin jadawalin.
