n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.c: Muna buƙatar gangarar g′(5) a g(f(2))=g(5), amma ba ta cikin jadawalin.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.r.d: Gangarar f′(1) a shigarwar aikin waje g(2)=1 tana cikin jadawalin.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s2.explain: Ana iya nemo derivative na hadadden aiki ne kawai idan jadawalin ya ƙunshi gangarar aikin waje da aka karanta a ƙimar aikin ciki. Ga (f∘g)′, ƙimomin g, wato 2 da 1, dukansu ƙimomin x ne a jadawalin, don haka ana iya nemo shi. Amma ga (g∘f)′, ƙimomin f, wato 3 da 5, ba su cikin jadawalin.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.prompt: Nemo ƙimar (f∘g)′(2). Ka kuma bayyana dalilin da ya sa lissafin f′(2)·g′(2)=42 ba daidai ba ne.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko karanta ƙimar g(2) daga jadawalin, sannan ka zaɓi wurin da za a ɗauki derivative na aikin waje.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.hint.1: A lissafin da aka samu 42, kwatanta wurin da ka karanta derivative na f da ƙimar da a zahiri take shiga cikin f.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka fara nemo g(2) sannan ka zaɓi wurin da za a karanta daga aikin waje?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka bayyana gangarar wane wuri aka gauraya cikin ƙimar 42?
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.model.0: g(2)=1, saboda haka dole ne a karanta f′ a 1. Don haka (f∘g)′(2)=f′(1)·g′(2)=4×6=24. Lissafin f′(2)·g′(2) yana amfani da gangarar f a x=2, amma abin da ke shiga f ba 2 ba ne; g(2)=1 ne. Saboda haka lissafin ba daidai ba ne.
n-m-h3-diffc-03.s.s3.model.1: Derivative na hadadden aiki shi ne f′(g(2))g′(2). Da yake g(2)=1, f′(1)=4 kuma g′(2)=6, samfurin shi ne 24. 42 ba daidai ba ne domin an yi amfani da f′(2)=7.

n-m-h3-dist-01.title: Duba mafitar bambancin Gayoung.
n-m-h3-dist-01.topic: Rarrabawar yiwuwa: matsakaicin ƙima da bambancin canjin bazuwar mai rarrabuwa.
n-m-h3-dist-01.goal: Nemo layin farko da bai dace ba a mafitar bambanci, nemo ƙimar daidai, sannan ka duba ko sakamakon yana da ma’ana.
n-m-h3-dist-01.material: Canjin bazuwar X yana ɗaukar ƙimomi 0, 1, 2, 3 da yiwuwarsu 0.1, 0.4, 0.3, 0.2 bi da bi. Gayoung ta warware kamar yadda ke ƙasa domin nemo bambancin V(X). (E(X²) na nufin “matsakaicin ƙimar X murabba’i,” {E(X)}² kuma na nufin “murabba’in matsakaicin ƙima.”)
n-m-h3-dist-01.thinking.0: Bi layukan mafita ɗaya bayan ɗaya ka nemo layin da ba daidai ba.
n-m-h3-dist-01.thinking.1: Duba ko sakamakon ya dace da siffar rarrabawar.
n-m-h3-dist-01.prereq.0: Matsakaicin ƙimar E(X) na canjin bazuwar mai rarrabuwa.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko da ba daidai ba a mafitar Gayoung.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.hint.0: Duba daga sama a jere ko kowane layi ya biyo bisa ƙa’ida daga layin da ya gabata.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta ma’anar E(X) da E(X²) da kalmomi, sannan ka kwatanta ko an lissafa kowanne layi bisa waɗannan ma’anoni.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.line.2: E(X²) dai E(X) ne a murabba’i kawai, saboda haka E(X²)=1.6²=2.56.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne ba daidai ba. E(X²) ba “murabba’in matsakaicin ƙima” ba ne; ƙimar ce da ake samu idan an fara ɗaukar murabba’in kowace ƙimar X, sannan a ninka da yiwuwoyinsu a tara. Layi na 4 da 5 sun biyo daga sakamakon layi na 3, don haka lissafinsu kansa daidai ne, amma ƙarshe ba daidai ba ne.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.prompt: Gyara layin da ba daidai ba, sannan ka nemo ƙimomin E(X²) da V(X). Ka kuma rubuta cikin jimla ɗaya dalilin da ya sa sakamakon Gayoung V(X)=0 ba shi da ma’ana ga wannan rarrabawa.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ɗauki murabba’in kowace ƙima 0, 1, 2, 3 ta X, sannan ka ninka su da yiwuwoyi iri ɗaya.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ka faɗi da kalmomi abin da bambanci 0 ke nufi game da ƙimomin X.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: E(X²) ita ce ... kuma V(X) ita ce ...
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka ƙididdige E(X²) kai tsaye ta amfani da murabba’in kowace ƙima?
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Za ka iya cewa E(X²) da {E(X)}² lambobi mabambanta ne?
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Za ka iya faɗin wace irin rarrabawa ce za ta iya samun bambanci 0?
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.model.0: E(X²)=0²×0.1+1²×0.4+2²×0.3+3²×0.2=0.4+1.2+1.8=3.4. V(X)=3.4−1.6²=3.4−2.56=0.84, kuma tunda X yana ɗaukar ƙimomi mabambanta 0, 1, 2, 3, bambancin ba zai zama 0 ba.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.model.1: Dole ne ka ɗauki murabba’in kowace ƙima, ka ninka da yiwuwar, sannan ka tara, saboda haka E(X²)=3.4 (=17/5) kuma V(X)=0.84. Bambanci 0 yana nufin X koyaushe yana ɗaukar ƙima guda ɗaya kawai, amma ba haka yake a nan ba.
n-m-h3-dist-01.s.s2.model.2: E(X²)=3.4, bambancin kuma 0.84 ne. Bambanci 0 yana nufin dukkan ƙimomi iri ɗaya ne, wanda ba haka yake a nan ba.

n-m-h3-dist-02.title: Yaushe za mu iya cewa rarrabawar binomial ce idan aka zaro ƙwallo 3?
n-m-h3-dist-02.topic: Rarrabawar yiwuwa: sharuddan da ake buƙata domin rarrabawar binomial ta dace.
n-m-h3-dist-02.goal: Zaɓi bayanin da ake buƙata ƙwarai domin yanke hukunci ko za a iya ɗaukar rarrabawar a matsayin binomial, sannan ka nuna da lambobi yadda yiwuwar ke canzawa idan bayanin ya canza.
n-m-h3-dist-02.material: Akwati yana ɗauke da ƙwallo fari 3 da baƙi 2. Seoyun ta ce, “Yawan X na ƙwallo farare idan aka zaro ƙwallo 3 yana bin rarrabawar binomial B(3, 3/5).” Daga abin da aka rubuta zuwa yanzu kaɗai, ba za a iya sani ko Seoyun tana daidai ba.
n-m-h3-dist-02.thinking.0: Bambanta bayanin da yake da muhimmanci wajen yanke hukunci da wanda ba shi da muhimmanci.
n-m-h3-dist-02.thinking.1: Duba ta lissafi bambancin da ke samuwa idan sharadi ya lalace.
n-m-h3-dist-02.prereq.0: Ma’anar rarrabawar binomial B(n,p): yin gwaje-gwaje n masu zaman kansu, kowanne yana da yiwuwar nasara p iri ɗaya.
n-m-h3-dist-02.prereq.1: Asalin yiwuwar da ke da sharadi.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.prompt: Me dole ne ka sani domin yanke hukunci ko Seoyun tana daidai?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko tuna waɗanne halaye ne gwaje-gwajen dole su kasance da su domin amfani da rarrabawar binomial.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.hint.1: Yanke hukunci ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko kowace zaɓi tana duba wannan hali ko kuma tana tambaya ne game da abin da aka riga aka sani.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.a: Sake ƙirga domin tabbatar da cewa akwatin yana da ƙwallo fari 3 da baƙi 2 da gaske.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.a: An riga an bayar da yawan ƙwallo. Ana amfani da shi wajen nemo yiwuwar 3/5, amma ba ya gaya maka ko yiwuwar iri ɗaya za ta kasance a kowane zaro.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.b: Duba ko zaro ƙwallo 3 ya isa a matsayin yawan gwaje-gwaje.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.b: Rarrabawar binomial ba ta dace ba domin yawan gwaje-gwajen ya yi yawa. Ko da ƙanƙane ne kamar n=3, rarrabawar binomial ce idan an cika sharuddan.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.c: Duba ko ana mayar da kowace ƙwallo da aka zaro cikin akwatin kafin a zaro ta gaba.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.c: Kana duba ko abin da ke cikin akwatin yana kasancewa iri ɗaya a kowane lokaci. Wannan shi ne muhimmin sharadin rarrabuwar binomial.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.o.d: Duba ko an riga an ƙayyade tsarin fitowar fararen ƙwallaye
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.r.d: Tsarin fitowar ƙwallaye ba shi da tasiri ga rarrabuwar adadin X na fararen ƙwallaye. Abin da ke ƙayyade ko rarrabuwar binomial ce shi ne ko gwaje-gwajen suna shafar juna.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s1.explain: A B(3, 3/5), yiwuwar samun farar ƙwallo dole ne ta zama 3/5 a duk lokacin da aka zaro ƙwallo, ba tare da tasirin juna ba. Idan aka mayar da kowace ƙwallo bayan zaro ta, hakan ya tabbata; amma idan ba a mayar ba, sakamakon baya yana sauya yiwuwar na gaba. An riga an san adadin ƙwallayen, kuma ba sai yawan gwaje-gwajen ya yi yawa ba.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.prompt: A ce an zaro ƙwallaye 3 ba tare da mayarwa ba. Idan ƙwallo ta farko fari ce, nemo yiwuwar ta biyun ma fari, sannan ka yi amfani da wannan wajen bayyana dalilin da X ba zai iya zama B(3, 3/5) a wannan yanayin ba.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta adadin ƙwallayen da suka rage a akwatin da kuma adadin fararen ƙwallaye bayan zaro ta farko.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.hint.1: Sanya wannan yiwuwar kusa da ta zaro ta farko, ka kwatanta su.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: Idan ƙwallo ta farko fari ce, ƙwallayen da suka rage su ne ...
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka ƙirga adadin ƙwallayen da suka rage (4) da fararen ƙwallaye (2) da kanka?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Za ka iya bayyana alaƙar sauyin yiwuwar da rashin zaman gwaje-gwaje masu zaman kansu?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Za ka iya bayyana abin da ke faruwa idan an mayar da ƙwallayen?
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.model.0: Idan ƙwallo ta farko fari ce, akwai fararen ƙwallaye 2 cikin ƙwallaye 4 da suka rage, saboda haka yiwuwar ita ce 2/4=1/2. Wannan ya bambanta da 3/5 na farko, don haka sharadin samun yiwuwar iri ɗaya kowane lokaci ya karye, kuma ba B(3, 3/5) ba ne.
n-m-h3-dist-02.s.s2.model.1: Idan ba a mayar da ƙwallayen ba, sakamakon zaro na baya yana sauya yiwuwar na gaba. Idan an fara zaro farar ƙwallo, yiwuwar ta biyun ma fari ita ce 2 cikin 4 (0.5), wadda ta bambanta da 3/5; saboda haka gwaje-gwajen ba masu zaman kansu ba ne kuma rarrabuwar ba binomial ba ce.

n-m-h3-dist-03.title: Wasanni biyu masu matsakaici iri ɗaya: shin warwatsewarsu ma iri ɗaya ce?
n-m-h3-dist-03.topic: Rarrabuwar yiwuwa: bambancin jimillar bazuwar canje-canje da kuma ninka bazuwar canji da adadi
n-m-h3-dist-03.goal: Yi hukunci ta hanyar kwatanta rarrabuwar kai tsaye ko matsakaici iri ɗaya yana nufin warwatsewa iri ɗaya, sannan ka bayyana dalilin ta amfani da bambancin.
n-m-h3-dist-03.material: A ɗauki X a matsayin lambar da aka samu idan aka jefa ƙwallon lido mai fuskoki shida. Akwai wasanni biyu. A Wasan A, ana jefa lido sau ɗaya kuma maki su ne ninkin lambar da aka samu da biyu (2X); a Wasan B, ana jefa lido sau biyu kuma maki su ne jimillar lambobin biyu (X₁+X₂). Matsakaicin maki a wasannin biyu maki 7 ne. Youngsu ya ce, “Tun da matsakaicin ya yi daidai, warwatsewar maki ma ya kamata ta yi daidai.”
n-m-h3-dist-03.thinking.0: Zaɓi hanyar kwatantawa da za ta gwada wannan iƙirari
n-m-h3-dist-03.thinking.1: Gina hujjar ƙaryatawa ta amfani da takamaiman yiwuwoyi
n-m-h3-dist-03.thinking.2: Mayar da ka’idar gaba ɗaya ta amfani da dokokin sauyin bambanci
n-m-h3-dist-03.prereq.0: Darajar tsammani da bambancin bazuwar canji mai ƙimomi masu ware
n-m-h3-dist-03.prereq.1: Bambancin jimillar bazuwar canje-canje biyu masu zaman kansu V(X+Y)=V(X)+V(Y)
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.prompt: Wace kwatantawa ce ta fi dacewa don gwada iƙirarin Youngsu?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.hint.0: Iƙirarin Youngsu ya shafi “warwatsewa,” ba matsakaici ba. Waɗanne bayanai za su nuna hakan?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ga kowane zaɓi, yi tunani ko zai iya nuna bambanci tsakanin wasannin biyu.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.a: Sake lissafi don tabbatar da cewa matsakaicin wasannin biyu da gaske maki 7 ne
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.a: An riga an ba da cewa matsakaitan iri ɗaya ne. Sake duba ƙima ɗaya ba zai nuna warwatsewar ba.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.b: Yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa matsakaicin jefa lido sau ɗaya shi ne 3.5 wajen kwatanta wasannin biyu
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.b: Wannan yana nuna kawai cewa matsakaicin maki 7 a wasannin biyu ya samo asali daga wannan ƙima. Ba ya nuna warwatsewa.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.c: Rubuta maki da za a iya samu a wasannin biyu da yiwuwar kowane maki gefe da gefe
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.c: Kana kwatanta rarrabuwar maki gaba ɗaya. Wannan hanya ce ta gani kai tsaye ko sifar rarrabuwar za ta bambanta duk da matsakaici iri ɗaya.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.o.d: Jefa lido sau da yawa, ka duba ko matsakaicin maki a wasannin biyu yana matsowa kusa da maki 7
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.r.d: Wannan yana nuna ko matsakaici yana taruwa kusa da 7, amma ba ya gaya maka komai game da warwatsewa.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s1.explain: Matsakaici taƙaitaccen bayani ɗaya ne kawai game da rarrabuwa. Idan ka rubuta maki da yiwuwarsu gefe da gefe, za ka ga nan take ko sifar rarrabuwar ta bambanta duk da matsakaici iri ɗaya. Sake lissafin matsakaici ko duba kawai ko yana taruwa kusa da matsakaicin ba zai gwada iƙirarin Youngsu ba.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.prompt: Nemo yiwuwar samun maki 2 ko 12 a kowane wasa (jimillar yiwuwar waɗannan lokuta biyu), sannan ka bayyana cewa iƙirarin Youngsu ba daidai ba ne.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta lambobin lido da ke ba da maki 2 da maki 12 a Wasan A.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.hint.1: A Wasan B, ƙirga dukkan jerantattun lambobi biyu da ke ba da maki 2 da 12, sannan ka nemo kaso na sakamako 36 da suke wakilta.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: A Wasan A, don samun maki 2 ...
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka ƙirga yuwuwar samun maki 2 da 12 a Wasan B a matsayin jerantattun lambobi da kanka?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Za ka iya cewa sifar rarrabuwar na iya bambanta duk da matsakaici iri ɗaya?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Za ka iya bayyana yadda bambancin yiwuwoyin biyu ke nuna bambancin warwatsewa?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.model.0: A Wasan A, jefa 1 ko 6 yana ba da maki 2 ko 12, saboda haka 2/6=1/3 ne. A Wasan B, sakamako biyu ne kawai, (1,1) da (6,6), saboda haka 2/36=1/18 ne. Duk da matsakaici iri ɗaya, yiwuwar samun maki masu nisa ta bambanta sosai, don haka ba za a ce warwatsewar iri ɗaya ba ce.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s2.model.1: Yiwuwar samun maki 2 ko 12 ita ce sulusi ɗaya a A, kuma sulusi ɗaya cikin goma sha takwas a B. Ko da matsakaici maki 7 ne a duka, A yana yawan bayar da maki masu tsaurin nisa, saboda haka bambance-bambancen sun bambanta.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.prompt: A kira bambancin lambar X da aka samu a jefa lido sau ɗaya V. Menene bambancin maki 2X na Wasan A da maki X₁+X₂ na Wasan B (jefawar biyu ba sa shafar juna)?
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.hint.0: 2X sakamako ɗaya ne da aka ninka, X₁+X₂ kuwa sakamako biyu daban ne da aka tara. Yi tunani a kansu dabam-dabam.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.hint.1: Saka lamba mai sauƙi a madadin V (misali V=1), nemo bambance-bambancen biyun ga kowane zaɓi, sannan ka kwatanta ko sun yi daidai da warwatsewar wasannin da ka gani a matakin baya.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.a: Bambancin 2X shi ne 2V, kuma bambancin X₁+X₂ shi ne 2V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.a: Ka ɗauki 2X daidai yake da “tara X sau biyu.” Tara ƙima guda ɗaya sau biyu ya bambanta da tara sakamakon jefawa biyu dabam.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.b: Bambancin 2X shi ne 4V, kuma bambancin X₁+X₂ shi ne 2V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.b: A 2X, ana ninka kowace ƙima, saboda haka bambanci yana ninkuwa da 2²; ga jimillar sakamako biyu masu zaman kansu, bambance-bambancen suna haɗuwa, saboda haka yana ninkuwa da 2.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.c: Bambancin 2X shi ne 4V, kuma bambancin X₁+X₂ shi ne 4V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.c: Ka yi amfani da ka’idar cewa ninka da adadi yana ninka bambanci da murabba’in adadin a kan jimillar jefawa biyu ma. Ga jimilla mai zaman kanta, bambance-bambancen kawai ake tarawa.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.o.d: Bambancin 2X shi ne 2V, kuma bambancin X₁+X₂ shi ne 4V
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.r.d: Ka musanya bambancin ninkawa da bambancin jimilla.
n-m-h3-dist-03.s.s3.explain: V(2X)=2²V=4V, kuma ga jimillar bazuwar canje-canje biyu masu zaman kansu, V(X₁+X₂)=V+V=2V. Matsakaitan duka maki 7 ne, amma bambance-bambancen sun bambanta: 4V da 2V. (Bambancin jefa lido V=35/12 ne, saboda haka su ne 35/3 da 35/6.)

n-m-h3-dist-04.title: Shin darajar tsammani ita ce ƙimar da ta fi yawan fitowa?
n-m-h3-dist-04.goal: Fahimci ma’ana da ma’anar darajar tsammani, sannan ka gina ka kuma gwada rarrabuwa inda darajar tsammani ba ƙima ce mai yiwuwa ba, kuma ba ita ce ƙimar da ta fi yiwuwa ba.
n-m-h3-dist-04.material: Akwai bazuwar canji X mai ɗaukar ƙimomi 0, 1, 2. Da zarar ka zaɓi yiwuwar ƙimomin uku a teburin rarrabuwar yiwuwa, darajar tsammani E(X) za ta ƙayyadu.
n-m-h3-dist-04.thinking.0: Rarraba maganganun darajar tsammani zuwa gaskiya da ƙarya
n-m-h3-dist-04.thinking.1: Gina rarrabuwa da ta cika sharuddan, ka yi amfani da ita wajen nuna misalin da ya ƙaryata iƙirari
n-m-h3-dist-04.prereq.0: Teburin rarrabuwar yiwuwar bazuwar canji mai ƙimomi masu ware
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi dukkan maganganun da suka dace game da darajar tsammani E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowace magana, yi tunani ko za ka iya gwada ta ta hanyar gina teburin rarrabuwar yiwuwa.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.hint.1: Da farko gwada rarrabuwa mai sauƙi inda ƙimomi 0 da 1 ne kawai, kuma yiwuwarsu daidai take.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.a: E(X) ɗaya ne daga cikin ƙimomin da X zai iya ɗauka
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.a: Ko da X zai iya ɗaukar lambobi cikakku kawai, E(X) na iya zama adadi mai ɗigo. Misali, matsakaicin yawan kawunan tsabar da aka samu na iya zama 0.5.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.b: E(X) jimillar kowace ƙima da aka ninka da yiwuwarta ce.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.c: E(X) ita ce ƙimar X mai yiwuwa mafi girma
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.c: Ka ɗauki darajar tsammani da “ƙimar da ta fi yiwuwa” a matsayin abu ɗaya. Ƙimar da ta fi yiwuwa ra’ayi dabam ce, kuma yawanci ba su zama ɗaya ba.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.o.d: Idan aka maimaita gwaji sau da yawa, matsakaicin ƙimomin da aka gani yana taruwa kusa da E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.r.d: Ka bayyana daidai inda matsakaici yake matsowa yayin maimaita gwaji.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s1.explain: E(X) jimillar ƙima × yiwuwa ce, kuma ita ce ƙimar da matsakaici yake matsowa yayin maimaita gwaji sau da yawa. Ba lallai ne ta kasance ƙimar da X zai iya ɗauka ba, kuma ba lallai ne ta kasance ƙimar da ta fi yiwuwa ba.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.prompt: A ce X yana ɗaukar ƙimomi 0, 1, 2. Zaɓi yiwuwarsu a matsayin kaso-kaso na cikakkun lambobi (p0, p1, p2). Sharudda: ① kowane kaso aƙalla 1% ne, kuma jimillarsu 100% ce ② ƙima 2 ita kaɗai ce ke da mafi girman yiwuwa ③ E(X)≤1.2 (darajar tsammani ta yi ƙasa da 2, mafi yawan yiwuwa, da aƙalla 0.8). Ƙirƙiri misalai 3 daban-daban (masu p2 daban-daban).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi p0, p1, p2 su zama 100 idan an tara, sannan ka sa p2 ya fi kowannensu girma.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.1: Lissafa E(X)=(p1+2·p2)/100 ka duba ko bai wuce 1.2 ba. Idan ya yi yawa, gwada ƙara p0 ko p1.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.hint.2: Sauya p2 da ƙimomi daban-daban kamar 45 da 39, sannan ka sake zaɓar p0 da p1 kowane lokaci.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Yiwuwoyin cikakkun lambobi ne, kowanne aƙalla 1%, kuma jimillarsu 100% ce.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Yiwuwoyin ukun dole ne su zama cikakkun lambobi aƙalla 1%, kuma jimillarsu ta zama 100.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Ƙima 2 ita kaɗai ce ke da mafi girman yiwuwa.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.fail.c2: P(X=2) dole ne ya fi kowanne daga cikin sauran yiwuwoyin (ba zai yi daidai da ɗayansu ba).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s2.explain: E(X)=(p1+2·p2)/100. Misali, ga (40, 15, 45), E(X)=1.05, kuma ƙimar da ta fi yiwuwa ita ce 2. E(X)=1.05 ba ƙimar da X zai iya ɗauka ba, kuma ta bambanta da 2, ƙimar da ta fi yiwuwa. Misalan da kawai suka sauya jerin (p0, p1, p2) ba a ƙirga su a matsayin misalai daban-daban.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.prompt: Zaɓi misalanka guda ɗaya, ka yi amfani da lambobinsa wajen bayyana dalilin da ya sa ba daidai ba ne a fassara E(X) da “ƙimar da ta fi yawan fitowa” ko “ƙimar da take fitowa da gaske.”
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.hint.0: Nemo E(X) na misalin da ka zaɓa, ka kwatanta shi da ƙimomin da X zai iya ɗauka: 0, 1, 2.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta alaƙar ƙimar da ta fi yiwuwa da ƙimar E(X).
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka lissafa E(X) da kanka don misalin da ka zaɓa?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana dalilin da E(X) ba ƙima ce da za ta iya faruwa ba?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana yadda ƙimar da ta fi yiwuwa ta bambanta da E(X)?
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.0: Misali, ga (40, 15, 45), E(X)=0.15 + 0.9 = 1.05. Wannan ba ƙimar da X zai iya ɗauka ba, kuma ƙimar da ta fi yiwuwa ita ce 2. Saboda haka E(X) ba ita ce ƙimar da ta fi yawan fitowa ba, kuma ba ƙima ce da za ta iya fitowa ba.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.1: Ga (37, 24, 39), E(X)=1.02, amma X zai iya zama 0, 1 ko 2 kawai, saboda haka 1.02 ba zai taɓa faruwa ba. Ƙimar da ta fi yiwuwa ita ce 2, da kaso 39%, don haka ta bambanta da darajar tsammani.
n-m-h3-dist-04.s.s3.model.2: Ga (25, 36, 39), E(X)=1.14 ba ƙimar da X zai iya ɗauka ba, kuma ta bambanta da 2, ƙimar da ta fi yiwuwa.

n-m-h3-dist-05.title: Idan Yiwuwar Ta Zama 0, Shin Da Gaske Ba Zai Iya Faruwa Ba?
n-m-h3-dist-05.topic: Rarrabuwar yiwuwa: yiwuwar maki guda ɗaya ga bazuwar canji mai ci gaba
n-m-h3-dist-05.goal: Yanke shawara ko ƙima za ta iya faruwa duk da cewa yiwuwarta a maki guda ɗaya na bazuwar canji mai ci gaba 0 ce. Bayyana hukuncinka da tasirin haɗawa ko cire iyakokin tazara cikin kalmomi masu sauƙin fahimtar aboki.
n-m-h3-dist-05.material: Bas na zuwa daidai da yiwuwa a kowane lokaci tsakanin minti 0 zuwa 10 daga yanzu. Lokacin jira X (minti) na iya zama kowace ƙima daga 0 zuwa 10 haɗe da iyakokin. Yiwuwar tazara tana daidai da tsawonta: P(a≤X≤b)=(b−a)/10. Jia ta rubuta bayani kamar haka.
n-m-h3-dist-05.thinking.1: Bayyana ra’ayi mai wuya ta amfani da kalmomi da misalai masu sauƙi
n-m-h3-dist-05.thinking.2: Yanke shawara ko haɗawa ko cire iyakar tazara yana sauya yiwuwa
n-m-h3-dist-05.prereq.0: Ma’anar bazuwar canji mai ci gaba da aikin yawan yiwuwa (yiwuwa ita ce yankin da ke kan tazara)
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin da bai dace ba a rubutun Jia.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.hint.0: Duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko kowace magana ta biyo bisa ƙa’ida daga wadda ta gabace ta.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo layukan da ke cewa “yiwuwar 0 ce” da “ba zai iya faruwa ba,” sannan ka gwada ko hujjar da ke haɗa su ta inganta ta hanyar tunanin bas da zai iso da gaske.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.0: X zai iya ɗaukar kowace ƙima daga 0 zuwa 10, kuma P(a≤X≤b)=(b−a)/10.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.1: P(X=4) yiwuwar tazara ce mai tsawon 0, saboda haka (4−4)/10=0.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.line.2: Tun da yiwuwar 0 ce, bas ɗin da ya iso daidai bayan minti 4 ba zai iya faruwa ba.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne ba daidai ba. Ga bazuwar canji mai ci gaba, ko da yiwuwar maki guda ɗaya 0 ce, hakan ba ya nufin ba zai yiwu ba. Akwai ƙimomi marasa iyaka tsakanin 0 da 10, kuma yiwuwar kowannensu 0 ce, amma wata ƙima tana faruwa. Layuka 4 da 5 sun biyo bisa ƙa’ida.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta saƙon waya ga Jia. Faɗi ɓangaren hujjarta da ya kamata a gyara da yadda girman P(X≤4) da P(X<4) yake kwatankwaci, ta amfani da kalmomi da misali masu sauƙi.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin yadda yiwuwar zaɓar ƙima guda ɗaya tak tsakanin 0 da 10 take da ƙanƙanta.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.hint.1: Sake bayyana wannan ra’ayi ta fuskar yanki: menene yankin layi guda da ba shi da faɗi?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: Yiwuwar daidai minti 4 ita ce ...
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka yi amfani da kalmomi da misali da abokin ajin tsakiya zai fahimta?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka ce “yiwuwa 0” ba ta nufin “ba zai yiwu ba”?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana dalilin da yiwuwar take iri ɗaya ko an haɗa iyakar ko ba a haɗa ba?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.0: Akwai ƙimomi marasa iyaka tsakanin minti 0 da 10, don haka yiwuwar kaiwa daidai minti 4 ƙanƙanta ce ƙwarai, kusa da 0 har ta zama 0. Amma wannan ba ya nufin bas ba zai taɓa zuwa bayan minti 4 ba, domin yana zuwa a wani lokaci. Ko an haɗa minti 4 ko ba a haɗa ba, ƙarin yiwuwarsa 0 ne, saboda haka P(X≤4) da P(X<4) daidai suke.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.1: Saboda lokacin yana ci gaba, ko da yiwuwar maki guda ɗaya 0 ce, bas na iya zuwa a wannan lokacin. Kamar maki guda a kan layi mai yankin 0, alhali layin yana da maki. Ƙara ko cire maki ɗaya ba ya sauya yiwuwa, saboda haka P(X≤4)=P(X<4)=0.4.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s2.model.2: P(X=4)=0, amma lokacin isowa ƙima guda tabbatacciya ce, don haka ba zai yiwu ba ta faru ba. Maki guda ba shi da faɗi, saboda haka ƙara shi ko cire shi ba ya sauya yiwuwa, kuma yiwuwoyin biyun daidai suke.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.prompt: Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ne daidai?
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.hint.0: Yi tunani yadda kowace magana ta danganta da ƙimar P(X=a).
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ga jefa lido X (mai ƙimomi ware), nemo P(X≤3) da P(X<3), ka kwatanta su.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.a: Ko da ga bazuwar canji mai ci gaba, P(X≤a) kullum ya fi P(X<a).
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.a: Ka yi tunanin cewa “≤” ya haɗa ƙarin lokuta, don haka dole ne yiwuwarsa ta fi girma. Ga bazuwar canji mai ci gaba, yiwuwar maki guda ɗaya 0 ce, saboda haka biyun daidai suke.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.b: Ga bazuwar canji mai ci gaba, idan P(X=a)=0, to X ba zai iya zama a ba.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.b: Ka ɗauki yiwuwar 0 daidai yake da rashin yiwuwa. Ga bazuwar canji mai ci gaba, ƙima mai yiwuwar 0 tana iya faruwa da gaske.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.c: Ga bazuwar canji mai ci gaba, yiwuwar iri ɗaya ce ko an haɗa iyakokin tazara ko a cire su.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.c: Yiwuwar maki guda ɗaya 0 ce, saboda haka haɗa ko cire iyakar ba ya sauya yiwuwar.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.o.d: Ga bazuwar canji mai ware ma, P(X≤a)=P(X<a) kullum ne.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.r.d: Ga bazuwar canji mai ware, P(X=a) na iya zama ba sifili ba, saboda haka yiwuwoyin biyun ba lallai su zama daidai ba.
n-m-h3-dist-05.s.s3.explain: Ga bazuwar canji mai ci gaba, P(X=a)=0, saboda haka P(a≤X≤b)=P(a<X<b)=P(a≤X<b)=P(a<X≤b). Ga bazuwar canji mai ware, P(X=a)>0 na iya yiwuwa, don haka haɗa ko cire iyaka na iya sauya yiwuwa.

n-m-h3-dist-07.title: Gina rabon binomial daga matsakaici da bambancin ƙima
n-m-h3-dist-07.topic: Rabon yiwuwar: matsakaici da bambancin ƙima na rabon binomial
n-m-h3-dist-07.goal: Yi amfani da alaƙar matsakaici da bambancin ƙima a rabon binomial domin cire haɗin da ba zai yiwu ba, sannan ka gina rabon binomial da ya cika sharuɗɗa domin nemo ƙa’ida.
n-m-h3-dist-07.material: Kana son bayyana wasu bayanai da rabon binomial B(n,p). A nan n lamba ce ta halitta, p kuma lamba ce tsakanin 0 da 1. Matsakaicin rabon binomial shi ne np, bambancin ƙimarsa kuma np(1−p).
n-m-h3-dist-07.thinking.0: Bincika sharuɗɗan ɓoye (n lamba ce ta halitta, 0<p<1).
n-m-h3-dist-07.thinking.1: Gina misalai naka da suka cika sharuddan, sannan ka nemo ƙa’ida.
n-m-h3-dist-07.prereq.0: Matsakaicin np da bambancin ƙima np(1−p) na rabon binomial B(n,p)
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.prompt: Wanne daga cikin ma’auratan matsakaici da bambancin ƙima zai iya faruwa a zahiri ga rabon binomial B(n,p)?
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.hint.0: Saita matsakaici daidai da np, bambancin ƙima kuma daidai da np(1−p); duba abin da ya rage idan ka raba bambancin ƙima da matsakaici.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.a: A nan bambancin ƙima ya fi matsakaici. Tun da bambancin ƙima np(1−p) ne, ba zai iya fi matsakaicin np ba.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.b: Idan ka nemo p, sannan n=np÷p, n ba lamba ce ta halitta ba. Ka manta sharadin cewa n lamba ce ta halitta.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.c: Idan bambancin ƙima ya yi daidai da matsakaici, to 1−p=1, saboda haka p=0. Sai matsakaicin ya zama 0, wanda bai dace ba.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.r.d: Bambancin ƙima ÷ matsakaici =1−p yana tantance p; n kuma ya zama lamba ta halitta, saboda haka wannan yana yiwuwa.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s1.explain: Bambancin ƙima ÷ matsakaici =1−p. Ga (8, 6), 1−p=3/4, p=1/4, n=8÷(1/4)=32, saboda haka yana yiwuwa. Ga (10, 12), 1−p>1, don haka p<0; ga (8, 5), p=3/8, n=64/3, wanda ba lamba ta halitta ba; ga (6, 6), p=0.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.prompt: Gina rabon binomial 3 daban-daban B(n,p) masu matsakaici 12 da bambancin ƙima bai wuce 8 ba. Rubuta n a matsayin lamba ta halitta, p kuma a matsayin kaso da kashi-kashi cikakke (p%). (Misali, ga p=25%, rubuta 25.)
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta ma’auratan n da p da suka cika matsakaici np=12 (p a matsayin kaso cikakke).
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ga kowane ma’aurata, ƙididdige bambancin ƙima 12(1−p), ka bincika ko bai wuce 8 ba.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.ok.c1: n lamba ce ta halitta, p kuma yana tsakanin 1% da 99%.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole n ya zama lamba ta halitta, p kuma kaso cikakke ne daga 1 zuwa 99.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Bambancin ƙima np(1−p) bai wuce 8 ba.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s2.explain: Daga np=12, p=q/100. Domin bambancin ƙima np(1−p)=12(1−p) bai wuce 8 ba, p dole ya kai aƙalla 1/3. Misalan da n da p suka cika sharuɗɗa su ne (30, 40%), (25, 48%), (24, 50%), (20, 60%), (16, 75%), da (15, 80%).
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.prompt: Daga rabon ukun da ka gina, rubuta alaƙar da ke tsakanin p da bambancin ƙima idan matsakaicin ya yi daidai.
n-m-h3-dist-07.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta p da bambancin ƙima na rabon ukun a jere kamar jadawali.

n-m-h3-dist-08.title: Mafita da ta ba da yiwuwar 2: wane layi ne ya yi kuskure?
n-m-h3-dist-08.topic: Ƙididdigar yiwuwar: yankin da aikin yawan yiwuwar ya ba da ƙima ba 0 ba
n-m-h3-dist-08.goal: Ka gane cewa ba za a iya yin integral a wajen tazarar da aikin yawan yiwuwar yake ba 0 ba; nemo layin da ya yi kuskure, sannan ka nemo yiwuwar daidai.
n-m-h3-dist-08.material: Canjin bazuwar ci gaba X yana da aikin yawan yiwuwar f(x)=kx (0≤x≤2), f(x)=0 kuma ga sauran x. Ga mafitar Minjun domin nemo ma’aunin k da P(1≤X≤3).
n-m-h3-dist-08.thinking.0: Nemo layin farko da mafita ta fara yin kuskure
n-m-h3-dist-08.thinking.1: Bincika ko sakamakon yana cikin zangon yiwuwar ƙima
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko da ba daidai ba a mafitar Minjun.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.hint.0: Duba daga sama ko kowane layi ya biyo bisa ƙa’ida daga layin da ya gabata.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.hint.1: Ga kowane layi, kwatanta jadawalin da aka yi amfani da shi a wannan tazara ta x da f(x) da aka bayar a matsalar.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.line.0: f(x)=kx (0≤x≤2), f(x)=0 a sauran wurare, kuma jimillar faɗi ita ce 1.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.line.1: Ta amfani da faɗin alwatika, (1/2)×2×2k=2k=1, saboda haka k=1/2.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.line.2: P(1≤X≤3) ita ce faɗin yankin tsakanin jadawalin y=x/2 da axis ɗin x daga x=1 zuwa x=3.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne ba daidai ba. A aikin yawan yiwuwar, f(x)=0 idan x ya fi 2, saboda haka jadawalin y=x/2 yana aiki ne har zuwa x=2 kawai. Saboda haka ba za a ƙara faɗin daga x=2 zuwa 3 ba. Layuka na 4 da na 5 sun ɗauki tazarar da ba daidai ba daga layi na 3.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.prompt: Gyara layin da ba daidai ba, nemo P(1≤X≤3), sannan ka rubuta dalilin da ya sa amsar Minjun 2 ba za ta iya zama yiwuwar ba.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko zana inda jadawalin ba 0 ba ne.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin zangon ƙimomin da yiwuwar za ta iya ɗauka.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: f(x) ba 0 ba ne ne kawai idan x yana ..., saboda haka ...
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka bincika tazarar da f(x) ba 0 ba ne kafin ka warware?
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Da kanka ka ƙididdige 3/4 (ta integral ko a matsayin trapezoid)?
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka bincika amsarka da gaskiyar cewa yiwuwar ba za ta iya wuce 1 ba?
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.model.0: Idan x ya fi 2, f(x)=0, saboda haka daga x=1 zuwa 2 kawai za a ƙididdige, kuma faɗin shi ne (1/2)×(1/2+1)×1=3/4. Amsar Minjun 2 ba zai yiwu ba domin yiwuwar ba za ta iya wuce 1 ba, alhali 2 ya fi 1.
n-m-h3-dist-08.s.s2.model.1: P(1≤X≤3)=P(1≤X≤2)=∫₁²x/2 dx=3/4. Tun da jimillar faɗi ita ce 1, faɗin kowane tazara ba zai zama 2 ba.

n-m-h3-prob-01.thinking.0: Nemo layin farko da mafita ta fara yin kuskure
n-m-h3-prob-01.title: Aƙalla Ɗaya 'Yar Ce: Yiwuwar Su Biyun Mata ne Nawa?
n-m-h3-prob-01.topic: Yiwuwar: sharaɗantaccen yiwuwa, zaman kansa da dogaro, tunanin Bayes, tsara sample space
n-m-h3-prob-01.goal: A cikin warware sharaɗantaccen yiwuwa, gano inda aka ƙirga yanayi marasa yiwuwa iri ɗaya a matsayin masu yiwuwa iri ɗaya, ka gyara; sannan tabbatar da cewa ragowar yanayi na canzawa bisa yadda aka faɗi sharaɗin.
n-m-h3-prob-01.material: Abin da aka sani kawai shi ne iyali na da yara biyu. Yiwuwar kowanne ya zama 'ya mace 1/2 ce, kuma jinsin ɗayansu ba ya shafar ɗayan. Seungwoo ya warware “yiwuwar su biyun mata ne, idan aƙalla ɗaya mace ce” kamar haka.
n-m-h3-prob-01.thinking.1: Sake gina sample space ta yanayi daban-daban
n-m-h3-prob-01.thinking.2: Kwatanta yiwuwoyin da ke canzawa bisa lafazin sharaɗi
n-m-h3-prob-01.prereq.0: Ma'anar sharaɗantaccen yiwuwa (rabon wasu yanayi cikin waɗanda suka cika sharaɗin)
n-m-h3-prob-01.prereq.1: Ƙirga sakamako idan ana bambanta jeri
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko mara daidai a warwarewar Seungwoo.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.hint.0: Duba daga sama layi bayan layi ko kowanne ya biyo daidai daga wanda ya gabata.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta yanayin da aka kira “masu yiwuwa iri ɗaya,” kana bambanta yaro na farko da na biyu, sannan kwatanta ko da gaske adadinsu iri ɗaya ne.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.0: A ƙarƙashin sharaɗin cewa aƙalla ɗaya cikin yaran biyu mace ce, nemo yiwuwar su biyun mata ne.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.1: Nau’in yaran biyu yana ɗaya daga cikin uku: “2 mata,” “1 mace da 1 namiji,” da “2 maza”; ana ɗaukar nau’ikan uku masu yiwuwa iri ɗaya.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.2: Cire “2 maza,” wanda bai cika sharaɗin cewa aƙalla ɗaya mace ce ba, sai nau’i biyu su rage.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.line.3: Cikin nau'i biyun, guda ɗaya ne yara mata biyu.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 ne farkon kuskure. “1 mace da 1 namiji” ya ƙunshi yanayin yaro na farko mace da na biyu namiji, da na farko namiji da na biyu mace. Idan an bambanta na farko da na biyu, ba su da yiwuwar iri ɗaya da “2 mata” ko “2 maza.” An ɗauki nau’ikan layi na 2 a matsayin gaskiya wajen layi 3 zuwa 5; lissafin cikinsu daidai ne amma sakamakon ba daidai ba ne.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.prompt: Ta amfani da warwarewar da aka gyara, nemo yiwuwar yaran su biyun mata ne, sannan bayyana dalilin bambancin da amsar Seungwoo. (Kowanne mace ne da yiwuwar 1/2, kuma ba sa shafar juna.)
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.hint.0: Bambanta yara na farko da na biyu, ka rubuta duk haɗuwar jinsi. Nawa ne, kuma shin yiwuwarsu iri ɗaya ce?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ƙirga yanayin da ya cika sharaɗin kawai, ka kwatanta guda nawa daga cikinsu ke da mata biyu.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.placeholder: misali, idan an bambanta yaro na farko da na biyu, ...
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka jera duk yanayin da zai yiwu kana bambanta yaro na farko da na biyu?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bar yanayin da ya cika sharaɗin kawai sannan ka nemo rabon masu mata biyu a cikinsu?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka faɗi cewa “1 mace da 1 namiji” ba yanayi guda ba ne?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.model.0: Idan an bambanta yaro na farko da na biyu, (mace,mace), (mace,namiji), (namiji,mace), (namiji,namiji) duk suna da yiwuwar iri ɗaya. Cikin yanayi 3 da aƙalla ɗaya mace ce, guda 1 ne ke da mata biyu; yiwuwar ita ce 1/3.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.model.1: “Mace ɗaya da namiji ɗaya” ya kasu gida biyu: (na farko mace, na biyu namiji) da (na farko namiji, na biyu mace), saboda haka kada a ƙirga shi a matsayin guda. Yanayi 3 ne suka cika sharaɗin, guda ɗaya ne ke da mata biyu; yiwuwar 1/3.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Yana da kyau a yi amfani da alamomi kamar G da B.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.prompt: Idan sharaɗin ba “aƙalla ɗaya mace ce” ba ne, sai “ɗan fari mace ne,” menene yiwuwar su biyun mata ne?
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta ragowar yanayin ƙarƙashin wannan sharaɗin, kana bambanta na farko da na biyu.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ajiye jerin yanayin da ya rage daga matsalar baya kusa da wannan, ka gano bambancin.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.a: Ka ƙirga yanayin da suka cika sharaɗin ba daidai ba, ko ka gauraya “aƙalla ɗaya mace” da “mata biyu.”
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.b: Ka bayar da yiwuwar cikin dukkan sample space na asali ba tare da amfani da sharaɗin ba. Idan akwai sharaɗi, yanayin da ya rage yana canzawa.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.r.c: Ka ɗauki sharaɗin matsalar baya da ta yanzu a matsayin iri ɗaya. A wannan karon jinsin ɗan na biyu ne kawai ba a sani ba.
n-m-h3-prob-01.s.s3.explain: Idan ɗan fari mace ce, yanayin da ya rage su ne (mace,mace) da (mace,namiji), masu yiwuwar iri ɗaya. Guda ɗaya ne ke da mata biyu, saboda haka yiwuwar 1/2. “Aƙalla ɗaya mace ce” kuma yana ƙyale (namiji,mace), saboda haka yanayi 3 ne, yiwuwar 1/3. Sample space da ya rage ya danganta da lafazin sharaɗin.

n-m-h3-est-01.title: Duba mafita game da yiwuwar matsakaicin kwalabe 9 ya kai aƙalla 503 mL
n-m-h3-est-01.topic: Ƙididdiga ta lissafi: rabon matsakaicin samfurin
n-m-h3-est-01.goal: Kwatanta matsakaici da karkacewar ma’auni na rabon matsakaicin samfurin da ƙimomin yawan jama’a, nemo ka gyara layin da ya yi kuskure a mafita, sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa yiwuwar matsakaicin samfurin ta bambanta da ta ƙima guda ɗaya.
n-m-h3-est-01.material: A masana’antar abin sha, ƙarar kwalba guda tana bin rabon al’ada mai matsakaici 500 mL da karkacewar ma’auni 6 mL. Haeun, mai kula da inganci, ta zaɓi kwalabe 9 bisa sa’a, sannan ta nemo yiwuwar matsakaicin ƙarar X̄ ya kai aƙalla 503 mL. Wani ɓangare na jadawalin al’ada: P(0≤Z≤0.5)=0.1915, P(0≤Z≤1.5)=0.4332, P(0≤Z≤3)=0.4987. (Z canjin bazuwar ne da ke bin rabon al’ada mai matsakaici 0 da karkacewar ma’auni 1.)
n-m-h3-est-01.thinking.0: Karanta a hankali domin bambance ƙima guda da matsakaicin samfurin
n-m-h3-est-01.thinking.1: Kwatanta matsakaici da karkacewar ma’aunin matsakaicin samfurin da ƙimomin yawan jama’a
n-m-h3-est-01.thinking.2: Bayyana yadda yiwuwar da aka gyara ta bambanta, da alkiblar bambancin, daga yiwuwar ƙima guda
n-m-h3-est-01.prereq.0: Yadda ake daidaita rabon al’ada da karanta jadawalin al’ada
n-m-h3-est-01.prereq.1: Alaƙar matsakaici da karkacewar ma’aunin matsakaicin samfurin da na yawan jama’a
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko marar daidai a mafitar Haeun.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.hint.0: Karanta kowane layi ka tantance ko yana magana ne game da “kwalba guda” ko “matsakaicin kwalabe 9”.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta ƙimomin biyu, matsakaici da karkacewar ma’aunin rabon X̄, ɗaya bayan ɗaya da ƙimomin rabon kwalba guda.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.line.0: Yawan jama’a yana bin rabon al’ada mai matsakaici 500 da karkacewar ma’auni 6; matsakaicin samfurin kwalabe 9 shi ne X̄.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.line.1: Matsakaicin X̄ shi ne 500, daidai da matsakaicin yawan jama’a.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.line.2: Karkacewar ma’aunin X̄ ita ce 6, daidai da karkacewar ma’aunin yawan jama’a.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne ba daidai ba. Karkacewar ma’aunin matsakaicin samfurin X̄ ita ce karkacewar yawan jama’a da aka raba da tushen murabba’in girman samfurin: 6/√9=2. Saboda haka X̄ yana bin rabon al’ada mai matsakaici 500 da karkacewar ma’auni 2, kuma P(X̄≥503)=P(Z≥1.5)=0.5−0.4332=0.0668. Layuka na 4 da 5 sun yi amfani da 6 na layi na 3, saboda haka sakamakonsu ba daidai ba ne (0.3085 ya dace da yiwuwar kwalba guda ta kai aƙalla 503).
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.prompt: Yi amfani da mafitar da aka gyara domin nemo P(X̄≥503). Sannan ka bayyana cikin jimloli 1 ko 2 yadda wannan yiwuwar ta bambanta da yiwuwar ƙarar kwalba guda ta kai aƙalla 503 mL, da dalilin.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta karkacewar ma’aunin X̄, sannan ka nemo ƙimar daidaitacciya ta 503.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta ta da ƙimar daidaitacciya ta kwalba guda, ka yi tunanin yadda yaɗuwar ta sauya.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: karkacewar ma’aunin X̄ ita ce ..., saboda haka idan aka kwatanta da kwalba guda ...
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka haɗa gaskiyar cewa karkacewar ma’aunin da aka gyara ita ce 2, ba 6 ba, da √9?
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana da dalili dalilin da ya sa yiwuwar ta yi ƙasa da ta kwalba guda (kusan 0.31)?
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana ra’ayin cewa idan an ɗauki matsakaicin kwalabe 9, manya da ƙanana suna daidaita juna?
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.model.0: Karkacewar ma’aunin matsakaicin samfurin ita ce 6÷√9=2. P(X̄≥503)=P(Z≥1.5)=0.5−0.4332=0.0668. Idan aka ɗauki matsakaicin kwalabe 9, manya da ƙanana suna daidaita juna, saboda haka matsakaicin ba ya bazuwa kamar na kwalba guda kuma yiwuwar ya kai aƙalla 503 ta fi ƙasa sosai.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.model.1: X̄ yana bin N(500, 2²), saboda haka Z=(503−500)/2=1.5 kuma yiwuwar kusan 6.68% ce. Karkacewar ma’aunin kwalba guda ita ce 6, amma ta matsakaici ta ragu zuwa 2, tana taruwa kusa da 500, saboda haka yiwuwar ya kai aƙalla 503 ta ragu.
n-m-h3-est-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Babban batu shi ne bayanin cewa karkacewar ma’auni ta ragu daga 6 zuwa 2.

n-m-h3-est-04.topic: Ƙididdiga ta lissafi: rabon matsakaicin samfurin
n-m-h3-est-04.title: Shin za a iya ɗaukar lokacin jira mai karkacewa a matsayin al'ada da zarar an ɗauki matsakaicinsa?
n-m-h3-est-04.goal: Ka yanke hukunci, yayin da ake bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya, kan lokacin da za a iya amfani da rarrabuwar al'ada ga matsakaicin samfurin idan yawan jama'a ba ya bin rarrabuwar al'ada, sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa hukuncin ke canzawa.
n-m-h3-est-04.material: A wurin sayar da kayan ciye-ciye, lokacin jira (a mintuna) daga yin oda har abinci ya iso yana da matsakaicin mintuna 10 da karkacewar ma'auni 10. Yawancin kwastomomi suna jira na ɗan lokaci, amma kaɗan suna jira na dogon lokaci sosai, don haka rarrabuwar tana da karkata da doguwar wutsiya ta dama kuma ba ta al'ada ba. Wani ɓangare na jadawalin al'ada ta ma'auni: P(0≤Z≤1)=0.3413, P(0≤Z≤1.2)=0.3849.
n-m-h3-est-04.thinking.0: Gyara hukunci idan sabon bayani ya bayyana.
n-m-h3-est-04.thinking.1: Bambanta dabarun matsakaici da karkacewar ma'aunin matsakaicin samfurin da siffar rarrabawarsa.
n-m-h3-est-04.thinking.2: Bayyana sharuddan da ke ba da damar kusantar da rarrabuwar zuwa al'ada.
n-m-h3-est-04.prereq.0: Matsakaici da karkacewar ma'aunin matsakaicin samfurin (m, σ/√n).
n-m-h3-est-04.prereq.1: Yadda ake karanta jadawalin al'ada ta ma'auni.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane mataki, zaɓi hukunci ta amfani da abin da ka sani zuwa wannan lokacin kawai.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, da farko duba ko abin da ake ƙididdigewa shi ne 'lokacin jiran kwastoma ɗaya' ko 'matsakaicin lokacin jiran kwastomomi da dama'.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.hint.1: Raba abin da dabara za ta iya gaya maka (matsakaici da karkacewar ma'auni) da abin da ya shafi siffa (ko rarrabuwar ta al'ada ce).
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Wani ma'aikaci ya ce, 'Mu ɗauki lokacin jira a matsayin N(10, 10²), sannan mu ƙididdige yiwuwar kwastoma ɗaya zai jira mintuna 20 ko fiye a matsayin P(Z≥1)=0.5−0.3413=0.1587.'
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wane hukunci ne ya fi dacewa game da wannan ƙididdiga?
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Wane hukunci ne ya fi dacewa game da wannan ƙididdiga?
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Rarrabuwar lokacin jiran ba ta al'ada ba ce, don haka 0.1587 daga jadawalin al'ada ƙiyasta ce kawai, ba ainihin ƙimar ba, kuma babu dalili mai ƙarfi na amincewa da ita.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 0.1587 daidai ne domin mun san matsakaici da karkacewar ma'auni.
n-m-h3-est-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka yi tunanin cewa sanin matsakaici da karkacewar ma'auni yana gaya maka siffar rarrabuwar ma. Idan siffar ta bambanta, yiwuwar na iya bambanta duk da matsakaici da karkacewar ma'auni iri ɗaya.

n-m-h3-est-06.material: Dina kantong aya 4 bal anu masing-masing ditandaan 1, 3, 5, jeung 7. Anjeun nyokot hiji bal, nyatet angkana, asupkeun deui, tuluy nyokot bal kadua sarta nyatet angkana. Sebut angka kahiji a jeung angka kadua b, sarta anggap (a, b) minangka hiji sampel; rata-rata sampelna X̄=(a+b)/2. Dina unggal nyokot bal, sakabéh 4 bal boga kasempetan anu sarua.

n-m-h3-est-06.s.s2.r.a: Anjeun ngaleungitkeun sampel anu a jeung b-na sarua, nyaéta (5,5) jeung (7,7), anu rata-ratana ogé sahenteuna 5. Soalna maréntahkeun supaya kasus anu sarua diasupkeun.

n-m-h3-est-02.title: Me ake buƙata domin nemo tsawon tazarar amincewa?
n-m-h3-est-02.topic: Ƙididdigar lissafi: tazarar amincewa ga matsakaicin yawan jama’a
n-m-h3-est-02.goal: Bambance abin da ke tantance tsawon tazarar amincewa ta matsakaicin yawan jama’a da abin da ke tantance matsayinta, sannan ka gina tsarin bincikenka da ya cika sharadin tsawo.
n-m-h3-est-02.material: Kana son ƙiyasta matsakaicin yawan jama'a m na matsakaicin lokacin karatun yau da kullum na matasa (a cikin sa'o'i). Yawan jama'ar yana bin rarrabuwar al'ada, kuma an san karkacewar ma'aunin yawan jama'a σ. Idan girman samfurin n ne, matsakaicin samfurin kuma x̄ ne, tazarar amincewa ta kashi 95% ita ce x̄−1.96×σ/√n ≤ m ≤ x̄+1.96×σ/√n. Ƙungiyar bincike ba ta fara binciken ba tukuna, kuma da farko tana son ƙididdige 'tsawon tazarar amincewa' kawai.
n-m-h3-est-02.thinking.0: Ware bayanin da ake buƙata daga wanda ba a buƙata.
n-m-h3-est-02.thinking.1: Bambanta abubuwan da ke shafar tsawo da waɗanda ke shafar matsayi.
n-m-h3-est-02.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri tsare-tsare da dama da suka cika sharadi, sannan ka tabbatar da su.
n-m-h3-est-02.prereq.0: Dabarar tazarar amincewa don matsakaicin yawan jama'a daga rarrabuwar al'ada idan an san karkacewar ma'aunin yawan jama'a.
n-m-h3-est-02.prereq.1: Ƙimar z don matakin amincewa da aka bayar a rarrabuwar al'ada ta ma'auni (kimanin 1.96 don kashi 95%).
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.prompt: Kafin fara binciken, zaɓi duk bayanan da dole ne ka sani don ƙididdige tsawon tazarar amincewa ta kashi 95%. (Kada ka zaɓi abin da ba a buƙata ba.)
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.hint.0: Cire iyakar ƙasa daga iyakar sama kai tsaye, sannan ka fara rubuta furucin tsawon.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.hint.1: Raba haruffan zuwa waɗanda suka rage a wannan furuci da waɗanda suka ɓace.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.r.a: x̄ yana ƙayyade tsakiyar tazarar. Za ka iya duba ko x̄ yana cikin nisan tsakanin iyakokin biyu ta hanyar cire iyakar ƙasa daga iyakar sama a cikin furucin.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.r.b: n yana cikin σ/√n kuma yana canza tsawon tazarar. Ka yi tunanin yadda tazarar ke canzawa idan samfurin ya fi girma.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.o.c: Karkacewar ma'auni s da aka lissafa daga samfurin
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.r.c: An riga an san karkacewar ma'aunin yawan jama'a σ, don haka s ba ya bayyana a furucin tsawon. Duba waɗanne haruffa ne suka bayyana a furucin.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.r.d: σ yana bayyana a furucin tsawo σ/√n. Idan ba ka san yaɗuwar bayanai ba, ba za ka iya faɗin faɗin tazarar ba.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.r.e: Matsakaicin yawan jama'a shi ne ainihin ƙimar da muke ƙoƙarin ƙiyastawa, don haka ba a san ta tukuna, kuma ba ta bayyana a furucin tsawon tazarar.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s1.explain: Cire iyakar ƙasa daga iyakar sama yana sa x̄ ya ɓace, ya bar 2×1.96×σ/√n kawai. An riga an ƙayyade matakin amincewa na kashi 95%, don haka σ da n ne ke ƙayyade tsawon, matsakaicin samfurin kuwa yana ƙayyade matsayin tazarar kawai. Matsakaicin yawan jama'a m ita ce ƙimar da ake ƙiyastawa; ba a amfani da karkacewar ma'aunin samfurin s a furucin tsawo domin an san σ.
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s2.prompt: A ɗauka σ aƙalla 4 ne, sannan ka tsara bincike ta yadda tsawon tazarar amincewa ta kashi 95% bai wuce sa'o'i 2 ba. Shigar da σ da girman samfurin n ga kowane tsari. Dole ne tsare-tsaren biyu su sami ƙimomin σ dabam; yi tsare-tsare 2. (n lamba ce ta halitta wadda ba ta wuce 400 ba.)
n-m-h3-est-02.s.s2.hint.0: Mayar da sharadin cewa tsawon 2×1.96×σ/√n bai wuce 2 ba zuwa rashin daidaito a cikin √n.
