n-m-h3-est-08.title: Mariksa Nilai-z dina Solusi Interval Kapercayaan 90%
n-m-h3-est-08.goal: Pariksa hubungan tingkat kapercayaan jeung probabilitas dina tabél normal baku, téangan sarta benerkeun baris salah dina solusi, tuluy pastikeun kasalahan ku ngitung tingkat kapercayaan anu sabenerna saluyu jeung nilai-z anu salah.
n-m-h3-est-08.material: Tina populasi anu distribusina normal kalayan simpangan baku populasi σ=8, dicokot sampel acak 64 kalayan rata-rata sampel x̄=50. Jiho manggihan interval kapercayaan 90% pikeun rata-rata populasi m. Bagian tina tabél normal baku: P(0≤Z≤1.28)=0.3997, P(0≤Z≤1.645)=0.4500, P(0≤Z≤1.96)=0.4750, P(0≤Z≤2.58)=0.4950. (Z nyaéta variabel acak anu nuturkeun distribusi normal kalayan rata-rata 0 jeung simpangan baku 1.)
n-m-h3-est-08.thinking.1: Ngarobah tingkat kapercayaan jadi probabilitas bagian tengah pikeun manggihan nilai-z
n-m-h3-est-08.thinking.2: Mundur nuturkeun nilai anu salah sarta pariksa deui
n-m-h3-est-08.prereq.1: Rumus interval kapercayaan pikeun rata-rata populasi
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.prompt: Pilih baris munggaran dina solusi Jiho anu teu bener.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.hint.0: Gambarkeun heula bagian distribusi normal baku anu dimaksud ku tingkat kapercayaan 90%.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.hint.1: Belah bagian éta jadi dua dina 0, tuluy bandingkeun jeung wangun dina tabél P(0≤Z≤z).
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.line.0: Simpangan baku rata-rata sampel nyaéta σ/√n=8/√64=1.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.line.1: Tingkat kapercayaan 90%, jadi paké z anu nyumponan P(Z≤z)=0.90.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s1.explain: Baris 2 salah. Tingkat kapercayaan 90% hartina probabilitas antara −z jeung z: P(−z≤Z≤z)=0.90. Ku simétri, P(0≤Z≤z)=0.45, sarta tina tabél z=1.645. Baris 3, 4, jeung 5 nuturkeun baris 2, jadi hasilna salah. Interval anu bener nyaéta 50±1.645×1, nyaéta 48.355 ≤ m ≤ 51.645.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.prompt: Panggihan interval kapercayaan 90% ku solusi anu geus dibenerkeun. Tuluy, maké tabél, itung P(−1.28≤Z≤1.28) pikeun z=1.28 anu dipaké Jiho, tuliskeun tingkat kapercayaan anu saluyu jeung nilai ieu, sarta buktikeun naha interval Jiho lain interval 90%.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tulis heula nilai P(0≤Z≤z) sangkan P(−z≤Z≤z)=0.90, tuluy téangan z dina tabél.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.hint.1: Pikeun 1.28, jumlahkeun P(0≤Z≤1.28) dua kali (pikeun dua sisi).
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.placeholder: contona, P(−z≤Z≤z)=0.90, jadi z=..., sarta intervalna ... Kalawan z Jiho 1.28, ...
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Naha anjeun nyokot satengah probabilitas tengah 0.90, nyaéta 0.45, sarta manggihan z=1.645?
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Naha anjeun ngitung tungtung interval kalayan bener, 50±1.645×1?
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Naha anjeun ngitung dua sisi pikeun 1.28 (2×0.3997) sarta mastikeun hasilna kira-kira 80%?
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.model.0: Lamun P(−z≤Z≤z)=0.90, mangka P(0≤Z≤z)=0.45, jadi z=1.645. Intervalna 50±1.645×1, nyaéta 48.355 nepi ka 51.645. Pikeun z Jiho 1.28, P(−1.28≤Z≤1.28)=2×0.3997=0.7994, kira-kira 80%, jadi éta lain interval kapercayaan 90%.
n-m-h3-est-08.s.s2.model.1: z nyaéta 1.645 sarta interval kapercayaanana [48.355, 51.645]. Lamun maké 1.28, probabilitas gabungan dua sisina 0.7994, ngan kira-kira 80%, jadi intervalna kacida heureutna jeung tingkat kapercayaanana kurang ti 90%.

n-m-h3-est-07.topic: Ƙiyasta ƙididdiga: son zuciya a binciken samfurin.
n-m-h3-est-07.title: Survéy Milih Sakabéh Hiji Kelas: Naha Rata-rata Sampel Bisa Dipercaya?
n-m-h3-est-07.goal: Pahami yén unggal murid boga kasempetan anu sarua pikeun kapilih téh béda jeung sampel anu ngawakilan populasi kalayan hadé; jieun jeung jelaskeun kaayaan hipotétis anu némbongkeun kalemahanana.
n-m-h3-est-07.material: Hiji SMA boga 20 kelas, unggal kelas eusina 30 murid, jumlahna 600 murid. Anjeun keur ngarencanakeun cara milih 30 murid pikeun survéy rata-rata waktu saré sapopoé.
n-m-h3-est-07.thinking.0: Pariksa naha kasempetan pikeun kapilih sarua
n-m-h3-est-07.thinking.1: Jieun kaayaan conto bantahan anu nyumponan sarat
n-m-h3-est-07.thinking.2: Jelaskeun kalemahan métode nyokot sampel jeung cara ningkatkeunana
n-m-h3-est-07.prereq.1: Éta rata-rata sampel mangrupa nilai pikeun ngira-ngira rata-rata populasi
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.prompt: Pilih sakabéh métode anu méré probabilitas kapilih anu sarua ka 600 murid.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.hint.0: Pilih saurang murid, tuluy tuliskeun minangka éksprési probabilitas murid éta asup kana sampel dina unggal métode.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.hint.1: Candak ogé murid tingkat kahiji, kadua, jeung katilu hiji-hiji, tuluy pariksa naha probabilitasna sarua.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.o.a: Nomeran sakabéh murid dina daptar, tuluy pilih 30 maké angka acak.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.r.a: Unggal murid kapilih kalayan probabilitas 30/600, sarua pikeun kabéh. Pariksa naha métode ieu kaliwat.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.o.b: Pilih sacara acak hiji kelas tina 20 kelas, tuluy pilih sakabéh 30 muridna.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.r.b: Unggal murid kapilih kalayan probabilitas 1/20, nyaéta kasempetan kelasna kapilih, sarua pikeun kabéh. Pariksa naha métode ieu kaliwat.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.o.c: Pilih sacara acak 30 tina 200 murid tingkat katilu.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.r.c: Murid tingkat kahiji jeung kadua teu boga kasempetan kapilih. Éta adil ngan di tingkat katilu, lain pikeun sakabéh murid.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.o.d: Pilih 30 murid kahiji anu kapanggih di koridor waktu istirahat dahar beurang.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.r.d: Murid anu remen aya di koridor leuwih gampang kapanggih, jadi probabilitas kapilihna béda-béda antara murid.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s1.explain: Dina A, 30 dipilih tina 600, jadi unggal murid boga probabilitas 30/600; dina B, hiji kelas tina 20 dipilih, jadi probabilitas unggal murid 1/20=30/600. Dina C, probabilitas murid tingkat kahiji jeung kadua nyaéta 0; dina D, probabilitas kapanggihna béda-béda. Tapi dina B kasempetanana sarua, sanajan murid anu kapilih babarengan bisa boga kamiripan, jadi métode éta teu bisa dianggap sarua jeung A.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.prompt: Anggap sakola ngan boga dua kelas anu masing-masing eusina 30 murid. Lamun hiji kelas dipilih sacara acak sarta 30 muridna dijadikeun sampel, kelas mana waé anu kapilih, rata-rata waktu saré sampel kudu nyimpang sahenteuna 1 jam ti rata-rata sakola. Jieun 2 pasangan béda tina rata-rata waktu saré dua kelas a jeung b (dina jam, ti 4 nepi ka 10 kaasup) tuluy eusian.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.hint.0: Lamun jumlah murid dina dua kelas sarua, tuliskeun heula rata-rata sakola dumasar kana a jeung b.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.hint.1: Panggihan bédana antara rata-rata kelas anu kapilih jeung rata-rata sakola, tuluy pilih bédana a jeung b sangkan sahenteuna 1.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.ok.c1: a jeung b aya di antara 4 jeung 10 kaasup.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.fail.c1: a atawa b henteu aya di antara 4 jeung 10 kaasup.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Kelas mana waé anu kapilih, rata-ratana nyimpang sahenteuna 1 jam ti rata-rata sakola.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Gumantung kelas anu kapilih, aya kaayaan rata-ratana nyimpang kurang ti 1 jam ti rata-rata sakola.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s2.explain: Kusabab jumlah murid dua kelas sarua, rata-rata sakola nyaéta (a+b)/2, sarta kelas mana waé anu kapilih, bédana sarua nyaéta |a−b|/2. Sangkan sahenteuna 1, kudu |a−b|≥2. Contona, lamun rata-rata kelas 6 jam jeung 8 jam, rata-rata sakola 7 jam, sarta milih salah sahiji kelas méré 6 atawa 8 jam, masing-masing béda 1 jam ti 7.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.prompt: Bandingkeun métode milih sakabéh hiji kelas jeung métode milih 30 tina 600 murid maké angka acak. Dumasar kana conto anu dijieun di luhur, jelaskeun kalemahan milih hiji kelas sarta tuliskeun hiji cara pikeun ngurangan éta kalemahan.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.hint.0: Dina conto anjeun, ku angka tuliskeun kumaha rata-rata sampel robah gumantung kelas mana anu dipilih.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.hint.1: Pikirkeun sabaraha kelas anu muridna bakal diasupkeun kana hiji sampel lamun 30 dipilih ku angka acak.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.placeholder: contona, Murid dina kelas anu sarua ... jadi ... Pikeun ngurangan ieu ...
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Naha anjeun ngajelaskeun kalemahanana maké rata-rata dua kelas anu dijieun tadi?
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Naha anjeun nyebutkeun yén sanajan kasempetan kapilih sarua, rata-rata sampel bisa jauh tina rata-rata populasi?
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Naha cara ningkatkeun anu diusulkeun ngajurung supaya murid ti sababaraha kelas dicampur?
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.model.0: Murid dina kelas anu sarua boga kabiasaan anu sarupa, jadi lamun milih sakabéh hiji kelas, rata-rata sampel bisa jauh ti rata-rata sakola gumantung kelas anu kapilih. Contona, kelas rata-rata 6 jam jeung kelas rata-rata 8 jam, kelas mana waé anu kapilih bakal béda 1 jam. Ieu bisa dikurangan ku milih acak tina daptar lengkep, atawa milih sababaraha murid ti unggal kelas.
n-m-h3-est-07.s.s3.model.1: Murid dina hiji kelas silih sarupa, jadi sanajan milih 30 urang, informasina teu sarua jeung 30 murid anu béda-béda. Lamun rata-rata kelas béda, hasilna robah pisan gumantung kelas anu dipilih (kasalahan ngagedéan); hasilna leuwih hadé lamun milih acak jeung rata ti loba kelas.

n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane mataki, zaɓi hukunci ta amfani da abin da ka sani zuwa wannan lokacin kawai.
n-m-h3-integc-04.title: Cikakkun Haɗi Ba Tare da Nemo Aikin Haɗi Ba
n-m-h3-integc-04.topic: Haɗawa: cikakkun haɗi ta amfani da sauya canji da daidaiton tazara (nemo daraja ba tare da aikin haɗi ba)
n-m-h3-integc-04.goal: Yayin da bayanai ke ƙaruwa, gyara hukuncinka; ka tabbatar cewa dangantakar daidaito da aka samu ta hanyar sauya canji tana ƙayyade darajar cikakken haɗi ba tare da nemo aikin haɗi ba.
n-m-h3-integc-04.material: Bi mataki-mataki tsarin nemo darajar cikakken haɗi I=∫_0^{π/2} sin x/(sin x+cos x) dx. (∫_0^{π/2} cikakken haɗi ne daga 0 zuwa π/2.)
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.1: Ƙirga yawan ma'auni da yawan abubuwan da ba a sani ba
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.2: Kula da alkiblar tazara bayan sauya canji
n-m-h3-integc-04.thinking.3: Yi hukunci kan sharuddan da hanya iri ɗaya za ta yi aiki a ƙarƙashinsu
n-m-h3-integc-04.prereq.0: Sauya canji a haɗawa (canja iyakoki a cikin cikakken haɗi)
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.hint.0: Duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana, ƙirga 'adadin abubuwan da ba a sani ba da adadin ma'aunai.'
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta ko kimantawarka ta farko da darajar da ka samu daga baya ba su bambanta sosai ba.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Kana son nemo I=∫_0^{π/2} sin x/(sin x+cos x) dx. Yana da wuya a nemo aikin haɗin wannan magana kai tsaye. Darajojin integrand h(x)=sin x/(sin x+cos x) su ne h(0)=0, h(π/4)=1/2, h(π/2)=1, kuma tsawon tazara π/2 ne (kusan 1.57).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wace kimanta girman I ce ta fi dacewa?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Tsayin yana tashi daga 0 zuwa 1, matsakaiciyar daraja 1/2 ce, saboda haka yankin yana kusan (1/2)×1.57≈0.8. Za a iya amfani da wannan kimanta daga baya don duba ko darajar da ka samu daidai ce.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: I kusan 1.57 ne: domin ka ɗauki tsayin a matsayin 1 ka ninka da tsawon 1.57
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Tsayin 1 yana samuwa ne kawai a ƙarshen tazara. Wannan kimanta tana ɗauka tsayin 1 ne a duk tazarar.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: I kusan 0.8 ne: domin tsayin yana bambanta daga 0 zuwa 1, matsakaiciyarsa kusan 1/2 ce
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka kimanta canjin tsayi ta hanyar amfani da matsakaici. Ba ainihin darajar ba ce, amma za a iya amfani da ita wajen hasashen girma.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: I=0 ne: domin h(0)=0 a wurin farawa
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Darajar zama 0 a wuri guda ba ya sa cikakken haɗi ya zama 0. Duba darajojin a duk tazara.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Ka kuma duba J=∫_0^{π/2} cos x/(sin x+cos x) dx. Idan aka haɗa waɗannan ɓangarori biyu, lissafi a sama ya zama lissafi a ƙasa, saboda haka I+J=∫_0^{π/2} 1 dx=π/2.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Za a iya ƙayyade I daga wannan bayani kaɗai?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Akwai ma'auni ɗaya kawai, I+J=π/2, saboda haka ba za a iya ƙayyade I da J dabam-dabam ba. Kana buƙatar nemo wata dangantaka guda tsakanin I da J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Za a iya ƙayyade shi: I+J=π/2, saboda haka I=π/4.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka raba shi gida biyu ba tare da duba ko I=J ba. I+J=π/2 dangantaka guda ce kawai tsakanin I da J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ba za a iya ƙayyade shi ba: I+J=π/2 ba ya taimakawa ko kaɗan wajen nemo I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Darajar I+J bayani ne mai amfani. Ta ba da dangantaka guda tsakanin I da J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Har yanzu bai isa ba: kana buƙatar sanin wata dangantaka guda tsakanin I da J.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka lura cewa akwai abubuwa biyu da ba a sani ba, I da J, amma ma'auni guda ɗaya kawai.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.info: A cikin J, bari x=π/2−t. Sai dx=−dt, kuma yayin da x ke tafiya daga 0 zuwa π/2, t yana tafiya daga π/2 zuwa 0. Tun da sin(π/2−t)=cos t da cos(π/2−t)=sin t, J=∫_{π/2}^{0} sin t/(sin t+cos t)·(−dt)=∫_0^{π/2} sin t/(sin t+cos t) dt, wanda ya yi daidai da I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.after: I=J kuma I+J=π/2, saboda haka I=π/4 (kimanin 0.785). Wannan ya yi daidai da ƙiyasin farko na 0.8.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka yi amfani da daidaitattun lissafi biyu I=J da I+J=π/2 tare. Wannan ma ya yi daidai da ƙiyasin farko na 0.8.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka ɗauki ƙimar I+J a matsayin ƙimar I. J ma yana da adadin iri ɗaya.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka ɗauki tsayin a wuri guda na tsakiya a matsayin ƙimar tabbataccen integral. Dole ne ka ninka tsayin da faɗin tazara.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s1.reflect: Da farko ƙiyasi ne kawai zai yiwu, kuma ko bayan samun I+J, raba biyu ya yi wuri. Sai da sauya canji ya ba da alaƙar J=I aka ƙayyade I. Ta amfani da daidaiton tazara a tabbataccen integral, za ka iya samun ƙimar ba tare da neman antiderivative ba.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.prompt: Idan ka sa x=π/2−t a cikin J, dx=−dt ne, amma J ya zama +I maimakon −I. Ka bayyana dalilin, kana mai mai da hankali ga iyakokin integral na sama da na ƙasa.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo ƙimar t da ta dace da x=0 da x=π/2, sannan rubuta iyakokin sama da na ƙasa na sabon integral.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta yadda alamar ke sauyawa idan ka mayar da tabbataccen integral mai iyakar sama ƙasa da ta ƙasa zuwa tsarin da aka saba.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta cewa bayan sauya canji iyakar ƙasa π/2 ce, ta sama kuma 0?
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.model.0: Yayin da x ke tafiya daga 0 zuwa π/2, t yana tafiya daga π/2 zuwa 0, saboda haka iyakokin integral sun juya. Juya tazara yana sauya alama; tare da debe na dx=−dt alamomin sun soke juna, don haka J=+I.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s2.model.1: Bayan sauya canji tazarar ta juya, daga π/2 zuwa 0. Gyara tazarar da aka juya yana haifar da alamar debe guda, wadda ke soke deben dx=−dt; saboda haka alamar ƙarshe ta zama kari.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.prompt: Zaɓi tabbataccen integral wanda za a iya samun ƙimarsa da irin hanyar samun I (sauya x da π/2−x sannan a tara kalmomin da suka dace).
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi, rubuta abin da ke faruwa ga tazara da ma'aunin denominator idan aka sauya x da π/2−x.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.hint.1: Duba ko numerator da denominator sun zama daidai idan aka tara asalin kalmar da wadda aka sauya.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.a: Idan tazarar [0,π/3] ce, x da π/2−x ba sa haɗuwa a cikin tazara ɗaya, don haka hanyar da ke sama ba ta aiki kai tsaye.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.b: Denominator ba ta da daidaito, saboda haka ko da an tara kalmomin haɗin ba za a sauƙaƙa juzu'in zuwa lamba guda ba.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.c: Ka ga cewa sauya x da π/2−x yana musanya sin³ da cos³, kuma jimillar kalmomin biyu ita ce 1.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.r.d: Denominator tana zama 0 a cikin tazara (a x=3π/4), saboda haka ba a ma ayyana tabbataccen integral ɗin.
n-m-h3-integc-04.s.s3.explain: A c, tazarar [0,π/2] tana komawa kanta ƙarƙashin x→π/2−x, kuma denominator sin³x+cos³x tana da daidaito; tara kalmar haɗin yana ba da 1. Saboda haka ƙimar ita ce π/4. Matsalar a ita ce tazara, ta b kuma daidaiton denominator, ta d kuma wurin da denominator take 0 (3π/4).

n-m-h3-est-05.title: Yadda za a bayyana wa aboki bambancin matsakaitan samfuran birane biyu daidai.
n-m-h3-est-05.goal: Idan matsakaitan samfura biyu sun bambanta kaɗan kawai, ƙididdige tazarorin amincewa don duba ko sun yi karo, sannan ka sake rubuta ikirarin da kalmomin da ba sa ayyana wanda ya yi nasara, ka kuma bayyana wa aboki.
n-m-h3-est-05.material: Labarin jaridar gida: 'Daliban sakandare a Birni A suna amfani da wayoyinsu na zamani matsakaicin sa'o'i 3.4 a rana, fiye da Birni B (3.1). Daliban Birni A suna amfani da nasu na dogon lokaci.' A biranen biyu an zaɓi ɗalibai 100 bazuwar; lokacin amfani yana bin rarrabuwar al'ada, kuma an san karkacewar ma'aunin yawan jama'a ta zama sa'o'i 1.5 a kowannensu.
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.0: Ka ƙididdige tazarorin amincewa da kanka, sannan ka kwatanta su.
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.1: Bambanta bambancin ƙiyasin maki ɗaya da haɗuwar tazarorin.
n-m-h3-est-05.thinking.2: Sake rubuta gyara da ya dace da wanda zai karɓa.
n-m-h3-est-05.prereq.0: Tazarar amincewa don matsakaicin yawan jama'a daga rarrabuwar al'ada idan an san karkacewar ma'aunin yawan jama'a.
n-m-h3-est-05.prereq.1: Ƙimar z don amincewa ta kashi 95%, kimanin 1.96.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.prompt: Nemo tazarar amincewa ta kashi 95% ga matsakaicin yawan jama'ar kowane birni, sannan ka shigar da ƙimomin da aka zagaye zuwa wurare goma sha biyu (wato wurare biyu na goma). (Birni A: iyakar ƙasa da sama; Birni B: iyakar ƙasa da sama.)
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko nemo karkacewar ma'aunin matsakaicin samfurin ga birni ɗaya, 1.5/√100.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ninka wannan ƙimar da 1.96 don samun gefen kuskure, sannan ka ƙara ka kuma rage shi daga matsakaicin samfurin kowane birni.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.fail.c1: Tazarar Birni A ba daidai ba ce. Duba 3.4 ± 1.96×1.5/√100.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.fail.c2: Tazarar Birni B ba daidai ba ce. Duba 3.1 ± 1.96×1.5/√100.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s1.explain: Matsakaicin samfurin ± 1.96×1.5/√100 = ± 0.294, don haka tazarar Birni A ita ce 3.106 zuwa 3.694, ta Birni B kuma 2.806 zuwa 3.394. Idan ba ka raba da √n ba, kamar a 3.4±1.96×1.5, tazarar za ta yi faɗi fiye da kima; idan kuma ka yi amfani da z=1.645, za ka sami tazarar kashi 90%.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.prompt: Idan ka dubi tazarorin amincewa biyun, zaɓi hukuncin da ya fi dacewa game da labarin.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.hint.0: Zana tazarorin biyun a kan layin lambobi sannan ka duba ko sun haɗu.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin ko wata ƙima a yankin da suka haɗu za ta iya zama matsakaicin yawan jama'a na biranen biyu.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.a: Birni A ya fi tsawo, domin matsakaicin samfurinsa ya fi da sa'o'i 0.3.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.r.a: Anjeun ngan ngabandingkeun ukuran rata-rata sampel. Rata-rata sampel robah-robah ti hiji sampel ka sampel séjén, jadi lamun kasalahan diperhatikeun, urutanna bisa waé malik.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.b: Hésé mastikeun yén Kota A leuwih lila; intervalna tumpang tindih, jadi bisa waé rata-rata populasina sarua.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.c: Dua kota éta sarua, sabab intervalna tumpang tindih, jadi rata-rata populasi bisa dianggap sarua.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.r.c: Anjeun maca tumpang tindih minangka bukti “sarua”. Tumpang tindih hartina kamungkinan sarua tetep aya; éta henteu mastikeun yén nilaina sarua.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.o.d: Teu bisa ditaksir; ngan 100 murid per kota, jadi ngabandingkeunana teu aya hartina.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.r.d: Sampel leutik henteu ngajadikeun intervalna teu aya gunana. Interval éta tetep nétélakeun rentang tempat rata-ratana aya.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s2.explain: Dua interval, 2.806 nepi ka 3.394 jeung 3.106 nepi ka 3.694, tumpang tindih ti 3.106 nepi ka 3.394. Tumpang tindih téh ukur pamariksaan gancang; leuwih taliti, pariksa naha interval 95% pikeun bédana dua rata-rata ngawengku 0. Di dieu interval bédana kira-kira −0.12 nepi ka 0.72, ngawengku 0, jadi hésé nyimpulkeun yén Kota A leuwih lila. Tapi can kabuktian ogé yén dua rata-rata éta sarua.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.prompt: Babaturan anjeun maca artikel tuluy nulis dina obrolan grup, “Barudak Kota A pasti leuwih lila maké telepon tibatan barudak Kota B.” Dumasar kana itungan interval di luhur, tuliskeun pesen pikeun ngabenerkeunana dina dua atawa tilu kalimah, maké kecap anu kaharti ku babaturan SMA.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.hint.0: Mimitian kalimah kahiji ku nyebutkeun angka dina artikel (3.4 jeung 3.1).
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.hint.1: Saterusna, ku kecap basajan, jéntrékeun kamungkinan anu masih kabuka lantaran intervalna tumpang tindih.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.placeholder: contona, Artikel nyebut 3.4 jam jeung 3.1 jam, tapi ...
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Naha anjeun nulisna ku kecap basajan anu kaharti ku babaturan?
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Naha anjeun sahenteuna sakali nyebutkeun tumpang tindih interval minangka bukti?
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Naha anjeun ngajaga jawaban saimbang, nyebutkeun “hésé dipastikeun” tinimbang “salah”?
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.model.0: Sanajan rata-rata sampelna 3.4 jam pikeun A jeung 3.1 pikeun B, can bisa buru-buru nyebut A leuwih lila. Unggal kota ngan nalungtik 100 murid, sarta interval kapercayaan 95%-na, kira-kira 3.11 nepi ka 3.69 pikeun A jeung 2.81 nepi ka 3.39 pikeun B, tumpang tindih. Dina kanyataanana, dua kota éta bisa waé sarua.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.model.1: Bédana 0.3 jam antara rata-rata sampel masih aya dina wates kasalahan. Kusabab dua interval kapercayaan tumpang tindih, hésé mastikeun yén A leuwih lila makéna, sarta nilaina bisa waé sarua.
n-m-h3-est-05.s.s3.model.2: Bédana ngan 0.3 jam, jadi bisa waé sarupa jeung teu bisa dipastikeun. Dua intervalna tumpang tindih.

n-m-h3-integc-02.title: Ƙirƙirar Ayyukan Kubik Daban-daban Masu Cikakken Haɗi iri ɗaya 4
n-m-h3-integc-02.topic: Haɗawa: ƙa'idodin cikakken haɗi — soke sharuɗɗan ma'auni mara-ɗaya a tazara mai daidaito
n-m-h3-integc-02.goal: Yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa cikakkun haɗin sharuɗɗan ma'auni mara-ɗaya a tazara mai daidaito 0 ne, domin gina ayyuka daban-daban masu cikakken haɗi iri ɗaya, sannan ka bayyana tsarin.
n-m-h3-integc-02.material: Yi la'akari da cikakken haɗin aikin kubik f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d a kan [−1,1]. (x³ yana nufin x a kubu, kuma ∫_{-1}^{1} cikakken haɗi ne daga −1 zuwa 1.)
n-m-h3-integc-02.thinking.0: Duba ko wasu ɓangarorin magana suna soke juna a tazara mai daidaito
n-m-h3-integc-02.thinking.1: Gina ayyuka daban-daban da ke ba da cikakken haɗi iri ɗaya
n-m-h3-integc-02.thinking.2: Duba sharuddan da wannan hanya za ta yi aiki a ƙarƙashinsu (tazara mai daidaito, ma'auni mara-ɗaya)
n-m-h3-integc-02.prereq.1: Yadda alamar darajar aiki take bambanta a x da −x
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk ayyukan da cikakken haɗinsu a kan [−1,1] yake 0.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.hint.0: Raba kowace magana zuwa sharuɗɗa, ka yi alama kan yadda kowane sharaɗi yake canjawa idan ka maye gurbin x da −x.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.hint.1: Zaɓi magana ɗaya wadda cikakken haɗinta ba 0 ba ne, sannan ka lissafta haɗin kowane sharaɗi a kan [−1,1] don dubawa.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.a: Sharuɗɗan ma'auni ma-biyu suna da daraja iri ɗaya a x da −x, don haka ba sa soke juna. Lissafta cikakken haɗin kowanne daga cikin sharuɗɗan biyu.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.b: Ka ga cewa sharuɗɗan ma'auni mara-ɗaya ne kawai, saboda haka darajojin a x da −x suna da kishiyar alama.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.e: Ka ga cewa sharuɗɗan ma'auni mara-ɗaya ne kawai, saboda haka darajojin a x da −x suna da kishiyar alama.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.c: Sharaɗin tsayayye 1 yana da daraja iri ɗaya a x da −x, don haka ba ya soke kansa. Duba haɗin sharaɗin tsayayyen.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.r.d: Sharaɗin x yana soke kansa amma x² ba ya soke kansa. Ka yanke hukunci kan dukan maganar daga sharaɗi ɗaya kawai.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s1.explain: Ga sharuɗɗan da darajarsu a x da −x take da kishiyar alama (x, x³, x⁵, …), yankin hagu da na dama a kan [−1,1] sun bambanta da alama kawai, saboda haka cikakken haɗin 0 ne. Ga x⁴−x² kuwa 2/5−2/3 ne; ga x³+1 kuma 2 ne; ga x²+x kuma 2/3 ne. Babu ɗaya daga cikinsu da yake 0.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.prompt: A ɗauki f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d (a, b, c, d cikakkun lambobi ne daga −20 zuwa 20 haɗe da iyakokin) inda ∫_{-1}^{1} f(x)dx = 4, sannan ka ƙirƙiri f guda uku daban-daban waɗanda a zahiri suke da sharaɗin x³ da na x (a≠0, c≠0). Shigar da a, b, c, d na kowannensu.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ka lissafta abin da za ka samu idan ka haɗa ax³ da cx daban-daban a kan [−1,1].
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.hint.1: Da farko zaɓi (b, d) ta yadda ragowar magana 2b/3+2d ta zama 4, sannan ka cika a da c da lambobi marasa sifili.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Dukkan ma'aunai huɗun cikakkun lambobi ne cikin iyakar.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Ma'aunai huɗun dole su zama cikakkun lambobi daga −20 zuwa 20 haɗe da iyakokin.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Idan a ya zama 0, babu sharaɗin x³.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Idan c ya zama 0, babu sharaɗin x.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.ok.c4: Cikakken haɗin a kan [−1,1] shi ne 4.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Cikakken haɗin a kan [−1,1] ba 4 ba ne.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.explain: A kan [−1,1], ∫ax³dx=0 da ∫cx dx=0, saboda haka ∫f(x)dx = 2b/3 + 2d. Idan wannan ya zama 4, to b+3d=6. Misalai su ne (1,0,2,2), (3,3,−1,1), da (−2,6,5,0). (1,3,2,2) yana ba da 2+4=6, ba 4 ba; kuma an hana misalan da a=0 ko c=0 bisa sharuddan.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Bayan ka nemo f daban-daban guda uku ko fiye, za ka ga cikakken haɗin yana nan iri ɗaya duk da cewa a da c suna canjawa yadda suka ga dama. Ka bayyana dalili.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Lissafta haɗin kowanne daga ax³ da cx a kan [−1,1].
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ka rubuta a matsayin magana ko haɗin sauran sharuɗɗan yana amfani da b da d kawai.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka danganta dalilin da ya sa cikakkun haɗin x³ da x suke 0 a kan [−1,1] da daidaiton tazara?
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka tabbatar da magana cewa haɗin yana dogara da b da d da suka rage kawai?
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.model.0: ax³ da cx suna da alamomi masu kishiya a x da −x, saboda haka cikakkun haɗinsu a kan [−1,1] suna soke juna su zama 0. Don haka darajar ta dogara ne kawai da haɗin bx² da d, wato 2b/3+2d.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Cikakkun haɗin sharuɗɗan ma'auni mara-ɗaya ax³ da cx su ne 0, saboda haka a da c ba za su iya shafar darajar ba. b mai ma'aunin ma-biyu da sharaɗin tsayayye d ne kawai ke da tasiri.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.prompt: Ana iya amfani da wannan ƙa'ida idan tazara ta daidaita a tsakiyar 0, kamar [−1,1]. Zaɓi cikakken haɗin da wannan hanya ta dace da shi.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko duba ko tazarar ta karkata a tsakiyar 0, wato tana da tsayi iri ɗaya hagu da dama.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.hint.1: Sannan duba ko maye gurbin x da −x a cikin integrand yana canja alama kawai.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.r.a: Ka lura cewa tazarar ta daidaita a tsakiyar 0, kuma integrand yana da sharuɗɗan ma'auni mara-ɗaya kawai.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.r.b: Integrand aikin ma'auni ma-biyu ne, saboda haka babu soke juna. Lissafta ainihin darajar.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.r.c: Tazara [0,2] ba ta daidaita a tsakiyar 0 ba. Ko da aikin ma'auni mara-ɗaya ne, tazara dole ta daidaita don hagu da dama su soke juna.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.r.d: Tazara [−1,3] ba ta daidaita a tsakiyar 0 ba. Dole ne ka ware ɓangaren da ya daidaita da wanda bai daidaita ba.
n-m-h3-integc-02.s.s3.explain: ∫_{-2}^{2}(x³−4x)dx = 0 ne domin tazarar ta daidaita kuma integrand yana da sharuɗɗan ma'auni mara-ɗaya kawai. [0,2] da [−1,3] ba su daidaita ba, saboda haka ba za ka iya cewa haɗin 0 ne nan take ba; x²−4 kuma aikin ma'auni ma-biyu ne, don haka ba ya soke kansa (darajar ita ce −32/3).

n-m-h3-integc-03.title: Ƙarar Da Aka Samu Ta Juyar da Yankin Tsakanin Zane-zane Biyu: A ina aka yi kuskure?
n-m-h3-integc-03.topic: Haɗawa: ƙarar jikin da aka samar ta juyar da yankin tsakanin zane-zane biyu (siffar ɓangaren giciye)
n-m-h3-integc-03.goal: A cikin mafita don ƙarar jikin juyawa na yankin tsakanin zane-zane biyu, nemo layin da ya sa siffar ɓangaren giciye ta zama ba daidai ba, ka gyara shi, sannan ka gano ƙarar yankin da ainihin maganar kuskuren take bayarwa.
n-m-h3-integc-03.material: Soyoung ta nemo ƙarar jikin da aka samu ta juyar da yankin da zane-zanen y=x da y=x² suka kewaye sau ɗaya a zagaye da x-axis. (x² yana nufin x murabba'i.)
n-m-h3-integc-03.thinking.0: Zana siffar ɓangaren giciye a wani wuri
n-m-h3-integc-03.thinking.1: Yi aiki daga baya domin gano yankin da maganar kuskuren take wakilta
n-m-h3-integc-03.thinking.2: Tabbatar da kuskuren ta hanyar kwatanta yankunan ɓangaren giciye kai tsaye
n-m-h3-integc-03.prereq.0: Ƙarar jikin da aka juyar a zagaye da x-axis
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko da ba daidai ba a mafitar Soyoung.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.hint.0: Zaɓi wuri ɗaya kamar x=1/2, ka zana nisan yankin daga x-axis da kuma inda ya miƙe.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yanke shawara ko ɓangaren giciye bayan juyawa faifan cikakke ne ko faifan da ke da rami.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.line.0: Zane-zanen y=x da y=x² suna haɗuwa a x=0 da x=1, kuma a kan 0≤x≤1, x≥x² ne.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.line.1: Idan aka juya wannan yanki a zagaye da x-axis, ɓangaren giciye a x yana zama da'ira mai radius x−x².
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.line.2: Saboda haka ƙarar ita ce V = π∫_0^1 (x−x²)² dx.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.line.3: Tun da (x−x²)² = x²−2x³+x⁴ ne, V = π(1/3 − 1/2 + 1/5).
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 shi ne farkon kuskure. Idan aka juya yankin tsakanin zane-zane biyu a zagaye da x-axis, ɓangaren giciye washer ne, wato faifan da ke da rami (radius na waje x, na ciki x²). Ba da'ira ba ce wadda radius ɗinta bambancin radius ɗin biyu ne. Daga layi na 3 gaba lissafin ya bi kuskuren siffar ɓangaren giciye na layi na 2; lissafin lambobi daidai ne amma sakamakon ba daidai ba ne.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.prompt: Gyara layin da ba daidai ba, ka nemo ƙarar. Sannan ta amfani da ɓangaren giciye a x=1/2, ka bayyana cikin jimloli ɗaya ko biyu dalilin da ya sa maganar Soyoung ba daidai ba ce.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.hint.0: Zana ɓangaren giciye a x domin duba ko babban da'ira ce mai radius x wadda aka cire ƙaramar da'ira mai radius x² daga cikinta.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.hint.1: A x=1/2, rubuta ka kwatanta yankunan babban da'ira, ƙaramar da'ira, da da'irar Soyoung.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.placeholder: misali, ɓangaren giciye a x shi ne ...
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta radius na waje da na ciki na ɓangaren giciye a x, sannan ka nemo yankinsa?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka kwatanta yankin ɓangaren giciye na Soyoung da daidai a x=1/2?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka gane cewa (x−x²)² da x²−x⁴ abubuwa ne daban-daban?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.model.0: Ɓangaren giciye a x washer ne mai radius na waje x da na ciki x², saboda haka yankinsa π(x²−x⁴) ne. V=π∫_0^1 (x²−x⁴)dx=π(1/3−1/5)=2π/15. A x=1/2, yankin daidai shi ne π(1/4−1/16)=3π/16, amma maganar Soyoung tana ba da da'ira mai radius 1/4, yankinta π/16 kawai ne.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s2.model.1: Ɓangaren giciye da aka samu ta juyar da yankin tsakanin zane-zane biyu shi ne babban faifan da aka cire ƙaramin faifan, wato π(x²)−π(x²)²; saboda haka ƙarar ita ce 2π/15. Murabba'in bambancin radius ba daidai yake da bambancin yankunan da'irori ba.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.prompt: Maganar da Soyoung ta samo, π∫_0^1 (x−x²)² dx, ita ce ƙarar juyar da wane yanki sau ɗaya a zagaye da x-axis?
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.hint.0: π∫_0^1 (wani aiki)² dx yana tara faifan cikakku masu radius 'darajar wannan aikin'. Nemo tsayin wane zane aikin yake wakilta.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ga kowane zaɓi, rubuta siffar ɓangaren giciye a x idan aka juya shi a zagaye da x-axis.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.o.a: Yankin da zane-zanen y=x da y=x² suka kewaye
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.a: Wannan yankin yana samar da ɓangaren giciye mai rami, saboda haka za a haɗa π(x²−x⁴). Duba ɓangaren giciye a x=1/2.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.o.b: Yankin da y=x, x-axis, da x=1 suka kewaye
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.b: Ɓangaren giciye na wannan yanki da'ira cikakkiya ce mai radius x, saboda haka yana zama π∫x²dx.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.o.c: Yankin da y=x², x-axis, da x=1 suka kewaye
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.c: Ɓangaren giciye na wannan yanki da'ira cikakkiya ce mai radius x², saboda haka yana zama π∫x⁴dx.
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.o.d: Yankin da y=x−x² da x-axis suka kewaye
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.r.d: Ka lura cewa wannan shi ne yankin da ke samar da da'irori cikakku masu radius na tsayin zane x−x².
n-m-h3-integc-03.s.s3.explain: y=x−x² ba ya ƙasa da 0 a kan 0≤x≤1, kuma idan aka juya yankin da wannan zane da x-axis suka kewaye a zagaye da x-axis, ɓangaren giciye da'ira cikakkiya ce mai radius x−x². Maganar Soyoung tana ba da ƙarar wannan yanki (π/30), ƙarar yankin da ke cikin tambaya kuwa (tsakanin zane-zanen biyu) ita ce 2π/15.

n-m-h3-integc-05.title: Tabbatattun Integrals na Ayyukan Maimaituwa: Me ya kamata ka sani?
n-m-h3-integc-05.topic: Integral: siffofin tabbatattun integrals — integrals na ayyukan maimaituwa da zaɓen bayanin da ake buƙata
n-m-h3-integc-05.goal: Lokacin nemo tabbataccen integral na aiki mai maimaituwa, ware bayanin da ake buƙata (lokacin maimaituwa da ƙimar integral na lokaci ɗaya) daga wanda ba a buƙata; ka tabbatar cewa muhimmin abu shi ne ko tsawon tazara ninki ne na lokacin maimaituwa.
n-m-h3-integc-05.material: Akwai aiki mai ci gaba f. Kana son nemo ƙimar tabbataccen integral ∫_2^{11} f(x)dx. (∫_2^{11} integral ne daga 2 zuwa 11.)
n-m-h3-integc-05.thinking.0: Bambanta bayanin da ake buƙata da wanda ba a buƙata
n-m-h3-integc-05.thinking.1: Gina misalanka da suka cika sharuɗɗan
n-m-h3-integc-05.thinking.2: Binciki yanayin da bayanan da aka bayar ba sa ƙayyade ƙima
n-m-h3-integc-05.prereq.0: Siffar raba tazara ta tabbatattun integrals
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.prompt: f aiki ne mai ci gaba a dukkan ainihin lambobi. Zaɓi duk bayanan da suke da matuƙar muhimmanci don ƙayyade ∫_2^{11} f(x)dx. (Zaɓi duk abin da ake buƙata, kada ka zaɓi abin da ba a buƙata.)
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nemo tsawon tazara [2,11], sannan raba shi da 3 ka ga sakamakon.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.hint.1: Cire kowane bayani ɗaya bayan ɗaya ka duba ko har yanzu za a iya ƙayyade ƙimar ba tare da shi ba.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.r.a: Tazarar [0,2] ba ta haɗuwa da [2,11]. Ka yi tunanin yadda za a yi amfani da wannan ƙima don samun ƙimar a [2,11].
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.r.b: Ka ga wannan yana nufin siffar tana maimaituwa duk bayan raka'a 3, don haka tana haɗa ƙimomi a tazara dabam-dabam.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.r.c: Kasancewar f ko da yana nufin kawai tana daidaito hagu da dama game da 0; ba a amfani da shi wajen raba [2,11] zuwa tazara masu maimaituwa.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.r.d: Ka ga cewa ana buƙatar ƙimar tabbataccen integral a kan tazara guda ta maimaituwa don ƙayyade jimillar ƙima.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.r.e: Ƙimar aiki a wuri guda ba ta shafar ƙimar tabbataccen integral.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s1.explain: Tsawon [2,11] shi ne 9, wato ninki 3 na lokacin maimaituwa 3. Ko ina aka fara tazarar lokaci ɗaya, integral ɗinta iri ɗaya ne; don haka ∫_2^{11} f=3×6=18. Ana buƙatar maimaituwa (b) da ƙimar integral na lokaci ɗaya (d), babu wani abu.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.prompt: Ta amfani da bayanin cewa lokacin maimaituwa 3 ne kuma ∫_0^3 f(x)dx=6 kawai, nemo tazara biyu [p,q] da za a iya ƙayyade ∫_p^q f(x)dx, sannan shigar da p da q. (p da q lambobi cikakku ne, p ba ninkin 3 ba ne, 0<p, 4≤q−p≤20, q≤40)
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko, ta amfani da maimaituwa, yi tunanin tabbataccen integral a tazarar [1,4] mai tsawon 3.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi (p,q) yadda tsawon tazara idan an raba da 3 ya zama cikakkiyar lamba, sannan tabbatar p ba ninkin 3 ba ne.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.ok.c1: p da q lambobi cikakku ne cikin iyakar da aka bayar.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.fail.c1: p da q dole su zama lambobi cikakku masu 0
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Tsawon tazara yana tsakanin 4 da 20, har da iyakokin.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Tsawon tazara q−p ba ya tsakanin 4 da 20.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.fail.c4: Tsawon tazara ba ninkin 3 ba ne, don haka ba a ƙayyade ƙimar.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.explain: Idan tsawon tazara ninkin 3 ne, ya ƙunshi tazarorin lokaci na 3 cikakku a jere; ko da inda aka fara, ƙimar ita ce (tsawo/3)×6. (1,7) yana ba da 6, (2,11) yana ba da 18, (4,19) yana ba da 30. (1,8) tsawonsa 7 ne, ba ninkin 3 ba, don haka ba a ƙayyade ƙimar; (3,9) an cire saboda p ninkin 3 ne; (1,4) kuma tsawonsa 3 ne, ƙasa da 4.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa za a iya ƙayyade ƙimar ko da wurin farawa p ba ninkin 3 ba ne.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Raba [p,q] zuwa tazarori masu jere na tsawon 3. Guda nawa za a samu?
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ta amfani da maimaituwa, yi tunanin ƙimar integrals a tazarorin tsawon 3 [1,4] da [2,5].
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.because.placeholder: misali, idan tsawon tazara ninkin 3 ne, ...
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka tabbatar cewa integral na tazara mai tsawon 3 shi ne 6 ko da a misalin da p ba ninkin 3 ba ne?
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta cewa tazara mai tsawon 9 tana rabuwa zuwa tazarorin lokaci 3?
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan tsawon tazara ninkin 3 ne, za a iya raba shi zuwa tazarorin lokaci da dama; ko ina aka fara, integral na kowane lokaci iri ɗaya ne, 6. Saboda haka ƙimar ita ce (tsawo/3)×6 ko da wurin farawa ya bambanta.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan tsawon q−p ninkin 3 ne, [p,q] ya ƙunshi tazarori masu tsawon 3 a jere. Integral na kowace tazara mai tsawon 3 shi ne 6, ko ina aka fara; saboda haka ba kome ko p ninkin 3 ne.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.prompt: An bayar da bayanin iri ɗaya (lokaci 3, ∫_0^3 f(x)dx=6). Zaɓi magana madaidaiciya game da ∫_2^{10} f(x)dx.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.hint.0: Raba [2,10] zuwa tazarori masu jere na tsawon 3, sannan nemo tsawon ɓangaren da ya rage a ƙarshe.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta ƙimomi ga ayyukan f daban-daban waɗanda duk suna da lokacin 3 da ∫_0^3 f=6 (aikin dindindin f=2 da wani guda).
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.o.a: An ƙayyade: matsakaicin tsayi a lokaci guda shi ne 2, don haka ga tsawo 8 ƙimar ita ce 16.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.r.a: Idan ba a raba tazarar zuwa lokuta cikakku ba, ba za ka iya lissafi ta matsakaicin ba. Wannan tazara tana ƙunshe da lokuta 2.67.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.o.b: An ƙayyade: tazarorin lokaci biyu suna ba da 12, kuma an ɗauki ragowar a matsayin 0.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.r.b: Babu hujjar cewa integral na ragowar tsawon 2 ya zama 0.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.o.c: Ba a ƙayyade ba: bayan cire tazarorin lokaci biyu, ba a san ƙimar ragowar tsawon 2 ba.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.r.c: Ka lura tsawon 8 ba ninkin 3 ba ne, saboda haka ba ya rabuwa daidai zuwa tazarorin lokaci.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.o.d: Ba a ƙayyade ba: saboda wurin farawa 2 ba ninkin 3 ba ne.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.r.d: Ba kome ko wurin farawa ninkin 3 ne. Ka tuna abin da ka bincika a matakin baya.
n-m-h3-integc-05.s.s3.explain: Tsawon [2,10] shi ne 8, saboda haka ya ƙunshi tazarorin lokaci biyu (tsawon 6) da ragowa mai tsawon 2. Ba za a iya sanin integral na ragowar daga bayanin da aka bayar ba. Misali, idan f(x)=2 ƙimar ita ce 16, idan f(x)=2+cos(2πx/3) kuma kusan 16.83 ce. Dukansu suna da lokacin maimaituwa 3 da ∫_0^3 f=6. Ba kome ko wurin farawa ninkin 3 ne.

n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.ok.c1: p da q lambobi cikakku ne cikin iyakar da aka bayar.
n-m-h3-integc-07.title: Idan Tabbataccen Integral Ya Fi Ƙarami, Shin Aikin Ya Fi Ƙarami a Ko'ina?
n-m-h3-integc-07.topic: Integral: siffofin tabbatattun integrals — shin akasin ƙa'idar kwatantawa yana aiki?
n-m-h3-integc-07.goal: Tabbatar ta hanyar gina misalin da ya ƙaryata cewa ƙa'idar kwatanta tabbatattun integrals hanya ɗaya ce kawai, sannan tantance abin da za a iya cewa game da akasin (wanzuwa).
n-m-h3-integc-07.material: Wannan tunanin Minsu ne game da ayyuka f da g da aka ayyana a tazara 0≤x≤2. (∫_0^2 integral ne daga 0 zuwa 2.)
n-m-h3-integc-07.thinking.1: Gina misalan ƙaryatawa da suka cika sharuɗɗan
n-m-h3-integc-07.thinking.2: Yi amfani da akasin sharadi don tantance abin da za a iya tabbatarwa
n-m-h3-integc-07.prereq.1: Tabbatattun integrals na ayyuka masu layi da dindindin
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko inda tunanin Minsu ya yi kuskure.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.hint.0: A layi na 1 da 2, nemo “sharadi” da “sakamako” a kowannensu, sannan kwatanta ko an musanya su.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin ko layi na 3 ya tabbatar cewa layi na 2 gaskiya ne koyaushe, ko misali guda ne kawai.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.line.0: Idan f(x)≤g(x) ga 0≤x≤2, to ∫_0^2 f(x)dx≤∫_0^2 g(x)dx.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.line.1: Akasin haka, idan ∫_0^2 f(x)dx<∫_0^2 g(x)dx, to f(x)<g(x) ga kowane x a 0≤x≤2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.line.2: Misali, idan f(x)=x da g(x)=3, to ∫_0^2 f(x)dx=2<6=∫_0^2 g(x)dx, kuma f(x)<g(x) a 0≤x≤2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 ne ya yi kuskure. Ƙa'idar kwatanta tabbatattun integrals tana aiki hanya ɗaya: “idan f≤g a kowane x, integral na f bai wuce na g ba.” Akasinta (idan integral ya fi ƙanƙanta, aikin ya fi ƙanƙanta a kowane x) ba gaskiya ba ne gaba ɗaya. Layi na 3 misali guda ne kawai inda hakan ya faru; ba hujja ba ce cewa layi na 2 daidai ne.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.prompt: Nuna da misalai dalilin kuskuren layi na 2 na Minsu. Ga f(x)=px da g(x)=q (p da q lambobi cikakku ne daga 1 zuwa 30), nemo nau'i-nau'i uku (p,q) inda ∫_0^2 f(x)dx<∫_0^2 g(x)dx amma akwai x a 0≤x≤2 da f(x)>g(x), sannan shigar da su.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta ∫_0^2 px dx da ∫_0^2 q dx ta amfani da p da q, sannan juya kwatantawarsu zuwa sharadi.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.hint.1: f(x)=px yana ƙaruwa yayin da x ke ƙaruwa. Rubuta sharadin kwatanta f(2) da g(2) a ƙarshen tazara, x=2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.fail.c1: p da q dole su lambobi cikakku daga 1 zuwa 30, har da su.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.ok.c2: ∫_0^2 f(x)dx=2p ya fi ƙasa da ∫_0^2 g(x)dx=2q.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.ok.c3: A x=2, f(2)=2p ya fi g(2)=q.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.explain: ∫_0^2 px dx = 2p kuma ∫_0^2 q dx = 2q. 2p<2q yana nufin p<q, kuma don f(2)=2p ya fi g(2)=q a x=2, dole q<2p. Saboda haka p<q<2p, misali (3,4), (5,7), (10,11), misalai ne masu ƙaryatawa. A (3,6), q=2p, saboda haka f(2)=g(2) kuma f(x)≤g(x) ga kowane x, don haka ba misalin ƙaryatawa ba ne.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin (p,q) da ka shigar. Ka bayar da x ɗaya inda f(x)>g(x) da ƙimomin integrals biyu, sannan bayyana yadda yake ƙaryata layi na 2 na Minsu.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Zaɓi x inda f(x)>g(x), sannan rubuta ƙimomin f da g a wurin.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Lissafa ƙimomin tabbatattun integrals biyu, ka kwatanta wanne ya fi girma.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.placeholder: misali, idan (p,q)=(...), a x=... f(x)=... kuma g(x)=..., saboda haka ...
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka tabbatar da takamaiman x inda f(x)>g(x), tare da lambobi?
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka lissafa ƙimomin integrals biyu ka tabbatar da rashin daidaito?
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan (p,q)=(3,4), to ∫_0^2 3x dx=6 kuma ∫_0^2 4 dx=8, saboda haka ∫f<∫g. Amma a x=2, f(2)=6 kuma g(2)=4, wato f(2)>g(2). Integral na f ya fi ƙanƙanta, amma a wani x aikin f ya fi girma; wannan ya ƙaryata layi na 2.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Ga (5,7), integrals ɗin su ne 10 da 14, saboda haka na f ya fi ƙanƙanta. Amma a x=2, f(2)=10 ya fi g(2)=7. Don haka ko integral ya fi ƙanƙanta, aikin ba lallai ya fi ƙanƙanta a kowane x ba.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.prompt: A ɗauka cewa ∫_0^2 f(x)dx<∫_0^2 g(x)dx. Me za ka iya tabbatarwa bisa wannan sharadi?
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta kwatancin integrals da za a samu idan aka ɗauka “f≥g a kowane x.”
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin sakamakon da ya rage idan wannan ya saɓa wa sharadin da aka bayar.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.o.a: Akwai aƙalla x guda a tazarar inda f(x)<g(x).
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.r.a: Ka yi amfani da akasin sharadin cewa idan f≥g a kowane x, to integral na f dole ya kai ko ya fi na g.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.r.b: Ba za a iya sanin ƙimar a x guda x=1 daga kwatancin integrals ba. Za ka iya gina misali inda f ya fi girma a x=1.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.r.c: Misalin ƙaryatawa na baya ya nuna cewa wannan da'awar ba daidai ba ce. Ko integral ya fi ƙanƙanta, f na iya fi girma a wani x.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.o.d: Babu x a tazarar inda f(x)>g(x).
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.r.d: A misalin ƙaryatawa, a x=2 f(2)>g(2). Akwai wuraren da f ya fi girma.
n-m-h3-integc-07.s.s3.explain: Idan f(x)≥g(x) a kowane x, dole ne ∫f≥∫g. Sharadin da aka bayar ∫f<∫g ya saɓa da wannan, saboda haka akwai x inda f(x)<g(x). Amma ba za a san inda x ɗin yake, guda nawa ne, ko akwai x inda f>g ba.

n-m-h3-integc-06.title: Haɗaɗɗen Integral: Za ka iya zaɓar u yadda ka ga dama?
n-m-h3-integc-06.topic: Integral: ma'aunin zaɓen u da v' a haɗaɗɗen integral
n-m-h3-integc-06.goal: Tabbatar cewa wahalar integral ɗin da ya rage tana danganta da yadda ka zaɓi u da v' a haɗaɗɗen integral, sannan bayyana ma'aunin zaɓe da kalmomin da aboki zai fahimta.
n-m-h3-integc-06.material: Hajun ya yi haɗaɗɗen integral na ∫ x eˣ dx da u=eˣ da v'=x, sai lissafin ya ƙara rikitarwa. Hajun ya ce, “Ba za a iya zaɓar u da v' yadda aka ga dama ba ne?” (eˣ na nufin e a ƙarfin x, ln x kuma logarithm na halitta ne.)
n-m-h3-integc-06.thinking.0: Kwatanta yadda integral ɗin da ya rage ke sauyawa gwargwadon zaɓi
n-m-h3-integc-06.thinking.1: Kafa ma'aunin zaɓe (yana sauƙaƙa idan an yi derivative / mai sauƙin integral)
n-m-h3-integc-06.prereq.1: Derivatives da integrals na ayyukan logarithm da exponent
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.prompt: Hajun ya yi ∫ x eˣ dx da u=eˣ da v'=x. Wanne ne ke bayyana abin da wannan zaɓi ke haifarwa?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.hint.0: Da u=eˣ da v'=x, nemo u' da v da kanka sannan rubuta integral ɗin gefen dama na dabara uv − ∫u'v dx.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta asalin integral da wanda ya rage, ka ga yadda ƙarfin x ya sauya.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.a: Integral ɗin da ya rage yana ɗauke da x², saboda haka ƙarfin x ya ƙaru.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.a: Ka ga cewa idan an musanya u da v', haɗa v' yana ƙara ƙarfin x; sakamakon haka integral ɗin da ya rage na iya rikitarwa fiye da na asali.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.b: Integral ɗin da ya rage ya zama 0, don haka amsar ta fito nan take.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.b: Don integral ɗin da ya rage ya zama 0, dole u'v ya zama 0. Nemo u' da v da kanka ka bincika.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.c: Dabarar haɗaɗɗen integral ba ta aiki, don haka ba za a iya warware shi ba.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.c: Dabarar tana aiki ko wane abu ka ɗauka a matsayin u. Abin da ke canzawa shi ne wahalar integral ɗin da ya rage.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.o.d: Integral ɗin da ya rage eˣ ne kawai, don haka ya fi sauƙi sosai.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.r.d: Abin da ya rage shi ne ninkin u'=eˣ da v=x²/2. Nemo u' da v da kanka.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s1.explain: Da u=eˣ da v'=x, u'=eˣ kuma v=x²/2, saboda haka ∫ x eˣ dx=(x²/2)eˣ−∫(x²/2)eˣ dx. Integral ɗin da ya rage yana da ƙarfin x mafi girma da ɗaya fiye da na asali, don haka ya fi wahala. Dabarar tana aiki, amma zaɓin bai dace ba. Idan u=x da v'=eˣ, integral ɗin da ya rage ∫eˣ dx ne kawai.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.prompt: Kana son nemo ∫ x ln x dx ta haɗaɗɗen integral. Zaɓi shawarar da ta dace ga Hajun.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi, fara duba ko za ka iya samun v nan take.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta ko ninkin u' da v ya fi asalin integral sauƙi.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.a: Mafi sauƙi shi ne u=x da v'=ln x.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.a: Samun v daga v'=ln x ba kai tsaye ba ne (v=x ln x−x). Integral ɗin da ya rage ma yana ƙunshe da ln x kuma bai fi sauƙi ba.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.b: Mafi sauƙi shi ne u=1 da v'=x ln x.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.b: Neman antiderivative na v'=x ln x daidai yake da warware matsalar asali, don haka babu ci gaba.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.c: Mafi sauƙi shi ne u=ln x da v'=x.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.c: Ka ɗauki abin da yake sauƙaƙa idan an yi masa derivative (ln x) a matsayin u, wanda kuma yake da sauƙin integral (x) a matsayin v'.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.o.d: Ba kome yadda aka zaɓa, domin integral ɗin da ya rage yana da wahala iri ɗaya; saboda haka zaɓi duk yadda kake so.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.r.d: Dangane da zaɓi, integral ɗin da ya rage zai iya sauƙaƙa ko ya fi wahala. Ka tuna abin da ya faru da Hajun a matakin baya.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s2.explain: Da u=ln x da v'=x, u'=1/x kuma v=x²/2, sannan ∫x ln x dx=(x²/2)ln x−∫(x/2)dx=(x²/2)ln x−x²/4+C. Integral ɗin da ya rage kalma ce mai sauƙi ta x. Ma'aunin zaɓe mai kyau shi ne ɗaukar abin da ke sauƙaƙa idan an yi derivative (ln x→1/x) a matsayin u, da wanda ke da sauƙin integral (x) a matsayin v'.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta amsa ga Hajun. Ya ce, “Ba za a iya zaɓar u da v' yadda aka ga dama ba ne?” Ta amfani da ∫x ln x dx a matsayin misali, bayyana da kalmomi masu sauƙi yadda za a zaɓi da kyau da dalili.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.hint.0: A cikin ∫x ln x dx, gano ko ln x ko x ne ke sauƙaƙa idan an yi derivative, da wanda ke da sauƙin integral.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta integral ɗin da ya rage da wannan zaɓin, ka yi amfani da shi a matsayin hujja ga Hajun.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana ma'aunin zaɓe a jimla guda maimakon “yadda aka ga dama”?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Da gaske ka yi amfani da ma'aunin a kan ∫x ln x dx?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka rubuta shi da kalmomin da Hajun zai fahimta (ba jerin alamomi kawai ba)?
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.model.0: Hajun, dabarar tana aiki duk yadda ka zaɓa, amma sauƙin integral ɗin da ya rage yana bambanta. Ga ∫x ln x dx, ya kamata ka ɗauki u=ln x da v'=x. ln x yana sauƙaƙa zuwa 1/x idan an yi derivative, kuma x mai sauƙin integral ne. Sai integral ɗin da ya rage ya zama ∫x/2 dx mai sauƙi.
n-m-h3-integc-06.s.s3.model.1: Gwada u=ln x da v'=x. Ka ɗauki abin da ke sauƙaƙa idan an yi derivative a matsayin u, wanda kuma ke da sauƙin integral a matsayin v'. Sai integral ɗin da ya rage ya zama x/2 kawai, wanda ake warwarewa da sauri. Idan ka ɗauki u=x, sai ka fara haɗa ln x, wanda ya fi wahala.

n-m-h3-prob-03.title: Wace Manhajar Karatu Ta Fi Tasiri?
n-m-h3-prob-03.topic: Yiwuwar: sharaɗantaccen yiwuwa, independence da dogaro, tunanin Bayes, tsara sample space
n-m-h3-prob-03.goal: Duba ko jimillar ƙima da ƙimar cikin kowace rukuni na iya nuna akasin juna; gyara hukunci a kowane mataki yayin da ake bayyana ƙarin bayanai.
n-m-h3-prob-03.material: Kana son kwatanta “kason ɗaliban da sakamakon karatunsu ya inganta” tsakanin masu amfani da manhajar A ko B a makaranta. Ana bayyana lambobin mataki-mataki.
n-m-h3-prob-03.thinking.0: Yin hukunci na farko bisa jimillar ƙimar
n-m-h3-prob-03.thinking.1: Gyara hukunci ta ƙimar sharaɗi a cikin rukuni
n-m-h3-prob-03.thinking.2: Fassara sakamakon bisa bambancin haɗin rukunoni
n-m-h3-prob-03.prereq.0: Sharaɗantaccen yiwuwa rabo ne cikin yanayin da ya cika sharaɗi
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanan mataki-mataki. A kowane mataki, zaɓi hukunci ta amfani da abin da ka sani zuwa lokacin kawai.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.hint.0: Duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana, duba ƙungiyar da adadinta kake kwatantawa.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.hint.1: Lissafta adadin gaba ɗaya da na kowane aji, sannan ka yi tunanin wanda yake kwatanta ɗaliban da suke yanayi iri ɗaya.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.info: A wata makaranta, ɗalibai suka zaɓi manhajar karatu A ko B da kansu kuma suka yi amfani da ita na zangon karatu ɗaya. Cikin ɗalibai 200 masu amfani da A, 132 sun inganta maki; cikin 200 masu amfani da B, 152 sun inganta.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wace manhaja ce take ganin ta fi inganta maki?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Adadin gaba ɗaya ya fi nuna cewa B ce. Amma idan ba mu san ko ɗaliban ƙungiyoyin biyu iri ɗaya ba ne, bai kamata mu yanke hukunci kan tasirin manhajojin daga waɗannan lambobi kaɗai ba.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: B: domin kaso na ɗaliban da makinsu ya inganta ya fi yawa
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka kwatanta adadin gaba ɗaya (66% da 76%) yadda suke. Wannan shi ne hukunci na farko da ya zo a rai.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: A: ko da kaɗan daga masu amfani da A suka inganta, dalili shi ne ɗaliban da ke fama da matsala sun fi amfani da ita
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka ɗauka ba tare da shaida ba cewa masu amfani da A ɗalibai ne masu fama da matsala. Ba mu san yanayin ɗaliban ba tukuna.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ba a kai lokacin yanke hukunci ba: ba mu san irin ɗaliban da suka yi amfani da kowace manhaja ba
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka gane ana buƙatar ƙarin bayani fiye da adadin.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.info: An sake rarraba ɗaliban zuwa aji na gaba da na asali, aka ƙirga. Manhajar A: 36 cikin 40 na aji na gaba da 96 cikin 160 na aji na asali sun inganta. Manhajar B: 136 cikin 160 na aji na gaba da 16 cikin 40 na aji na asali sun inganta.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yanzu, wace manhaja ce take ganin ta fi inganci?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.after: A aji na gaba 36/40=90% ne, B kuma 136/160=85%; a aji na asali A 96/160=60%, B kuma 16/40=40%. Adadin A ya fi yawa a duka azuzuwan, duk da cewa B ta fi gaba idan aka duba gaba ɗaya. Adadin gaba ɗaya da na kowane aji na iya nuna sakamako sabanin juna.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: B: adadinta gaba ɗaya ya fi yawa, saboda haka bayanin da aka raba bisa aji ba shi da muhimmanci
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ko da an bayar da bayanan da aka raba bisa aji, ka kalli adadin gaba ɗaya kawai. Ba ka yi amfani da kwatanta ɗalibai a aji ɗaya ba.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: A: adadinta ya fi yawa a aji na gaba (90% da 85%) da a aji na asali (60% da 40%)
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka kwatanta ɗalibai a aji ɗaya domin duba tasirin manhajar dabam-dabam.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Kusan iri ɗaya: A ta fi a aji ɗaya, B kuma a ɗayan, don haka sun soke juna
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: A ta fi a duka azuzuwan, amma ka karanta kamar B ce ta fi a ɗaya. Ka sake kwatanta lambobin.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Ɗaliban sun zaɓi manhajojin da kansu. Cikin masu amfani da A guda 200, 160 suna a aji na asali; cikin masu amfani da B guda 200, 40 ne kawai suke a aji na asali.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: A ƙarshe, wane ƙarshe ne ya fi dacewa daga waɗannan bayanai?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Aji na asali rukuni ne mai ƙarancin adadin inganta maki ko da wace manhaja aka yi amfani da ita, kuma ɗalibansa sun fi yawa cikin masu amfani da A, wanda ya rage adadin A gaba ɗaya. A cikin aji ɗaya A ce ta fi, amma da yake ɗalibai ne suka zaɓi manhajar, akwai iyaka ga cewa wannan tasirin manhajar ne.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: A tana ganin ta fi inganci. Adadinta gaba ɗaya ya yi ƙasa ne domin ɗaliban aji na asali da yawa sun yi amfani da ita; a cikin aji ɗaya A ce ta fi, amma bai tabbata ba tukuna
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka yi hukunci ta kwatanta cikin aji ɗaya, kuma ka ambaci iyakar bayanan da suka fito daga zaɓin ɗalibai da kansu.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: B tana ganin ta fi inganci. Adadin inganta makinta gaba ɗaya ya fi yawa, amma bai tabbata ba tukuna
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka bi adadin gaba ɗaya kawai. Ba ka yi amfani da bayanin cewa ɗaliban aji na asali sun fi yawa cikin masu amfani da A ba, wanda ya rage adadinta.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ba za mu iya cewa ɗaya ta fi ba. Raba bisa aji ya sauya sakamakon, saboda haka ba za a amince da bayanan gaba ɗaya ba kuma bai tabbata ba tukuna
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka yar da komai domin bayanan sun sauya sakamakon. Kwatanta cikin aji ɗaya har yanzu tana ba da bayani.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s1.reflect: Da farko ka yi hukunci daga adadin gaba ɗaya cewa B ta fi, amma bayan an raba ɗalibai rukuni-rukuni, ƙarshe ya sauya. 'Adadin inganta maki cikin masu amfani da manhajar A' da 'adadin inganta maki cikin ɗaliban aji na asali masu amfani da A' yiwuwar sharadi ne daban-daban. Don kwatantawa, fara duba ko rukunan da ake kwatantawa suna da tsari iri ɗaya.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.prompt: Ka bayyana wa abokin da ya fara tunanin 'B ta fi inganci' dalilin da ya sa adadin gaba ɗaya na B ya fi yawa alhali adadin kowane aji na A ya fi yawa, da yadda ya kamata a yi kwatancin.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ƙirga aji mafi yawan ɗaliban da suka yi amfani da A da na B suke ciki, sannan ka kwatanta.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.hint.1: Haɗa wane aji ne ɗalibansa suka fi saurin ingantawa da manhajar da yawancinsu suka yi amfani da ita.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.placeholder: misali, cikin masu amfani da A, ...
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka nuna cewa yanayin masu amfani da A ya bambanta da na masu amfani da B?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka faɗi dalilin da ya sa kwatanta cikin aji ɗaya ta fi adalci?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka haɗa dalilin bambancin adadin gaba ɗaya da na azuzuwa cikin jimla ɗaya?
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.model.0: Ɗaliban aji na asali ba sa saurin ingantawa da kowace manhaja, kuma yawancinsu suna cikin A, saboda haka adadin A gaba ɗaya ya ragu. Shi ya sa dole a kwatanta cikin aji ɗaya domin ganin tasirin manhajar.
n-m-h3-prob-03.s.s2.model.1: Yawancin masu amfani da A suna a aji na asali, inda inganta maki yake da wuya, saboda haka A ta fi muni idan aka kalli adadin gaba ɗaya kawai. Idan aka raba bisa aji aka kwatanta cikin yanayi iri ɗaya, A ta fi.

n-m-h3-prob-05.topic: Yiwuwar: sharaɗantaccen yiwuwa, independence da dogaro, tunanin Bayes, tsara sample space
n-m-h3-prob-05.title: Fuskoki Biyar a Jere: Yanzu Lokacin Jela Ne?
n-m-h3-prob-05.goal: Gano kuskuren fahimtar yiwuwa bayan jerin sakamako, sannan ka sake faɗin ra'ayin ɗaya ta yadda kanin ƙaraminka na makarantar tsakiya zai fahimta.
n-m-h3-prob-05.material: Kanin ƙaraminka yana jefa tsabar kuɗi madaidaiciya, ya ce, 'Fuska ta fito sau 5 a jere! Ba lokaci ya yi da jela za ta fito ba?' Tsabar madaidaiciya ce: fuska da jela suna da yiwuwa iri ɗaya. Kaninka yana a aji na 7.
n-m-h3-prob-05.thinking.1: Zaɓar bayani da ya dace da mai sauraro
n-m-h3-prob-05.thinking.2: Bayyana da kanka cikin kalmomi masu sauƙi
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.prompt: Ka jefa tsabar madaidaiciya, fuska ta fito sau 5 a jere. Wane bayani game da yiwuwar fuska a jifa na 6 ne daidai?
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.hint.0: Yi tunanin ko tsabar tana tuna jifofin baya ko tana ƙoƙarin rama su.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta yadda hasashen ya bambanta tsakanin 'ba mu san jifofi 5 na farko ba' da 'bayan fuska 5 ta riga ta fito.'
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.o.a: Wannan tsabar tana fifita fuska, saboda haka yiwuwar fuska ta fi 1/2.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.r.a: Ko da tsabar madaidaiciya ce, ka yi tunanin sakamakon baya ya sauya yanayinta.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.o.b: Fuska ta fito da yawa, yanzu jela ce lokacinta, kuma yiwuwar fuska ta ƙasa da 1/2.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.r.b: Ka yi tunanin dole ne a rama sakamakon baya. Tsabar ba ta tuna sakamakon baya ta daidaita su ba.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.o.c: Ko da menene sakamakon jifofi 5 na farko, yiwuwar fuska a jifa na 6 tana nan 1/2.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.o.d: Yiwuwar fuska 6 a jere ita ce 1/64, saboda haka yiwuwar fuska a jifa na 6 ma 1/64 ce.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.r.d: Ka gauraya yiwuwar hasashen duk jifofi shida tun farko da yiwuwar hasashen jifa ɗaya bayan jifofi biyar sun riga sun faru.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s1.explain: Kowace jifa ta tsabar madaidaiciya mai zaman kanta ce, don haka ko da mun san sakamakon baya, yiwuwar fuska a jifa na 6 ita ce 1/2. Yiwuwar 1/64 ta fuska 6 a jere ita ce hasashen jifofi shida duka kafin farawa; bisa sharadin cewa fuska 5 ta riga ta fito, (1/64)÷(1/32)=1/2.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.prompt: Kana son bayyana wa kaninka na aji na 7 'dalilin da ya sa jifa na 6 ma fuska ko jela ke da 50-50.' Zaɓi bayani mafi dacewa.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowane bayani, rubuta a layi ɗaya abin da kaninka zai ce a gaba.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.hint.1: Duba dabam ko abin da aka faɗa daidai ne da ko kaninka zai iya karantawa ya fahimta.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.o.a: Tun da al'amuran suna zaman kansu, P(H6 | H1~H5) = P(H6) = 1/2.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.r.a: Akwai alamomi da kalmomi masu yawa, saboda haka zai yi wa kaninka wuya ya bi. Ba a sake bayyana abu ɗaya da harshen yau da kullum ba.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.o.b: Tsabar ba ta tuna sakamakon baya. Kana jefa ta sabuwa kowane lokaci, don haka jifa na 6 ma fuska ko jela na da damar 50-50.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.o.c: Idan ka jefa sau da yawa, daga ƙarshe zai daidaita zuwa 50-50, don haka wannan karon jela ta fi yiwuwa kaɗan.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.r.c: Ka fahimci 'daga ƙarshe ya daidaita' a matsayin jifa ta gaba za ta rama fuska. A zahiri wannan yana ƙarfafa kuskuren tunani.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.o.d: Fuska biyar a jere abin mamaki ne ƙwarai. Idan fuska ta fito a karo na 6 ma, ya kamata ka zargi tsabar.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.r.d: Wannan ya yi watsi da sharadin cewa tsabar madaidaiciya ce. Wannan bayanin bai amsa kuskuren kaninka ba.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s2.explain: Kyakkyawan bayani yana sake faɗin abu ɗaya da kalmomin da kaninka ya sani. B ya bayyana zaman kai cikin sauƙi da 'ba ta tunawa' da 'kana jefa sabuwa kowane lokaci'; A daidai ne amma alamominsa suna da wuya; C yana ƙarfafa kuskuren tunani; D ya yi watsi da cewa tsabar madaidaiciya ce.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.prompt: Kaninka ya sake tambaya, 'Amma yiwuwar fuska 6 a jere 1/64 kawai ce. Idan fuska ta fito a na 6 ma, abin ba kasafai yake faruwa ba!' Ka amsa cikin kalmomi masu sauƙi da zai fahimta. (Ka guji alamomi ko kalmomi kamar P( ) ko 'sharadi'.)
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta jimla guda da ke bayyana 'lokacin' da yiwuwar 1/64 take aiki. Kafin jifa ne, ko bayan an yi jifa biyar?
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta jifa nawa suka rage yanzu, ka faɗi yiwuwar fuska a jifa guda ɗin.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.placeholder: misali, 1/64 ita ce ... Jifofi biyar na farko sun riga ...
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka faɗi lokacin da 1/64 take zama yiwuwa (lokacin hasashen duka jifofi shida kafin a fara jifa)?
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka ce yanzu, saura jifa na 6 kawai, yiwuwar ita ce 1/2?
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka yi bayani da kalmomin da kaninka ya sani kawai?
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.model.0: 1/64 ita ce damar samun fuska a duk jifofi shida, an ƙididdige ta kafin fara jifa. Yanzu jifofi 5 sun riga sun faru kuma jifa na 6 kaɗai ya rage; a wannan jifan guda, fuska da jela suna da yiwuwar iri ɗaya.
n-m-h3-prob-05.s.s3.model.1: Jifofi biyar na farko sun riga sun ƙare, tsabar ba ta tuna su. Saboda haka fuska ko jela a jifa na 6 kowacce na da dama 1/2. 1/64 damar samun duk fuska shida tun farko ce, don haka yanayin yanzu ya bambanta.

n-m-h3-prob-06.title: Ninkin Lamba a Katuna: Nemo Ma'aurata Masu Zaman Kai
n-m-h3-prob-06.goal: Ka nemo da kanka ma'auratan abubuwan ninkin da suke zaman kansu, sannan ka bayyana ta ƙirga cewa kasancewa lambobi marasa rabon gama gari bai isa ya tabbatar da zaman kai ba.
n-m-h3-prob-06.material: Kana zare kati ɗaya daga katuna 20 masu lambobi 1 zuwa 20. Seunghyeon ya yi hasashen cewa al'amarin 'an zare ninkin p' da 'an zare ninkin q' za su kasance masu zaman kansu duk lokacin da p da q ba su da rabon gama gari.
n-m-h3-prob-06.thinking.0: Yanke shawarar zaman kai ta hanyar ƙirga
n-m-h3-prob-06.thinking.2: Bayyana misalin da ya karyata cewa rashin rabon gama gari yana tabbatar da zaman kai
n-m-h3-prob-06.prereq.0: Ninkin lambobi da ninkin gama gari
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.prompt: Kana zare kati daga katuna 20 masu lamba 1 zuwa 20. Bari A ya zama al'amarin zare ninkin 3, B kuma zare ninkin 4. Menene yiwuwar P(A∩B) cewa al'amuran biyu sun faru tare?
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta duk katunan da suke ninkin 3 da duk na ninkin 4.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo katunan da suka bayyana a jerin biyun.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.o.a: 0: babu kati da yake ninkin 3 da 4 duka
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi tunanin cewa tunda 3 da 4 ba su da rabon gama gari, babu kati da ya haɗu. Amma 12 ninkin 3 ne da ninkin 4 kuma.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.o.b: 1/20: kati ɗaya kawai, 12, ya cika sharuddan duka biyun
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.o.c: 1/12: tunda 3×4=12, ɗaya bisa goma sha biyu ne
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.r.c: Ba ka ƙirga ninkin gama gari ba, ka yi amfani da 3×4 a matsayin abin ƙasan kaso. Ba ka yi amfani da cewa katuna 20 ne kawai ba.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.o.d: 1/2: kaso na katunan ninkin 3 ko ninkin 4
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.r.d: Ka samo haɗin ('ko'). Abin da ake nema shi ne 'duka biyun'.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s1.explain: Ninkin 3 su ne 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18 (katuna 6); ninkin 4 su ne 4, 8, 12, 16, 20 (katuna 5), kuma kati ɗaya kawai, 12, yana cikin jerin biyun. Saboda haka P(A∩B)=1/20, amma P(A)P(B)=6/20×5/20=3/40. Darajojin biyu sun bambanta, saboda haka A da B ba su zaman kansu ba.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.prompt: Ga p,q lambobi na halitta masu 2≤p<q≤20, nemo aƙalla nau'i-nau'i 3 daban inda A=“ninkin p” da B=“ninkin q” suke zaman kansu.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ƙirga cikin katuna 20 nawa ne ninkin p, ninkin q, da ninkin p da q tare; kwatanta 20×(katunan da suka zama duka) da (ninkin p)×(ninkin q).
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.hint.1: Fara da ƙirga ƙananan nau'i-nau'i da hannu, ka duba abin da suke da shi iri ɗaya.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Lambobi na halitta su zama masu 2≤p<q≤20.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Ba su zaman kansu. Ƙirga ninkin p, ninkin q da katunan da suka zama duka, sannan kwatanta P(A∩B) da P(A)P(B).
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.explain: Ga katuna 20, nau'i-nau'i masu yiwuwa su ne (2,3),(2,5),(2,7),(2,9),(4,5). Misali (2,5), ninkin 2 guda 10, ninkin 5 guda 4, ninkin 10 guda 2 ne; 20×2=40=10×4. (3,4) ba su da rabon gama-gari illa 1, amma 20×1=20 da 6×5=30, saboda haka ba su zaman kansu. (2,4) kuma 20×5=100 da 10×5=50, ba su zaman kansu.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.prompt: p=3, q=4 ba su da rabon gama-gari sai 1, amma ba su zaman kansu ba. Ta ƙirga, nuna dalili, ka bayyana bambanci da (2, 5) masu zaman kansu.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Rubuta yawan katuna 20 da suke ninkin 3, ninkin 4, da ninkin 12, sannan lissafa ninkin.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ƙirga adadin haka ga (2, 5), kwatanta, ka duba ko 20 na rabuwa daidai da ninkin gama-gari.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.placeholder: misali, ninkin 3 guda 6 ne, ninkin 4 kuma ...
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka ƙirga ninkin 3 guda 6, ninkin 4 guda 5, da katin gama-gari guda 1, ka kwatanta ƙimomin?
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana dalilin da lissafi iri ɗaya ke aiki ga (2,5)?
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ka guji cewa “rashin rabon gama-gari yana nufin zaman kai.”
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Ninkin 3 guda 6, na 4 guda 5 ne, katin da ya zama duka ɗaya ne, 12. P(A∩B)=1/20 amma P(A)P(B)=6/20×5/20=3/40, ba daidai ba. Ga (2,5), ninkin gama-gari 10 ne, 20 ma ninkin 10 ne; ƙirgar ta yi daidai kuma ninkin ya tabbata.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.model.1: 12 ne kawai ya zama duka, saboda haka P(A∩B)=1/20, amma 6/20×5/20=3/40, sun bambanta. Ga 2 da 5, ninkin 10 guda 2 ne cikin 20, don haka 10×4=20×2; amma ga 3 da 4, 12 ba mai raba 20 ba ne.
n-m-h3-prob-06.s.s2.because.model.2: Ninkin 3 guda 6 ne, na 4 guda 5; katin 12 guda ɗaya ne kawai suke da shi tare. Idan masu zaman kansu ne, ya kamata 6×5÷20=1.5 katuna, amma guda 1 ne. Ga (2,5), 10×4÷20=2 katuna, cikakkiyar lamba ce.

n-m-h3-prob-07.topic: Yiwuwar: sharaɗantaccen yiwuwa, independence da dogaro, tunanin Bayes, tsara sample space
n-m-h3-prob-07.title: Ƙwallo ta Farko da Ba Mu Gani Ba: Menene Yiwuwar ta Biyu?
n-m-h3-prob-07.goal: Duba yadda yiwuwar ke sauyawa idan bayanai na fitowa mataki-mataki, ka fahimci bayanin da aka koya daga baya na iya sauya yiwuwar zane na baya.
n-m-h3-prob-07.material: Za ka yi aikin ƙwallo a jaka. Ba a mayar da ƙwallo bayan cirewa, kuma kowace ƙwallo tana da yiwuwar cirewa iri ɗaya.
n-m-h3-prob-07.thinking.0: Raba yanayin da ba a sani ba, sannan haɗa ƙimomi
n-m-h3-prob-07.thinking.1: Takaita sample space ta amfani da bayanin da muka koya
n-m-h3-prob-07.thinking.2: Bambanta jerin lokaci da alkiblar bayanai
n-m-h3-prob-07.prereq.0: Ninkin yiwuwar cire ƙwallo ba tare da mayarwa ba
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai kaɗan-kaɗan. A kowane mataki zaɓi yiwuwar bisa abin da ka sani kawai.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki duba ko akwai sabon bayani kuma ko yana sauya ƙwallan da suka rage.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.hint.1: Idan akwai ƙwallon da ba ka san launinta ba, raba yanayi bisa launi, sannan tara yiwuwar.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Jaka mara gani tana ɗauke da ƙwallo ja 3 da shuɗi 5 (siffarsu iri ɗaya). Mina ta cire ɗaya ta ajiye a gefe ba tare da duba launinta ba. Sai ta sake cire wata.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Menene yiwuwar ƙwallo ta biyu da aka cire ja ce?
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.after: Idan yiwuwar wadda aka ɓoye ja ce 3/8, to ja 2/7 suka rage; idan shuɗi ce 5/8, ja 3/7 suka rage. Don haka (3/8)(2/7)+(5/8)(3/7)=21/56=3/8. Idan ba mu san ta farko ba, yiwuwar launin ta biyu daidai take da rabon farko.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka lissafa kamar launin ƙwallon da aka ɓoye tabbatacciyar shuɗiya ce. A yanzu ba mu san launinta ba.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.o.b: 3/8: raba bisa launin ɓoyayyiya da tara yana ba da rabon farko iri ɗaya
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka lissafa kamar ƙwallon da aka ɓoye tabbatacciyar ja ce. Ba mu san launinta ba yanzu.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ba za a iya ƙayyadewa ba: ba mu san launin ƙwallon ɓoyayyiya ba
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ba ka yi amfani da hanyar raba yanayi da haɗawa ba. Ko ba ka san launi ba, za ka iya lissafi idan ka san yiwuwar kowane yanayi.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.1.info: Mina ta buɗe ƙwallon da ta ɓoye, ja ce. (Ba a duba ta biyu ba tukuna.)
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yanzu menene yiwuwar ƙwallo ta biyu ja ce?
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Yanzu mun san ta ɓoye ja ce; sauran su ne ja 2 da shuɗi 5, jimilla 7. Saboda haka yiwuwar ta biyu ja ce ta ragu zuwa 2/7.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka san ƙwallon ɓoyayyiya ja ce amma ba ka rage adadin jajayen ba.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ba ka yi amfani da bayanin duba ƙwallon da aka ɓoye ba. Ƙarin bayani yana sauya abin da ya rage.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.info: Wata rana ka sake yin aikin da jaka ɗaya. A wannan karon ƙwallo ta farko tana ɓoye, amma ka buɗe ta biyu da aka cire kuma ja ce. Ba a duba ta farko ba tukuna.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Menene yiwuwar ƙwallo ta farko, wadda aka ɓoye, ja ce?
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.after: P(ta farko ja | ta biyu ja)=P(duka ja)÷P(ta biyu ja)=(3/8×2/7)÷(3/8)=2/7. Sanin ta biyu ja ce yana kama da cire jajayen ɗaya, saboda haka yiwuwar ta farko ja ce ma ta sauka daga 3/8 zuwa 2/7.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 2/7: idan mun san ta biyu ja ce, yiwuwar ta farko ja ce tana raguwa
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 3/8: an riga an cire ta farko, saboda haka sanin ta biyu ba ya sauya ta
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka rikita jerin lokaci da alkiblar bayani. Bayanin da aka koya daga baya ma na iya sauya yiwuwar sakamakon farko.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 5/7: ta biyu ja ce, saboda haka watakila ta farko shuɗiya ce
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ana tambayar yiwuwar ta farko ja ce, amma ka bayar da yiwuwar shuɗi ce. Duba ko ƙimomin biyu sun tara zuwa 1.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s1.reflect: Ba mu ga ƙwallo ba tukuna, yiwuwar ta biyu ita ce 3/8 kamar rabon farko; idan mun san ta farko, ta sauya zuwa 2/7. Haka kuma sanin ƙwallon baya ya sauya yiwuwar ta baya. Sharaɗantaccen yiwuwa ya dogara da “abin da muka sani,” ba jerin lokaci ba.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.prompt: Bayyana wa aboki dalilin da ya sa yiwuwar ƙwallo ta biyu ja ce 3/8 idan ba a san launin ta farko ba. (Abokin ya ce ba za a iya lissafi ba sai an san launin ta farko.)
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta dabam yanayin ƙwallon ɓoyayyiya ja ce da shuɗi ce, ka nemo yiwuwar ta biyu ja ce a kowane yanayi.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ninka da yiwuwar kowane yanayi, tara yanayin biyun, sannan lissafa ƙimar.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.placeholder: misali, idan ƙwallon ɓoyayyiya ja ce ko shuɗi ce, ...
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka raba yanayi bisa launin ƙwallo ta farko, ko ka ba da dalilin da ya sa yiwuwarsu iri ɗaya ce?
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta yadda ninkawa da tara yiwuwar yanayi ke ba da 3/8?
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.model.0: Idan ƙwallon ɓoyayyiya ja ce, yiwuwar ja da ya rage 2/7; idan shuɗi ce, 3/7. Ninkawa da yiwuwarsu 3/8 da 5/8, sannan tarawa, yana ba da (3/8)(2/7)+(5/8)(3/7)=3/8.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.model.1: Idan ba mu san ƙwallo ta farko ba, kowace ƙwallo cikin 8 tana iya zama wadda aka cire ta biyu daidai. Saboda haka yiwuwar ja ce ita ce rabon farko, 3/8.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.model.2: Idan ta ɓoye ja ce, sauran jajayen 2/7 ne; idan shuɗi ce, 3/7 ne. Saboda haka 3/8×2/7+5/8×3/7=3/8.
n-m-h3-prob-07.s.s2.model.3: Idan ba mu san launin ƙwallon ɓoyayyiya ba, ta biyu kamar kowace ƙwallo ce da aka zaɓa bazuwar; yiwuwar ja ce rabon farko, 3/8.

n-m-h3-serieslim-03.topic: Jerin lissafi: jimlolin ɓangare da jerin geometric marar iyaka
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.title: Ma'aunan Gama Gari na Yanki da Kewayen Murabba'ai Yayin Zana Su Akai-akai
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.goal: Koyi cewa idan siffofi masu kama juna suka maimaitu, ma'aunin gama gari na yankuna ya bambanta da na kewayen, sannan ka rubuta saƙon da zai taimaka wa aboki ya gano kuskurensa da kansa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.material: Akwai murabba'i R1 mai tsawon gefe 8. Haɗa tsakiyar gefunansa yana samar da R2; haɗa tsakiyar gefunan R2 yana samar da R3, kuma ana maimaita wannan har abada. Domin nemo jimillar yankuna da jimillar kewayen R1,R2,R3,…, Jiwon ta aika wa aboki saƙon da ke ƙasa.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.thinking.0: Bambanta ma'aunin tsawo da ma'aunin yanki
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.thinking.1: Nemo ma'aunin gama gari da ya dace da adadin da ke samar da jerin
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.thinking.2: Rubuta bayani da zai taimaka wa aboki ya bincika da kansa
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.prereq.2: Ma'aunin tsawo da na yanki a siffofi masu kama juna

n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s1.line.2: Kewayen ma murabba'ai ɗin ne, don haka zan iya amfani da ma'aunin gama gari 1/2 kuma,

n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk hanyoyin dubawa da za su taimaka wa Jiwon ta gano kuskuren da kanta.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin ko yayin aiwatar da kowace hanya Jiwon za ta ga abin da ya saɓa wa 64.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.hint.1: Duba ko hanyar tana amfani da bayani mai zaman kansa daga sakamakon Jiwon.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.o.a: Tabbatar cewa yana da ma'ana jimillar kewayen 64 ta zama rabin jimillar yanki 128
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.r.a: Kewayen da yanki adadi ne masu ma'auni daban-daban. Kwatanta 128 da 64 ba ya bincika komai.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.o.b: Nemo tsawon gefen R2 kai tsaye da ka'idar Pythagoras, ka kwatanta da gefen R1
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.r.b: Wannan hanya ce ta duba kai tsaye cewa ma'aunin gama gari na kewayen shi ne ma'aunin tsawon gefuna.

n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s2.o.d: Haɗa kewayen R1,R2,R3 da gaske, ka duba ko sun zarce 64

n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s3.hint.0: Zana hoton wane alwatika mai kusurwar dama ne gefen R2 da R1 suke samarwa (gefen karkata da kafa).
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta dangantakar ma'aunin yanki da na gefuna, sannan ka yi tunanin ko ana amfani da daraja ɗaya ga kewayen ma.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka yarda da ɓangaren da Jiwon ta yi daidai (yanki)?
