n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka ja hankalinta zuwa aikin dubawa ba tare da ba ta amsar ba?
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s3.model.0: Ka yi daidai cewa ma'aunin yankuna 1/2 ne. Amma kewayen tsawo ne, saboda haka ma'auninsa daban ne. Gefen sabon murabba'i rabin diagonal ne, wato kusan 8÷√2, kuma ma'aunin tsawon gefuna 1/√2 ne. Ma'aunin yanki murabba'in ma'aunin tsawo ne, shi ya sa 1/2 yake. Nemo gefen R2 da kanka ka kwatanta da R1.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s3.model.1: Jiwon, ka yi lissafin yanki da kyau! Amma amfani da 1/2 a matsayin ma'aunin gama gari na kewayen ya ɗauko ma'aunin yankuna ne. Ma'aunin yankuna murabba'in ma'aunin tsawo ne, don haka ma'aunin kewayen 1/√2 ne. Nemo gefen R2 ta ka'idar Pythagoras ka kwatanta da 8; idan ka tara kewayen R1,R2,R3 kuma za ka ga ko ya wuce amsarka 64.
n-m-h3-serieslim-03.s.s3.model.2: Ana auna yanki da ma'aunin murabba'i, kewayen kuma da ma'aunin tsawo, saboda haka ma'aunansu sun bambanta. Yi amfani da tushen murabba'in 2 don fara nemo sau nawa gefen R2 yake da gefen R1. Sannan yi amfani da darajar a matsayin ma'aunin gama gari.

n-m-h3-vec-01.thinking.0: Nemo layin farko da aka yi kuskure a mafita
n-m-h3-vec-01.title: Duba Mafitar da Ta Nemo Iyakokin k da Ke Ba da Kusurwa Mai Faɗi
n-m-h3-vec-01.topic: Vektoci da lissafin siffa mai girma uku
n-m-h3-vec-01.goal: Nemo ka gyara layin farko kuskure a mafitar da ta mayar da sharadin kusurwa mai faɗi zuwa alamar dot product, sannan ka yanke shawarar ko ana buƙatar irin wannan dubawa ga kusurwar kaifi.
n-m-h3-vec-01.material: Wannan mafitar Dain ce ta nemo iyakar lambobin gaske k inda kusurwar tsakanin vektoci a=(1, 2) da b=(k, −1) take faɗi. (k lambar gaske ce, ana karanta θ 'theta', −1 'negative one', kuma a·b 'a dot b'.)
n-m-h3-vec-01.thinking.1: Bambanta alkiblar 'idan' da 'saboda haka' (sharadi dole da isasshe)
n-m-h3-vec-01.thinking.2: Duba yanayi na musamman a iyaka
n-m-h3-vec-01.prereq.0: Abubuwan vektocin lebur da dot product
n-m-h3-vec-01.prereq.1: Dangantakar dot product da kusurwar vektoci biyu a·b=|a||b|cosθ
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko kuskure a mafitar Dain.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.hint.0: Yi alama ko kowane layi dole ne ya biyo daga wanda ya gabata, ko kuwa magana ce da ake buƙatar duba juyawarta dabam.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta iyakar θ inda cosθ<0 daga 0° zuwa 180°, tare da iyakokin.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.line.1: Idan kusurwar faɗi ce, cosθ<0 kuma |a|,|b| tabbatattu ne, saboda haka a·b<0.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.line.2: Akasin haka, idan a·b<0 kusurwar faɗi ce, saboda haka sharadin kusurwa mai faɗi kaɗai a·b<0 ne.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.line.4: Saboda haka iyakar k ita ce k < 2.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s1.explain: Kuskure yana farawa a layi na 3. Layi na 2 ya faɗi alkibla guda kawai: 'idan kusurwar faɗi ce, to a·b<0.' Layi na 3 ya ɗauki akasin alkiblar ('idan a·b<0, kusurwar faɗi ce') kai tsaye, amma a·b<0 ya haɗa duk yanayin θ ya fi 90° kuma bai wuce 180° ba, saboda haka 180° ma yana ciki (vektoci masu kishiyar alkibla daidai). Layi na 4 da 5 suna biyo daga layi na 3, saboda haka ƙarshe ba daidai ba ne. Lissafin layi na 1 daidai ne.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.prompt: Gyara layin kuskure ka rubuta iyakar k daidai. Sannan idan akwai darajar da za a cire daga iyaka, rubuta ta, ka bayyana yadda vektocin biyu suke a wannan darajar.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.hint.0: Fara nemo k inda b yake ainihin ninkin a (vektoci masu layi ɗaya).
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ga wannan k, rubuta alamar a·b da alkiblar vektoci biyun gefe da gefe ka kwatanta.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.placeholder: misali, a·b<0 ne, amma ya haɗa yanayin da ..., saboda haka ...
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka nemo darajar k da b yake layi ɗaya da a?
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: A wannan darajar, ka duba alamar a·b da girman kusurwar duka?
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Za ka iya bayyana cikin jimla ɗaya dalilin da ya sa 'a·b<0' da 'kusurwa mai faɗi' ba magana ɗaya ba ne?
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.model.0: Domin b ya yi layi ɗaya da a, daga (k, −1)=λ(1, 2) ana samun λ=−1/2 da k=−1/2. Sai a·b=−5/2 mara kyau ne, amma b yana nuna kishiyar alkiblar a daidai, don haka kusurwar 180° ce, ba mai faɗi ba. Saboda haka iyakar k<2, k≠−1/2.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.model.1: Idan a·b<0, to 90°<θ≤180°, saboda haka an haɗa 180° ma. Idan k=−1/2, b=(−1/2,−1)=−(1/2)a, suna layi ɗaya amma kishiyar alkibla. A cire wannan darajar, k<2 kuma k ba −1/2 ba ne.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Za ka iya rubuta ta da alamomi a matsayin k<−1/2 ko −1/2<k<2.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.prompt: Ta wannan hanya, an warware iyakar m da kusurwar tsakanin a=(1, 2) da c=(m, 4) take kaifi ta amfani da 'a·c>0'. Zaɓi darajar da dole ne a duba dabam ko a cire daga iyakar.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.hint.0: Fara nemo m inda c yake ninkin a na gaske mai tabbataccen ma'auni.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.hint.1: Duba ko m ɗin yana cikin darajojin da suka cika a·c>0.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.r.a: m=−8 ita ce inda a·c=0; alamar '>' ta riga ta cire ta. Ba sabuwar daraja ce da za a duba ba.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.r.b: Wannan zaɓi yana bincika ko cikin darajojin a·c>0 akwai yanayin da c yake layi ɗaya da a a alkibla guda.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.r.c: c=(8, 4) ba layi ɗaya da a ba ne. Daraja ce ta yau da kullum mai kusurwa kaifi.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.r.d: c=(−2, 4) yana da a·c>0 kuma ba layi ɗaya da a ba ne. Daraja ce ta yau da kullum mai kusurwa kaifi.
n-m-h3-vec-01.s.s3.explain: Idan a·c=m+8>0, to m>−8. Cikin waɗannan, yanayin c=(m, 4) yake layi ɗaya da a=(1, 2) a alkibla guda shi ne c=2a, wato m=2; kusurwar a lokacin 0° ce, ba kaifi ba. Don haka m>−8, m≠2. Ga faɗi, kishiyar alkibla daidai (180°) ce ke shiga a iyaka; ga kaifi, alkibla ɗaya ce (0°).

n-m-h3-vec-02.topic: Vektoci da lissafin siffa mai girma uku
n-m-h3-vec-02.title: Me Ya Kamata Mu Sani Don Nemo Nisan Tsakanin Batu da Shimfiɗa?
n-m-h3-vec-02.goal: Tantance bayanin da ya isa da wanda bai isa ba domin ƙayyade nisan batu zuwa shimfiɗa, bayyana yanayin rashin isasshen bayani da misalan karya, sannan ka kafa ma'aunin shimfiɗa na zahiri ka nemo nisan.
n-m-h3-vec-02.material: Kana son nemo nisan batu P(1, 1, 1) a sarari zuwa shimfiɗa α. A ɗauka an bayar da kowane bayani na ƙasa dabam game da α. (Vektor normal vektori ne da yake daidai da shimfiɗar. Ana karanta ma'aunai (x,y,z).)
n-m-h3-vec-02.thinking.0: Bambanta bayanin da ake buƙata da wanda ya isa
n-m-h3-vec-02.thinking.1: Bayyana rashin isasshen bayani ta misalan karya
n-m-h3-vec-02.thinking.2: Kafa ma'aunin shimfiɗa daga batu uku
n-m-h3-vec-02.prereq.0: Ma'aunin shimfiɗa ax+by+cz+d=0 da vektocin normal
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.prompt: Cikin bayanan da ke ƙasa, zaɓi duk wanda idan shi kaɗai aka bayar zai ƙayyade nisan P zuwa α a matsayin daraja guda.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane bayani, zana a rai shimfiɗu nawa za su iya cika shi.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.hint.1: Idan za ka iya nemo shimfiɗu biyu masu nisan daban, wannan bayanin bai isa ba.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.a: Ana iya juya shimfiɗu da ke bi ta batu biyu a kewayen layin da ya bi ta cikinsu, saboda haka akwai marasa iyaka. Ba a ƙayyade nisan ba.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.o.b: Batu ɗaya a α da vektorin normal na α
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.b: Batu yana ƙayyade wurin shimfiɗar, vektorin normal kuma karkatarwarta. Ka lura wannan bayani yana ƙayyade shimfiɗa guda ɗaya.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.c: Vektorin normal yana nuna karkatar shimfiɗa kawai. Akwai shimfiɗu masu layi ɗaya marasa iyaka masu normal iri ɗaya.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.o.d: Batu uku a α waɗanda ba sa kan layi ɗaya
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.d: Batu uku da ba sa kan layi ɗaya suna ƙayyade shimfiɗa guda ɗaya. Da zarar an san shimfiɗar, an san nisan ma.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.o.e: Batu uku a α da suke kan layi ɗaya
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.r.e: Idan batu ukun suna kan layi ɗaya, a zahiri bayanin layi ɗaya ne kawai, don haka ba a ƙayyade shimfiɗar ba.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s1.explain: Domin a ƙayyade nisan da daraja guda, dole ne a san shimfiɗa α ta musamman. Ana ƙayyade shimfiɗa ta 'batu da vektorin normal' ko 'batu uku da ba sa kan layi ɗaya.' Batu biyu daban ko uku a layi ɗaya suna barin shimfiɗu marasa iyaka, normal kaɗai kuma yana barin shimfiɗu masu layi ɗaya marasa iyaka.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.prompt: Bayanin 'vektorin normal na α kaɗai aka bayar' ba ya ƙayyade nisan. Ka bayyana da misalai shimfiɗu biyu masu normal iri ɗaya amma nisan su daga P ya bambanta.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta ma'aunan shimfiɗu biyu masu vektorin normal (0, 0, 1).
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo nisan P zuwa kowace shimfiɗa biyu, ka kwatanta.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.placeholder: misali, ko da vektocin normal iri ɗaya ne, ...
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta ma'aunan shimfiɗun biyu dalla-dalla?
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka lissafta nisan P zuwa kowace shimfiɗa ka nuna sun bambanta?
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Za ka iya bayyana da kalmomin 'karkata iri ɗaya, wuri daban'?
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.0: Ko da vektorin normal iri ɗaya ne, (1, 0, 0), shimfiɗu x=2 da x=5 shimfiɗu ne masu layi ɗaya daban. Nisansu daga P(1, 1, 1) su ne 1 da 4, sun bambanta.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.1: Akwai shimfiɗu masu layi ɗaya marasa iyaka masu normal iri ɗaya amma wurarensu daban. Misali z=0 da z=3 suna da normal iri ɗaya, amma nisan daga P ya bambanta, 1 da 2.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.2: Shimfiɗu z=0 da z=3, masu normal (0,0,1), suna da nisan 1 da 2 daga P(1,1,1).
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s2.model.3: Shimfiɗu z=1 da z=4 suna da normal ɗaya (0,0,1). Nisansu daga P su ne 0 da 3, don haka sun bambanta.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.prompt: A ɗauka α tana bi ta batu uku A(1, 0, 0), B(0, 2, 0), C(0, 0, 3). Zaɓi nisan daga P(1, 1, 1) zuwa α.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.hint.0: Yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa batun ukun suna kan gatarin ma'aunai domin fara kafa ma'aunin shimfiɗar, ka tabbatar ta maye gurbin batun ukun.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.hint.1: Duba cewa abin ƙasan kaso a tsarin nisa shi ne girman vektorin normal.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.a: Wataƙila ka yi amfani da murabba'in darajar 49 a ƙasan kaso maimakon girman vektorin normal √(36+9+4)=7.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.b: Ka kafa shimfiɗar 6x+3y+2z=6, ka samu 6+3+2−6=5, sannan ka raba da girman normal 7.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.c: Wataƙila ba ka cire ma'aunin tsayayye 6 na shimfiɗar daga darajar 6+3+2 da aka maye gurbin ba.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.r.d: Wataƙila ka ɗauki wuraren tsinkayen 1, 2, 3 a matsayin ma'aunai, ka kafa shimfiɗar kamar x+2y+3z=1.
n-m-h3-vec-02.s.s3.explain: Batu ukun suna da tsinkayen x=1,y=2,z=3, saboda haka shimfiɗar x/1+y/2+z/3=1 ce, wato 6x+3y+2z−6=0. Nisan daga P shi ne |6+3+2−6|/√(36+9+4)=5/7.

n-m-h3-vec-03.topic: Vektoci da lissafin siffa mai girma uku
n-m-h3-vec-03.title: Idan Vektocin Alkibla Suna Layin Ɗaya, Shin Layukan Su Ne Ɗaya?
n-m-h3-vec-03.goal: Tantance irin shaida daga vektocin alkibla da batu na layuka biyu da ta isa yanke ko layukan ɗaya ne, sannan ka bincika da kanka yanayin da shaidar ba ta isa ba.
n-m-h3-vec-03.material:
An rubuta layuka uku a sarari da ma'aunan t da s. (t da s lambobin gaske ne. Ana karanta l1 'l one', kuma (2,−1, 1) vektori ne mai abubuwan 2,−1, 1.)
l1: (x,y,z)=(1, 0, 2)+t(2,−1, 1)
l2: (x,y,z)=(3,−1, 3)+s(−4, 2,−2)
l3: (x,y,z)=(3,−1, 4)+s(−4, 2,−2)
Mina, Hajun, Seoyun, da Dohyun sun yi waɗannan ikirari game da dangantakar l1 da l2.
n-m-h3-vec-03.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci kan dangantakar ikirari da shaida
n-m-h3-vec-03.thinking.1: Duba ko layuka ɗaya ne ko da maganganun sun bambanta
n-m-h3-vec-03.thinking.2: Bambanta sharuddan da ake buƙata da waɗanda suka isa
n-m-h3-vec-03.prereq.0: Ma'aunin vektori (siffar parametric) na layi a sarari
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.prompt: Cikin ikirarin mutane huɗu game da l1 da l2, zaɓi wanda dalilinsa ba shi da gibi.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.hint.0: Fara duba adadin da za a ninka vektorin alkibla ɗaya da shi domin samun ɗayan.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.hint.1: Sannan saka ma'aunan batun da l2 ke bi ta cikinsa cikin tsarin l1, ka duba ko akwai t da ya dace.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.a: Mina: Vektocin alkibla (2,−1, 1) da (−4, 2,−2) ba daidai ba ne, saboda haka l1 da l2 layuka daban ne.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.a: Ka kalli cewa vektocin alkibla ba magana iri ɗaya ba ne kawai. Ana iya rubuta vektorin alkibla na layi da tsawo ko alama daban.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.b: Hajun: Vektocin alkibla (2,−1, 1) da (−4, 2,−2) suna layi ɗaya, saboda haka l1 da l2 layi ɗaya ne.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.b: Ƙarshe daidai ne amma dalili bai isa ba. Layuka masu vektocin alkibla masu layi ɗaya kawai na iya zama layuka biyu masu layi ɗaya dabam.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.c: Seoyun: Vektocin alkibla (2,−1, 1) da (−4, 2,−2) ba sa layi ɗaya, saboda haka l1 da l2 skew ne.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.c: (−4, 2,−2) ya ninka (2,−1, 1) da −2, saboda haka suna layi ɗaya. Ba ka ma bincika lissafin ko suna layi ɗaya ba.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.o.d: Dohyun: Vektocin alkibla suna layi ɗaya kuma batu (3,−1, 3) da l2 ke bi a cikinsa yana kan l1, saboda haka layukan biyu ɗaya ne.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.r.d: Alkiblar iri ɗaya ce kuma suna da batu gama gari, saboda haka layukan sun zo wuri guda. An bincika sharuddan biyu a matsayin shaida.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s1.explain: (−4, 2,−2)=−2(2,−1, 1), saboda haka vektocin suna layi ɗaya. Haka kuma, saka t=1 cikin l1 yana ba (3,−1, 3), don haka batun l2 yana kan l1. Idan alkiblar ta yi layi ɗaya kuma batu ɗaya ya zo wuri guda, layukan ɗaya ne. Vektocin alkibla masu layi ɗaya kaɗai ba su isa ba; kuma bambancin rubutun vektoci ba ya nufin layukan sun bambanta.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.prompt: A wannan karon, kwatanta l3 (batu (3,−1, 4), vektorin alkibla (−4, 2,−2)) da l1. Yanke ko layukan ɗaya ne, ka rubuta dalili tare da lissafinka.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.hint.0: Daidaita ma'aunan x da y na batu l3 (3,−1, 4) da tsarin l1, ka nemo t.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.hint.1: Yi amfani da t ɗin don lissafta ma'aunin z ma, ka kwatanta da batun l3.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.placeholder: misali, vektorin alkiblar l3 ... batun l3 ...
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka fara duba ko vektocin alkibla suna layi ɗaya?
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka saka batun l3 cikin tsarin l1 ka kwatanta dukkan ma'aunai ukun?
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka faɗi cewa 'layuka na iya samun alkibla mai layi ɗaya ba tare da zama layi ɗaya ba'?
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.model.0: Vektorin alkiblar l3 ya ninka na l1 da −2, saboda haka suna layi ɗaya. Amma idan muka saka batu l3 (3,−1, 4) cikin l1, x da y suna ba t=1, sannan z=3, wanda ya bambanta da 4; don haka batun ba ya kan l1. Layukan suna layi ɗaya amma ba ɗaya ba.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s2.model.1: Ko da alkibla iri ɗaya ce, ba za mu ce layukan ɗaya ba ne. Daga (1+2t,−t, 2+t)=(3,−1, 4), ma'aunai na farko biyu suna ba t=1 amma na uku t=2, saɓani ne. Batu ba ya kan l1, saboda haka layuka biyu ne masu layi ɗaya.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.prompt: Zaɓi dangantakar layi l4: (x,y,z)=(5,−2, 4)+u(−6, 3,−3) da l1.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.hint.0: Fara nemo alaƙar ninkin vektocin alkibla.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.hint.1: Saka batun l4 cikin tsarin l1 domin bincika ko yana kan l1.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.o.a: Yana layi ɗaya da l1 amma layi daban ne
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.a: Ka duba vektocin alkibla masu layi ɗaya kawai, ba ka duba ko batu yana kan l1 ba.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.b: Wannan zaɓin ya bincika duka layin vektocin alkibla da kasancewar batu a l1.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.o.c: Yana haɗuwa da l1 a batu guda
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.c: Layuka masu vektocin alkibla layi ɗaya ba za su haɗu a batu guda kawai ba. Idan sun haɗu, sun zama layi ɗaya; in ba haka ba ba sa haɗuwa.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.r.d: Layuka masu alkibla layi ɗaya ba za su zama skew ba. Layukan skew ba layi ɗaya ba ne kuma ba sa haɗuwa.
n-m-h3-vec-03.s.s3.explain: (−6, 3,−3)=−3(2,−1, 1), saboda haka suna layi ɗaya. Saka t=2 cikin l1 yana ba (5,−2, 4), saboda haka batun l4 yana kan l1. Don haka l4 layi ɗaya ne da l1. Ana iya bayyana layi ɗaya da kowane zaɓin batu da vektorin alkibla.

n-m-h3-vec-05.topic: Vektoci da lissafin siffa mai girma uku
n-m-h3-vec-05.title: Ƙirƙirar layi da ba ya haɗuwa da faifai
n-m-h3-vec-05.goal: Kada ka ɗauki sharadin da zai sa layi kada ya haɗu da faifai a matsayin sharadi guda a kan vector ɗin alkibla kawai; ka kuma yi la’akari da yanayin da layin yake cikin faifai, sannan ka ƙirƙiri misalai.
n-m-h3-vec-05.material: A sarari akwai faifai α: x + y − 2z = 0. Kana son ƙirƙirar layi l da ya ratsa ta wurin (p, 1, 1), mai vector ɗin alkibla (a, b, c), ta yadda ba zai haɗu da α ba. (Ana karanta l da “el”, p lamba ce cikakkiya, kuma vector ɗin alkibla (a, b, c) shi ne vector mai sassan a, b, c.)
n-m-h3-vec-05.thinking.0: Ƙirƙirar misalai da kanka waɗanda suka cika sharuɗɗan
n-m-h3-vec-05.thinking.1: Duba iyakar da ke tsakanin layi mai layi ɗaya da faifai da layi da ke cikin faifai
n-m-h3-vec-05.thinking.2: Tantance matsayin layi dangane da faifai ta amfani da sharuɗɗa biyu
n-m-h3-vec-05.prereq.0: Daidaiton layi da daidaiton faifai a sarari
n-m-h3-vec-05.prereq.1: Vector na al'ada na faifai da samfurin dot
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi (p, a, b, c) ta yadda layi l: (x, y, z) = (p, 1, 1) + t(a, b, c) ba zai haɗu da faifai α: x + y − 2z = 0 ba. p, a, b, c lambobi ne cikakku, kuma (a, b, c) ba zai zama vector marar sifili ba. Domin kada a maimaita vector ɗin alkibla masu alkibla iri ɗaya, dole ne mafi girman rabon bai ɗaya na a, b, c ya zama 1, kuma ko dai a>0 ko kuma (a=0 da b>0). Ka ƙirƙiri misalai uku masu vector ɗin alkibla daban-daban.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko ka tantance alaƙar da ya kamata ta kasance tsakanin vector ɗin alkibla da vector na al'ada na faifai domin layin ya kasance layi ɗaya da faifai.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.hint.1: Bayan ka ƙirƙiri misali ɗaya, ka kuma duba ko wani batu a kan layin yana cikin faifai.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.var.a: sashen x na vector ɗin alkibla a
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.var.b: sashen y na vector ɗin alkibla b
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.var.c: sashen z na vector ɗin alkibla c
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c1: p, a, b, c lambobi ne cikakku masu ƙimar cikakkiya da ba ta wuce 50 ba.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c1: p, a, b, c dole ne su zama lambobi cikakku masu ƙimar cikakkiya da ba ta wuce 50 ba.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c2: Vector ɗin alkibla ba sifili ba ne, mafi girman rabon bai ɗaya nasa 1 ne, kuma sharadin alamar ma ya cika.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c2: Vector ɗin alkibla kada ya zama sifili, mafi girman rabon bai ɗaya nasa ya zama 1, kuma ko dai a>0 ko kuma (a=0 da b>0).
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c3: Vector ɗin alkibla yana tsaye wa vector na al'ada na faifai daidai.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c3: Duba alaƙar da ke tsakanin vector ɗin alkibla da vector na al'ada na faifai (1, 1, −2) domin alkiblar layin ta kasance layi ɗaya da faifai.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.ok.c4: Batu a kan layin ba ya cikin faifai.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.fail.c4: Duba ko layin ba ya haɗuwa da faifai a ko da batu guda, da kuma ko batu (p, 1, 1) da ke kan layin yana cikin faifai.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.explain: Vector na al'ada na faifai shi ne (1, 1, −2). Domin layi kada ya haɗu da faifai, vector ɗin alkiblarsa dole ya tsaya wa vector ɗin al'ada daidai, don haka a+b−2c=0. Amma wannan kaɗai na iya sa layin ya kasance cikin faifai. Idan batu (p, 1, 1) da ke kan layin yana cikin faifai (p+1−2=0, wato p=1), to layin gaba ɗaya yana cikin faifai. Saboda haka ana kuma buƙatar p≠1.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.prompt: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa ba za ka iya amfani da vector ɗin alkibla mai cika a+b−2c=0 ba idan p=1.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.hint.0: Idan p=1, saka haɗin gwiwar batu da layin ya ratsa ta cikinsu cikin daidaiton faifai.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.hint.1: Ka yi tunani game da abin da zai faru da sauran batutuwan da ke kan layin idan an kuma yi amfani da sharadin vector ɗin alkibla.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.placeholder: misali, idan p=1, wani batu a kan layin ...
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Ka lissafa ko batu (1, 1, 1) da ke kan layin yana cikin faifai x+y−2z=0 lokacin da p=1?
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Za ka iya bayyana dalilin da ya sa sharadin vector ɗin alkibla kaɗai ba ya tabbatar da cewa “ba ya haɗuwa”?
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.model.0: Idan p=1, batu (1, 1, 1) da layin ya ratsa ta cikinsa yana cikin faifai. Kuma idan alkiblar layin ma ta kasance layi ɗaya da faifai, kowane batu a kan layin yana cikin faifai, saboda haka layin yana cikin faifai. Don haka ba wai ya guji haɗuwa da faifai ba ne; yana haɗuwa da shi a batutuwa marasa iyaka.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s1.because.model.1: Idan p=1, (1,1,1) yana cika daidaiton faifai x+y−2z=0, don haka batu a kan layin yana cikin faifai. Vector ɗin alkibla yana tsaye wa vector na al'ada daidai, saboda haka layin gaba ɗaya yana cikin faifai; wannan yana sa ya kasance cikin faifai maimakon ya kasance layi ɗaya da shi kawai.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi dangantakar da ke tsakanin layi m: (x, y, z) = (1, 0, 0) + t(0, 1, 1) da faifai β: y − z = 0.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ka lissafa samfurin dot na vector ɗin alkibla da vector na al'ada na faifai.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.hint.1: Saka haɗin gwiwar batu da layin ya ratsa ta cikinsa cikin daidaiton faifai.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.a: Wataƙila ba ka duba ko samfurin dot na vector ɗin alkibla da vector na al'ada (0, 1, −1) 0 ne ba.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.o.b: Yana layi ɗaya da faifai kuma ba ya haɗuwa da shi
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.b: Wataƙila ka duba kawai cewa alkiblar layin tana layi ɗaya da faifai, amma ba ka duba ko batu da ke kan layin yana cikin faifai ba.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.c: A wannan zaɓin an duba cewa vector ɗin alkibla yana tsaye wa vector na al'ada daidai, da kuma cewa batu (1, 0, 0) da ke kan layin yana cikin faifai.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.o.d: Layin yana tsaye wa faifai daidai
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.r.d: Idan vector ɗin alkibla yana tsaye wa vector na al'ada daidai, layin yana layi ɗaya da faifai. Domin layin ya tsaya wa faifai daidai, vector ɗin alkibla dole ya kasance layi ɗaya da vector na al'ada.
n-m-h3-vec-05.s.s2.explain: Samfurin dot na vector ɗin alkibla (0, 1, 1) da vector na al'ada (0, 1, −1) shi ne 0, don haka layin yana layi ɗaya da faifai. Haka kuma, batu (1, 0, 0) yana cika y−z=0, saboda haka yana cikin faifai. Don haka layin yana cikin faifai.

n-m-h3-vec-06.topic: Vektoci da lissafin siffa mai girma uku
n-m-h3-vec-06.title: Bayyana samfurin dot ga ƙane ko ƙanwarka da bai riga ya koyi cosine ba
n-m-h3-vec-06.goal: Bayyana ma'anar samfurin dot (lamba guda da ke nuna gwargwadon yadda vector biyu suke nuni zuwa alkibla ɗaya) ga masu sauraro da ba su san cosine ba, ta hanyar sauya yanayin misalin.
n-m-h3-vec-06.material: Jisu ta bayyana wa ƙanenta ko ƙanwarta mai aji 7 samfurin dot na vector kamar haka: “Samfurin dot na vector a da b biyu shi ne |a||b|cosθ. Kana ninka sassan su ne kawai sannan ka tara, kuma sakamakon 0 ne idan sun tsaya wa juna daidai.” Ƙanenta ko ƙanwarta bai koyi cos ba tukuna, don haka ya tambaya, “Amma mene ne samfurin dot?” (|a| shi ne girman a, ana karanta θ da “theta”, kuma cos shi ne cosine.)
n-m-h3-vec-06.thinking.0: Sauya kalmomin bayani su dace da masu sauraro
n-m-h3-vec-06.thinking.1: Sanya ma'anar cikin wani yanayi na zahiri
n-m-h3-vec-06.thinking.2: Bayyana yanayin saɓanin alkibla da kuma tsayuwa daidai ma
n-m-h3-vec-06.prereq.0: Ma'anar samfurin dot da kusurwar da ke tsakanin vector biyu
n-m-h3-vec-06.prereq.1: Alamar samfurin dot da sharadin tsayuwa daidai
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi jimlar da ta fi bayyana ma'anar samfurin dot da kalmomin da ƙanenka ko ƙanwarka zai fahimta.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko ka faɗi ko kowace jimla tana cewa sakamakon samfurin dot lamba ce ko vector.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.hint.1: Gwada kowace jimla ɗaya bayan ɗaya a yanayin da vector biyun suke nuni alkibla ɗaya, suke tsaye wa juna daidai, da kuma suke nuni saɓanin alkibla.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.a: Samfurin dot lamba guda ce da ke nuna gwargwadon yadda vector ɗaya yake nuni zuwa alkiblar ɗayan, tare da la'akari da girmansu.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.a: Wannan bayani ya ƙunshi dukkan halayen samfurin dot: ƙimarsa tana ƙaruwa yayin da alkiblar vector ɗin biyu ta ƙara kama da juna, tana zama 0 idan sun tsaya wa juna daidai, kuma tana zama mara kyau idan suna nuni saɓanin alkibla.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.b: Samfurin dot lissafi ne da ake ninka sassan vector biyu da juna domin a samar da sabon vector. Sakamakon ma kibiya ce.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.b: Sakamakon samfurin dot ba vector ba ne, lamba guda ce. Ka gauraya hanyar lissafin da irin sakamakon da ake samu.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.c: Samfurin dot shi ne ninkar girman vector biyun. Yana bayar da ƙima ɗaya komai alkiblar da kibiyoyin biyu suke nuni.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.c: Ƙimar samfurin dot tana dogara da kusurwar da ke tsakanin vector biyun. Wannan bayani bai kula da alkibla ba.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.o.d: Samfurin dot ƙima ce da ke gaya maka kusurwar da ke tsakanin vector biyu a digiri. Idan suna a kusurwar da ta kai ta dama, za ka samu 90.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.r.d: Samfurin dot ba ita ce kusurwar da kanta ba. Idan kusurwar ta kai ta dama, samfurin dot 0 ne, ba 90 ba.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s1.explain: Samfurin dot lamba guda ce da ta dogara da girman vector biyun da kuma kusurwar da ke tsakaninsu. Tana ƙaruwa yayin da alkiblar vector ɗin ta ƙara kama da juna, tana zama 0 idan sun tsaya wa juna daidai, kuma tana zama mara kyau idan suna nuni saɓanin alkibla. A ya ɗauki sakamakon a matsayin vector, B bai kula da alkibla ba, D kuma ya gauraya shi da kusurwar kanta.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.prompt: Yanzu ka rubuta bayanin da za ka aika wa ƙanenka ko ƙanwarka da kanka. (1) Ka bayyana shi da yanayin jan sled da igiya, (2) ka kwatanta jan shi a alkiblar da sled ɗin ke tafiya da jan shi a tsaye (zuwa sama), sannan (3) kada ka yi amfani da kalmomi kamar cos, θ, ko projection.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ka yi tunanin yanayin da alkiblar tafiyar sled da alkiblar jan igiyar suke iri ɗaya.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.hint.1: Sannan ka yi tunani game da yawan ƙarfin jan igiyar da ake amfani da shi wajen tafiya gaba idan jan yana a kusurwar dama da alkiblar motsi.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.placeholder: misali, idan kana jan sled da igiya, ...
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka sauya shi zuwa yanayin da ƙanenka ko ƙanwarka zai fahimta (sled, keken turawa, da sauransu)?
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka kwatanta alkibla iri ɗaya, alkibla karkatacciya, da yanayin tsayuwa daidai?
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana da kalmomi “yawan ƙarfin da ake amfani da shi a alkibla ɗaya” maimakon amfani da dabara?
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.0: Idan kana jan sled da igiya, idan igiyar tana cikin alkiblar da sled ɗin ke tafiya, duk ƙarfin jan naka yana taimaka masa ya tafi gaba. Idan igiyar ta karkata, wani ɓangare na ƙarfin ne kawai ake amfani da shi, kuma idan ka ja ta miƙe zuwa sama, ba a amfani da ko wani ɓangare wajen tafiya gaba, don haka ƙimar 0 ce. Samfurin dot lamba guda ce da ke nuna yawan ƙarfin da ake amfani da shi a alkiblar tafiyarsa.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.1: Idan kana tura keken hannu, zai fi tafiya idan ka tura shi a alkiblar da yake nufi. Idan alkiblar turawar ta karkata kaɗan, ba zai tafi sosai ba, kuma idan ka tura shi gefe a kusurwar dama, hakan ba ya taimaka masa ya tafi gaba, don haka ƙimar 0 ce. Samfurin dot lamba ce da ke nuna yadda kibiyoyi biyu suke nuni alkibla ɗaya.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.2: Idan ka ja igiyar zuwa sama, ba a amfani da ƙarfin wajen tafiya gaba, don haka ƙimar 0 ce. Idan alkiblar jan ta yi daidai da ta sled ɗin, ana amfani da duk ƙarfin.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s2.model.3: Idan ka ja kai tsaye a alkiblar da sled ɗin ke tafiya, ana amfani da duk ƙarfin, idan kuma jan ya karkata, ana amfani da wani ɓangare ne kawai. Idan ya tsaya a kusurwar dama, ƙimar 0 ce.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.prompt: Ƙanenka ko ƙanwarka ya tambaya, “To, wane irin yanayi ne samfurin dot zai zama mara kyau?” Zaɓi yanayin da ya dace a misalin sled.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.hint.0: Ga alkibla iri ɗaya, tsayuwa daidai, da alkibla saɓani, rubuta ko kowanne yana taimaka wa tafiya gaba ko yana hana ta.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta yadda alamar samfurin dot take da alaƙa da gwargwadon taimakonsa.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.a: Lokacin da igiyar ke jan sled ɗin daidai a alkiblar da yake tafiya
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.r.a: A alkibla ɗaya, samfurin dot shi ne mafi girman lamba mai kyau.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.b: Lokacin da aka ja igiyar zuwa sama a kusurwar dama
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.r.b: A kusurwar dama, samfurin dot 0 ne.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.c: Lokacin da igiyar ke jan sled ɗin a saɓanin alkiblar tafiyarsa
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.r.c: Idan yana nuni saɓanin alkibla, yana hana tafiya gaba, don haka samfurin dot mara kyau ne.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.o.d: Lokacin da igiyar ke jan sled ɗin a karkatacciyar hanya amma zuwa kusan alkiblar tafiyarsa
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.r.d: A karkatacciyar alkibla zuwa gefe ɗaya, samfurin dot yana da kyau kuma kusurwar ba ta kai 90° ba.
n-m-h3-vec-06.s.s3.explain: Samfurin dot yana zama babbar lamba mai kyau yayin da vector biyu suka ƙara nuni zuwa gefe ɗaya, yana zama 0 idan sun tsaya wa juna daidai, kuma yana zama mara kyau idan sun nuni zuwa saɓanin gefe. A misalin sled, jan shi a akasin alkibla yana hana tafiya gaba, saboda haka yana dacewa da ƙima mara kyau.

n-m-h3-vec-07.topic: Vektoci da lissafin siffa mai girma uku
n-m-h3-vec-07.title: Idan babu faifai biyu masu layi ɗaya, faifai ukun za su haɗu a batu guda?
n-m-h3-vec-07.goal: Ka gwada hasashe game da matsayin faifai uku da misalin ƙarya da ka ƙirƙira da kanka, sannan ka bayyana tsarin da wannan misalin yake da shi.
n-m-h3-vec-07.material: Ka yi la’akari da faifai uku daban-daban. Wani aboki ya ce idan babu faifai biyu da suke layi ɗaya, faifai ukun kullum suna haɗuwa a batu guda. Faifai x=0 da y=0 ba layi ɗaya ba ne, kuma suna haɗuwa a layi guda. (Ana karanta x=0 da “x daidai yake da 0”, kuma ax+by+cz=d ita ce daidaiton faifai.)
n-m-h3-vec-07.thinking.0: Gwada hasashe da misalan da ka ƙirƙira da kanka
n-m-h3-vec-07.thinking.2: Bayyana matsayi ta amfani da tsarin layukan haɗuwar faifai
n-m-h3-vec-07.prereq.0: Daidaiton faifai da vector na al'ada
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.prompt: Me kake tunani game da maganar abokinka?
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko nemo layin da faifai x=0 da y=0 suke haɗuwa a cikinsa.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunani ko abin da suke da shi tare yana canzawa gwargwadon yadda faifai na uku yake haɗuwa da wannan layi.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.a: Ba koyaushe ba ne. Akwai yanayin da faifai ukun ba su da batu guda ɗaya na haɗuwa.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya kuma yi la’akari da dangantakar da ke tsakanin layin da faifai biyu suka haɗu a kansa da faifai na uku.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.b: Koyaushe haka ne. Faifai da ba su layi ɗaya suna haɗuwa, don haka faifai uku ma suna haɗuwa a batu guda.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.b: Faifai biyu da suke haɗuwa bibbiyu da faifai uku da suke da batu guda na haɗuwa ba abu ɗaya ba ne.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.c: Ba koyaushe ba ne. Amma yanayi biyu ne kawai: su haɗu a batu guda ko kuma a kan layi.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.c: Ba ka bincika yanayin da babu batu guda na haɗuwa ba. Ka yi tunani game da yanayin da faifai na uku yake layi ɗaya da layin haɗuwar faifai biyu na farko.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.o.d: Koyaushe haka ne. Faifai uku suna kasa haɗuwa ne kawai idan biyu daga cikinsu suke layi ɗaya.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hukunci ne da bai bincika kai tsaye ko za a iya rasa batu guda na haɗuwa ba ko da faifai ba layi ɗaya ba ne.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s1.explain: Faifai x=0 da y=0 suna haɗuwa a layin z-axis. Sakamakon yana dogara ne da ko faifai na uku yana haɗuwa da wannan layi ko a’a. Ko da babu faifai biyu daga cikin ukun da suke layi ɗaya, ƙila ba su da batu guda na haɗuwa. Ka gwada ko wannan gaskiya ne ta hanyar ƙirƙirar misali da kanka.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.prompt: Akwai faifai x=0 da y=0. Zaɓi faifai na uku ax + by + cz = d ta yadda babu faifai biyu daga cikin ukun da suke layi ɗaya, kuma faifai ukun ba su da batu guda na haɗuwa. a, b, c, d lambobi ne na ainihi. Ka ƙirƙiri faifai uku daban-daban.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ka gano inda layin da faifai x=0 da y=0 suke haɗuwa yake.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunani game da irin tsarin daidaiton da ake buƙata domin babu wani batu a kan wannan layi da zai cika faifai na uku.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Faifai na uku ba ya layi ɗaya da faifai x=0.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Faifai na uku yana layi ɗaya da faifai x=0. Duba ko vector na al'ada (a, b, c) yana layi ɗaya da (1, 0, 0).
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Faifai na uku ba ya layi ɗaya da faifai y=0.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Bédana katilu sajajar jeung bidang y=0. Pariksa naha vektor normal (a, b, c) sajajar jeung (0, 1, 0).
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Teu aya titik anu diliwatan ku tilu bidang éta sakaligus.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Aya titik anu diliwatan ku tilu bidang éta. Pariksa naha titik dina garis patepungna bidang x=0 jeung y=0 aya dina bidang katilu.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s2.explain: Bidang x=0 jeung y=0 patepung dina sumbu z. Lamun bidang katilu ngaliwatan sahenteuna hiji titik dina sumbu z, tilu bidang boga titik babarengan. Ngasupkeun titik (0, 0, z) dina sumbu z méré cz=d; sangkan teu aya z anu nyumponan, kudu c=0 jeung d≠0. Salian ti éta, a jeung b kudu lain 0 sangkan bidangna henteu sajajar jeung bidang x=0 atawa y=0.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.prompt: Candak salah sahiji bidang anu anjeun jieun jadi conto, jelaskeun naha unggal dua bidang silih patepung tapi teu aya hiji titik anu umum pikeun tiluanana.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.hint.0: Tuliskeun naon anu kajadian lamun titik dina garis hasil patepung x=0 jeung y=0 diasupkeun kana bidang anu anjeun jieun.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.hint.1: Pikirkeun patalina tilu garis anu kabentuk tina patepungna unggal dua bidang.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.placeholder: contona, garis patepung x=0 jeung y=0 nyaéta ..., sedengkeun bidang katiluna ...
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Naha anjeun ngajelaskeun kumaha susunan tilu garis patepung bidang éta?
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Naha anjeun némbongkeun ku rumus naha bidang katilu henteu patepung jeung sumbu z?
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Naha anjeun ngabédakeun yén unggal dua bidang patepung, tapi henteu tiluanana patepung babarengan?
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.0: Contona, candak x+y=1. x=0 jeung y=0 patepung dina sumbu z, tapi x+y=1 sajajar jeung sumbu z; titik dina sumbu z boga x+y=0, jadi teu bisa nyumponan bidang ieu. Teu aya dua bidang anu sajajar, tapi euweuh titik anu aya dina tilu bidang sakaligus.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.1: Tilu garis patepung bidangna kabéh sajajar jeung sumbu z. Saperti tilu sisi prisma segitiga, unggal dua bidang patepung, tapi euweuh titik anu diliwatan ku tiluanana babarengan.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.2: x+y=1 sajajar jeung sumbu z. Lamun titik (0,0,z) dina sumbu z diasupkeun, hasilna 0=1, anu mustahil, jadi euweuh titik umum pikeun tilu bidang.
n-m-h3-vec-07.s.s3.model.3: Sumbu z sajajar jeung bidang katilu, jadi teu patepung. Ku kituna unggal dua bidang patepung, tapi euweuh titik tempat tiluanana patepung babarengan.
